title: Creating TEAM-WV Corporation
description: The purpose of this bill is to create TEAM-WV.

title: Establishing the West Virginia Collaboratory
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia Collaboratory.

title: WV First Small Business Growth Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the WV First Small Business Growth Act.

title: Creating the Recharge West Virginia Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Recharge West Virginia Program, which reimburses West Virginia employers for the costs of upskilling their workforces. To be eligible for reimbursement, an employee must have received a 25% wage increase as a result of the upskilling training, and the wage must be above the average weekly West Virginia wage, as published by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. Each employer may receive $10,000 per trainee, and no employer may receive more than $50,000 during any fiscal year.

title: Skills to work
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the categories of employment which are prohibited or authorized for persons in West Virginia who are under the age of 18 and to clarify youth apprenticeships prohibited or authorized in such categories of employment and to be known as "The Workforce Development Act of 2026".

title: Creating the West Virginia Aerospace and Advanced Manufacturing Growth Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to foster the operations and growth of all facets of the aerospace industry in West Virginia.

title: Relating to industrial access roads
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that funding may be used as part of the West Virginia Business Ready Sites Program, raising the funding limits, and requiring a response deadline when a formal use request is submitted.

title: Relating to Business Ready Sites Program
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the West Virginia Business Ready Sites Program.

title: Relating to the creation of the Portable Benefit Account Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Portable Benefit Account Act.

title: Providing a statutory program for loaning financial assistance to local airports for airplane hangar construction in this state
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a statutory framework for lending state funds to local airports for hangar construction to enhance economic development in the state.

title: Relating to advanced recycling.
description: The purpose of this bill is to facilitate the implementation of the certification of mass balance attribution by third party certified to promote waste reduction practices by facilitating the use of recycled material in the feedstock for new products.

title: Relating to reducing the regulatory burden on utility companies when constructing and maintaining electric power generation and transmission facilities within this state
description: The purpose of this bill is to reduce the regulatory burden on utility companies when constructing and maintaining electric power generation and transmission facilities within this state.

title: Relating to the Mountaineer Flexible Tax Credit Act of 2026
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Mountaineer Flexible Tax Credit Act of 2026, encourage economic development through tax incentives, and promote the welfare of the people through investment in businesses.

title: Workforce Readiness and Opportunity Act
description: The purpose of this bill is all related to the Workforce Readiness and Opportunity Initiatives Act including by establishing the West Virginia Micro-Credential Program, expanding the apprenticeship training tax credit, allowing for independent contractors to have portable benefits which hiring parties can contribute to without altering the nature of the relationship, providing for tax treatment of portable benefits, and eliminating barriers to professional licensures for military trained applicants.

title: Tourism Development Act Credit.
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand the definition of tourism attraction to include lodging facility for purposes of the Tourism Development Act credit

title: Historic Rehab Building Credit Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to sunset the historic rehabilitation credits in their current disperse locations in the code, provide continued eligibility to current recipients, and to replace those sections with a cohesive article that is easier to utilize and administer.

title: Faith Based Partnership
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide the Secretary of the Department of Human Services with the authority to enter into contracts and partnerships with child welfare providers, including faith-based organizations, to carry out the statutory responsibilities imposed upon the Department of Human Services under Chapter 49.

title: Enhancing Flood Resiliency Disbursements
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the State Resiliency Officer to disburse funds from the West Virginia Flood Resiliency Trust Fund, upon the approval of the State Resiliency Office Board.

title: Relating to Personal income Tax Reduction
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the personal income tax.

title: Removing Full Time Requirement for Health Officers
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the qualifications for State Health Officer, Commissioner of the Bureau for Public Health, and the Commissioner of the Bureau of Senior Services to attract and retain high quality talent in these positions.

title: Bring them Home Fund.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the renovation and repair of state-owned properties and buildings to expand high-acuity psychiatric, neurodevelopmental, and trauma services for children in West Virginia.

title: CPS Allocation
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the application of the allocation formula for child protective services workers by county, and to set forth what information should be included in the annual report.

title: Relating to Updating Corporate Net Income Tax definitions
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend and update Â§11-24-3 of the Code of West Virginia, 1931, as amended to bring terms not defined in that act into conformity with the meaning of those terms for federal income tax purposes; and specifying effective dates.

title: Relating to Updating Personal Income Tax definitions
description: The purpose of this bill is to update the meaning of federal adjusted gross income and certain other terms used in the West Virginia Personal Income Tax Act; and specify effective dates.

title: Exempting certain employees from the classified civil service system
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt new hires and promoted employees within the Departments of Health Facilities, Department of Human Services, and Department of Health from the classified civil service system and the state grievance process starting on July 1, 2026.

title: Relating to expanding the requirements for integrated resource plans utility companies must file with the Public Service Commission
description: The purpose of this bill is to require utility companies to expand the integrated resource plans filed with the Public Service Commission to include comprehensive analyses and descriptions and describe current and potential future uses of advanced transmission technologies that detail economic and technological feasibility, optimization, reliability, and resiliency, and list other technologies designed to increase and optimize efficiency, safety, reliability, resilience, and capacity.

title: Budget Bill
description: The Budget Bill making appropriations of public money out of the Treasury in accordance with section 51, article VI of the Constitution.

title: Relating to sales tax on construction materials
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide contactors of school facilities with a tax exemption on construction materials.

title: Require all public contracts be publicly advertised
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a public entity accepting a bid on a public contract to notify all municipalities and counties in which the contractor or any of its subcontractors will be performing services under the contract of the existence of the contract. The bill also requires publishing terms of contract; and providing time for public comment.

title: Standardize gas and oil contracts
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the secretary of the Department of Environmental Protection to adopt rules relating to the standardization of leases, deeds, or contracts relating to oil and gas, consistent in format with the purpose of making the terms of these documents less confusing to the landowners.

title: Require all tax assessments be done on a periodic schedule
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide requirements for the fair and equitable assessment of real property.

title: Establish quick response teams to work with drug users who are arrested
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish quick response teams (QRT) under the Office of Drug Control Policy to act as first responders in narcotic related medical emergencies.

title: Require that a public service district board that represents more than one community have at least one member from each community
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that if a public service board represents more than one community, there shall be one member from each such community on the service district board.

title: To display the Ten Commandments in public schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to require public elementary schools and secondary schools to display in a conspicuous place in each classroom of the school a durable poster or framed copy of the Ten Commandments that meets certain requirements.

title: Relating to providing a credit against the business and occupation tax imposed on coal-fired electric generating units to help off-set environmental compliance costs
description: The purpose of this bill is to encourage and incentivize the installation, repair, and maintenance of environmental pollution control equipment at coal-fired electric generating units located in West Virginia and that serve West Virginia residents, by authorizing a credit against the business and occupation tax imposed on the business of generating electricity, thereby extending the life of coal-fired power plants, which will provide cheaper electricity to the State's residents.

title: Relating to stricter enforcement for parking in a handicapped designated spot
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase certain criminal penalties for unlawful use of designated accessible parking spaces for mobility impaired persons and unlawful creation and use of special plates or placards issued to mobility impaired persons and establishing a program to increase public awareness for unlawful use of designated accessible parking spaces for mobility impaired persons and unlawful creation and use of special plates or placards issued to mobility impaired persons

title: Consolidate county school boards
description: The purpose of this bill is to unify county school districts in the state; establish findings; require county school districts be unified with other county school districts by July 1, 2029; require State Board of Education to study and provide recommendation regarding school district unification by October 31, 2026; create School District Unification Committee to assist State Board of Education; and authorize rulemaking to aid in the transition process.

title: Relating generally to coal fired energy plants and wind power
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit the number of permits to construct wind power plants, wind power farms, or "windmills" for power generally in West Virginia; to provide that for each new wind powered facility built in West Virginia, there is an offset in the amount of taxes paid by new and existing coal fired power plants; and to ensure that coal remains the primary source of power in West Virginia during emergency weather events.

title: Limit amount a county tax assessor can increase assessed value of antique or classic cars
description: The purpose of this bill is to require county tax assessor to have a justification for increasing the valuation of an antique or classic vehicle.

title: Non-State Owned Roads Improvement Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to facilitate the improvement of non-state owned roads by municipalities while providing legal safeguards against litigation, ensuring that local governments can enhance infrastructure and ensure public safety effectively.

title: Making it a mandatory 25 year sentence for an assault on any law enforcement or animal
description: The purpose of this bill is to make a mandatory sentence of 25 years for anyone convicted of assault on any law enforcement officer or law enforcement animal.

title: To eliminate property taxes on the farm structures of any farmer producing at least 40% of their income from their farm
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt from taxation real property used for farming, if the owner-farmer resides on the real property and receives at least 40 percent of his or her income from the farm.

title: To give an additional $20,000 dollar Homestead Exemption on the property tax of any West Virginia citizen farmer that produces more than 50% of his or her income from their farm
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide an additional homestead exemption on the property tax of any West Virginia citizen farmer who produces more than 50% of his or her income from their farm.

title: To require hair follicle drug testing of parents or guardians in cases of substantiated child abuse or neglect of a minor
description: The purpose of this bill is to enhance and improve child well-being by requiring a hair follicle drug test of a substantiated child abuser before restoring visitation rights.

title: Allow customers to make changes to their accounts by phone or mail.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create The Rossi Act; requiring that entities providing goods, services, or utilities allow changes to be made to an electronic account by telephone or mail; and providing for enforcement.

title: Relating to Rural Recycling Co-ops
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow cooperatives, operating continuously for at least 12 consecutive months before a certified waste motor carrier begins providing the same service in the same area, to continue to serve its members.

title: To remove sales tax for food bought in vending machines
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove consumers sales and service tax from prepared food sold through vending and money-operated machines.

title: To prohibit placement of children in unlicensed organizations
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the crime of sale or barter of a child for adoption and the prohibition of placement of children for adoption by an unlicensed person or organization and create criminal penalties.

title: Relating to the creation of the Criminal Forfeiture Process Act replacing the West Virginia Contraband Forfeiture Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Criminal Forfeiture Process Act.

title: Establishing reporting requirements for utilities that are members of a regional transmission organization
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that each public utility that is a member of a regional transmission organization submit information relating to the utility's or an affiliate's votes at a regional transmission organization meeting.

title: Permitting certain nonviolent offenders to be able to carry firearms.
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that the right to bear arms is a constitutional right and to provide when persons convicted of non-violent crimes may have their rights to bear arms reinstated. The bill also clarifies what constitutes a crime of violence and provides protection for residents in the exercise of their constitutional rights.

title: To enhance the safety of first responders at emergency scenes (Halo Law)
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the HALO law.

title: To establish the blue envelope program.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the blue envelope program.

title: WV code §19-20-20 apply to all animals, not just dogs
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the ownership of any vicious pet.

title: Repeal WV Code §56-3-16. Execution of process on Sunday.
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the code prohibiting civil process on Sunday.

title: Allow local governments to hold property owners more accountable for upkeep of buildings
description: The purpose of this bill is to empower county commissions and local governing bodies to compel removal of unsafe real property conditions.

title: Reducing cost for Volunteer Fire and EMS supplies
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the promulgation of rules, to implement a central purchasing program to reduce the cost of supplies by purchasing in bulk or in a discounted format for volunteer fire fighters and emergency medical services first responders.

title: Assure West Virginians proper access to water and sewage service at reasonable rates
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the PSC to reduce rates for residential utility customers who are residents of a small community with fewer than 1,000 residents.

title: To require hospitals and or Counties to report costs associated with illegal or undocumented immigrants
description: The purpose of this bill is to require political subdivisions and the Department of Health to collect and report data regarding the cost expended on undocumented immigrants.

title: Businesses in WV must accept cash
description: The purpose of this bill is to require businesses in West Virginia to accept cash as a form of payment.

title: Requiring PEIA and other health insurance providers to provide payment parity for certain services
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide payment parity for mental health care delivered by non-physicians for identical services provided by physicians.

title: To create the West Virginia Homeschool Student Athletics Participation Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide an opportunity for homeschool students to engage in interscholastic athletics while maintaining the integrity of WVSSAC rankings and postseason competitions.

title: Relating to requiring the State Board of Education to design, test, and deploy an internet-based reporting system to be known as the School Choice Portal
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a school choice portal. The bill also requires the Board of Education to adopt a school choice portal.

title: Relating to the rate of tax on motor vehicles
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the rate of tax on motor vehicles to include the exchange of used cars. This article is new, therefore,

title: Relating to the membership of the Hope Scholarship Board
description: The purpose of this bill relates generally to the composition of the Hope Scholarship Board.

title: Creating penalties for county and state boards of education for providing misinformation to parents, custodians, reviewers, or any other individual through any form of communication
description: The purpose of this bill is to create penalties for county and state boards of education for providing misinformation to parents, custodians, reviewers, or any other individual through any form of communication.

title: Providing any employee working 20 hours or more per week in a licensed child care center or certified family child care (FCC) home is eligible for a child care subsidy, regardless of their household income
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a subsidy for child care services rendered to children of child care program employees.

title: Requiring Department of Health to report positive Alpha Gal tests to CDC
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Secretary of the Department of Health to propose legislative rules to include alpha-gal syndrome on the list of diseases that shall be required to be reported to the Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

title: To remove the helmet law in West Virginia.
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove helmet and eye protection from motorcycle safety equipment requirements.

title: Relating to natural immunity or antibodies to any illness to be treated as equal or better to vaccine induced immunity
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide equal or preferred treatment to persons who have natural immunity or antibodies from their contraction of an infectious or communicable disease as opposed to persons who have vaccine induced immunity.

title: Requiring K–12 schools to display school report card on website
description: The purpose of this bill is to require county boards of education, K though 12 schools, to display school report cards on websites and use the statewide electronic information system established by the state board for data collection and reporting to the state department of education.

title: Creating the Employee Child Care Assistance Partnership
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Employee Child Care Assistance Partnership Program.

title: Permitting religious exemptions for compulsory immunizations
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit a religious exemption to compulsory school immunizations.

title: Relating to establishing a pilot program to develop a childcare program where the state, employer, and employee, contribute one-third of the total cost each
description: The purpose of this bill is to improve the affordability, access, and quality of childcare by reducing the cost to the parent or caretaker.

title: Insurance must cover Bioidentical hormones as they do pharmaceutical one
description: The purpose of this bill is to require insurance coverage for biodentical hormones.

title: Relating to the sale of homemade food items and honey
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize production and sale of homemade food items under certain circumstances.

title: Remove standardized testing in public and private schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate standardized testing requirements in West Virginia public and private schools.

title: To repeal a provision of the code relating to the limitation on bringing an action to enter upon or recover lands
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal a provision of the code relating to the limitation on bringing an action to enter upon or recover lands.

title: Eliminate woke, anti-women words from state government
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate woke words and agendas from state government documents, websites, literature, and in person.

title: To provide for partisan races for mayoral and city council races, and provide for the election of mayors by citizens of a town or municipality.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require mayor and city council elections to be partisan.

title: To create the Higher Education Health and Aid Grant.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Higher Education Health and Aid Grant," which requires the West Virginia Higher Education Policy Commission to establish a grant program to address food, health, and hygiene insecurities among students enrolled in state institutions of higher education

title: Require the West Virginia Department of Education to provide a complete and in-depth budget for review to the Legislature.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the State Board of Education to provide a budget for review by the Legislature.

title: Relating to Medical Professional Responsibility
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify parameters for medical malpractice civil actions.

title: To protect homeowners from unscrupulous contractors
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a written contract between a licensed contractor and owner or lessee of residential property and information to be contained in the written contract.

title: To increase penalties for selling or facilitating the sale of alcohol to a minor.
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the penalties for selling or obtaining alcohol for a minor.

title: West Virginia Teachers Retirement system
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow Tier II members of the Teachers Retirement System to apply accrued annual and sick leave, on the basis of one day's retirement service credit for each one day of accrued annual and sick leave, toward an increase in his or her retirement benefits with those days constituting additional credited service in computation of the benefits under the Teachers Retirement System.

title: To create a West Virginia-Ireland Education Alliance.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia-Ireland Education Alliance Partnership with the goal of the West Virginia-Ireland Education Alliance Partnership is to strengthen academic, cultural, and workforce connections between West Virginia and Ireland,

title: Relating to certified public accountants
description: The purpose of this bill is to update the provisions governing the education, examination and experience requirements for certified public accountants and to clarify substantial equivalency practice privileges and the issuance of certificates to out-of-state applicants/practitioners.

title: Preservation of hair during chemotherapy. Also known as the “Jessica Huffman Bill”
description: The purpose of this bill is to require health insurers to provide coverage for scalp cooling systems for the preservation of hair during cancer chemotherapy treatment.

title: Provide for the employment or acceptance as avolunteer of a Certified Chaplain by public school board
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize county boards of education to employ or accepting as volunteers certified chaplains. The bill also provides for limitation of liability.

title: Removal of elected and certain appointed officers by courts.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the removal of elected and certain appointed officers by courts.

title: require all law enforcement officers in WV be U.S. citizens
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that all law-enforcement officers have proof of citizenship of the United States as a condition of certification; and providing an exception for those persons already employed

title: To allow those with a concealed carry license to carry a concealed handgun in public school property and buildings.
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow persons who have a concealed carry license to carry a concealed handgun in or on the grounds of any primary or secondary educational facility.

title: To eliminate the dog tax
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the sections of code relating to dogs being subject to taxation.

title: To remove qualified immunity from officers serving no-knock warrants
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove qualified immunity for officers serving no-knock warrants if they are found to have used excessive force or are found to have been negligent and to cause an investigation of the training the officer received.

title: Preserving and protecting the right to keep and bear arms
description: The purpose of this bill is to define acts which constitute infringements of the right to keep and bear arms, to articulate the constitutional limits on such infringements, to declare all such infringements to be against the rights of the people and to be legally void, and to provide remedies for acts taken under the color of federal law.

title: To create the Protection of Shared Physical and Digital Property from Warrantless Searches Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Protection of Shared Physical and Digital Property from Warrantless Searches Act. The bill provides for legislative findings. The bill provides for definitions. The bill creates conditions for government to search or seize physical or digital property from a third party. The bill defines illegal searches and seizures. Finally, the bill provides for an effective date

title: To restore the right of a person to sit on a jury has been restored upon expungement of one’s record
description: The purpose of this bill is to reinstate jury service rights to citizens with felony convictions if the felony convictions have been expunged.

title: To disallow the recognition of a drivers license issued by another state to any undocumented immigrant
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish that drivers licenses issued in other states to undocumented immigrants are not recognized as valid in West Virginia.

title: Relating to human growth and development curriculum
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend required courses of education to include human growth and development related to pregnancy and human development inside the womb; required methods of presenting this instruction and adding a human growth and development curriculum to be known as the "Baby Olivia Act"; and to authorize the Attorney General to sue for any violation of the "Baby Olivia Act".

title: To amend the state tax code to provide an exemption from state income tax for families with four or more children
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a personal income tax exemption for families with four or more children.

title: Requiring publicly funded medical schools to teach certain life-saving methods
description: The purpose of this bill is to require publicly-funded medical schools to teach the most current evidence-based, life-saving methods including abortion pill reverse.

title: Relating to the display of the Ten Commandments in public schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to require public elementary schools and secondary schools to display in a conspicuous place in each classroom of the school a durable poster or framed copy of the Ten Commandments that meets certain requirements.

title: American Civics and History Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the American Civics and History Act.

title: To provide requirements relating to education of students and young adults about unplannned pregnancy options
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Adoption Education Act; providing requirements relating to the education of students and young adults about unplanned pregnancy options, including adoption as an option; providing for the education about current adoption practices; and providing for adoption resources.

title: Allowing constitutional carry for 18- to 20-year-olds
description: The purpose of this bill is to recognize the right of persons 18-20 years of age to carry a deadly weapon without first obtaining a license to carry concealed deadly weapons.

title: Relating to requiring disclosure of the lawful activity that is the basis of a permit application with the Department of Environmental Protection
description: The purpose of this bill is to require disclosure of the lawful activity that is the basis of a permit application with the Department of Environmental Protection; and providing exceptions thereto.

title: Increasing transparency in the apportionment process for congressional and legislative districts
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase transparency in the apportionment process for congressional and legislative districts.

title: Removing cap on numbers of wells operators required to pay annual oversight fee
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the cap on the number of gas and other type wells for which operators are required to pay annual oversight fees.

title: Creating the WV Energy Efficiency Jobs Creation Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide the Public Service Commission the authority to require electric utilities to develop and implement plans for the efficient use, conservation and reduction of electricity usage. The bill sets forth goals to achieve electricity savings. The bill also requires electric utilities to submit plans for reaching those goals. The bill also provides for a self-direct option for large electricity customers.

title: Establishing a community solar program for subscribers to gain credits against their utility bills
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a community solar program where subscribers can purchase an interest in a solar facility and use credits against their electric utility costs; establishing parameters and conditions for the program; and provide for administration and rulemaking by the Public Service Commission.

title: Provide tax credit for homeschool students
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish tax credits for parents and legal guardians whose children are in a home-schooling program or private school. The bill provides for an exception. Finally, the bill provides rule-making authority.

title: Emergency Medical Services Sales Tax
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize county commissions to impose an emergency medical services tax.

title: Relating to oversight of West Virginia Fusion Center
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for oversight authority of the West Virginia Fusion Center; to terminate the Joint Oversight Committee as of June 30, 2026; to establish the Fusion Center Joint Oversight Committee to be effective July 1, 2026; to direct the Inspector General to conduct an annual audit of the Fusion Center and to respond to questions from committee; to provide that the President and Speaker may call Fusion Center employees to testify in committee meetings; and to establish that violations of law or policy identified by audit may form basis for disciplinary action for a Fusion Center employee.

title: To modify the required amount of contracted teaching days and provide for breaks per semester for teachers.
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the required amount of contracted teaching days and provide for breaks per semester for teachers.

title: Relating to eligiblity for WV Invests Grant Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend the West Virginia Invests Grant Program to an associate degree or certificate in a post-secondary program for emergency medical services.

title: Prohibiting surprise billing of ground emergency medical services by nonparticipating providers
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit out-of-network emergency medical services agencies from balance billing a covered enrollee in a health insurance plan for ground ambulance services. The bill establishes the minimum payment to be made by an insurer to an out-of-network emergency medical services agency for ambulance services. The bill requires payment by the insurer directly to the out-of-network emergency medical services agency and the prompt payment of clean claims.

title: Authority to establish voluntary firefighter service fee and fund.
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize county commissions to establish and impose voluntary firefighter service fees on county residents and establish a voluntary firefighter service fund.

title: Establishing the West Virginia TEACH Scholarship Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia TEACH Scholarship Program.

title: Productive Energy Site Reclamation Waiver
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Productive Energy Site Reclamation Waiver Program to streamline the process of transferring former surface mine sites into productive sites for new energy generation projects arid to optimize the flat land for energy projects that is otherwise in short supply in the state of West Virginia.

title: Relating to reporting duties of county commission regarding ambulance services.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the county commissions to provide ambulance service to all residents and to submit a yearly report to the Office of Emergency Medical Services on the funds expended the year prior on emergency ambulance services.

title: To require cameras in every classroom and room where children are present
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that all schools maintain cameras in areas where students are present in schools.

title: To provide a pay increase for the West Virginia Capitol Police and support staff of Capitol police
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a pay increase for capitol police and staff.

title: To require baby food manufacturers to provide information about the quantity of or percentage of different types of heavy metals in baby food
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure the safety of baby food products sold in West Virginia.

title: Eliminate double taxation on foreign income at the state level
description: The purpose of this bill is to alleviate double taxation on foreign income at the state level. The bill sunsets the credit for income tax paid on foreign income in 2070.

title: To modify the funding distribution to the state park endowment fund and the State Parks Operational Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the funding distribution to the West Virginia State Parks and Recreation Endowment Fund and the State Parks Operation Fund as it relates to royalties received from beneath the Ohio River and its tributaries.

title: Repealing section of code authorizing additional registration fees for alternative fuel vehicles
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the section of the West Virginia code relating to additional registration fees for alternative fuel vehicles.

title: Determining Bond requirements for certain crimes
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit magistrates to order mental health evaluations prior to setting bonds for certain crimes.

title: Relating to the prohibition of warrantless searches and seizures.
description: The purpose of this bill is to warrantless entry of private lands; limitations of entry onto private lands; clarifying the process for law enforcement entry onto posted private lands; use of surveillance cameras on or near posted private lands; searches and seizures on private lands; requiring a search warrant or other recognized exception for searches and seizures in open fields; providing a definition; providing for abolishing the common law open fields doctrine; prohibiting surveillance cameras on private property; and providing exceptions.

title: Increase penalties for abuse of or cruelty to animals
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide increased protections for the welfare of domestic animals in the care of animal shelters, breeders, and private individuals.

title: Create a Police Officer’s Bill of Rights
description: The purpose of this bill is to guarantee certain procedural safeguards to law-enforcement officers during any investigation or interrogation or subsequent hearing that could lead to disciplinary action, demotion, or dismissal.

title: Provide programs to educate senior citizens
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the implementation of community education programs throughout the state to facilitate the providing of educational, recreational, cultural, social, health, and other community services to senior citizens of the community.

title: Defining a work day for school service personnel and removing a provision relating to employment of licensed practical nurses
description: The purpose of this bill is to define "workday" and "half workday" for school service personnel.

title: To quantify fair workman compensation rates and more equitable method of tracking/billing for various classifications within volunteer fire departments and emergency rescue personnel
description: The purpose of this bill is to quantify and ensure fair workers' compensation rates and to develop a more equitable method of tracking and billing for the various classifications within volunteer fire departments and emergency rescue personnel.

title: To allow police access to all photo information upon arrest for sex offenders
description: The purpose of this bill is to require registrant to Sex Offender Registry to provide all online identifiers from internet and mobile application accounts; to permit State Police to inspect mobile phone to verify accuracy of information; and to requiring registrant provide information about All Terrain Vehicles and Utility Terrain Vehicles operated by the registrant.

title: To require the Department of Education to alter who can certify homeschool portfolios or review them
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that certified teachers who review portfolios of samples of a home instructed child's work receive training in specific areas such as English, math, and science.

title: Updating the West Virginia Law Institute
description: The purpose of this bill is to add new members; clarify how vacancies shall be filled; authorize reimbursement for the members; and exempt the institute from open meetings laws.

title: Relating to persons convicted of a crime
description: The purpose of this bill is to address Code consistency given the passage of SB240 during 2025 Regular Session to ensure that the current crimes of "sexual extortion" and "aggravated sexual extortion" are offenses that require registration as a sex offender by person convicted of one of these offenses and also clarifies that a prior conviction for the crime of sexual assault of a spouse, which was repealed by an act of the Legislature during the 2000 legislative session shall remain an offense that requires registration as a sex offender.

title: Allow female inmates to work on state convict road crews.
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit female inmates to become members of the state convict road force.

title: To allow counties to post legal ads on their website in lieu of print in local newspapers
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize county commissions post legal ads on the county website in lieu of publication in local newspapers.

title: Award military veterans with a “Veterans” license plate
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt honorably discharged veteran of any branch of the armed services of the United States from the payment of vehicle registration fees under the provisions of this chapter, except for a special initial application fee of $10.

title: Better protect citizens in the event of a car accident with an uninsured motorist
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the commissioner of Motor Vehicles to develop and implement an electronic insurance verification program; to require the Insurance Commissioner to propose rules necessary to implement requirements of the electronic insurance verification program; and require every person operating a vehicle have insurance.

title: Relating to Women’s Bill of Rights
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia Women's Bill of Rights.

title: To require the state to pay all state employees a $500 Holiday Bonus (Christmas) if state surplus revenues exceed 100$ million annually
description: The purpose of this bill is to grant an annual Christmas bonus to eligible state employees if state surplus revenue exceeds $100 million annually.

title: Creating a school choice office.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the creation of a school choice office by the Governor.

title: To require compulsory vaccinations for anyone employed by the public school system in this state.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require vaccinations for anyone employed by the public school system in this state, to be done in accordance with the pediatric schedule. The bill prohibits religious or philosophical exemptions by school personnel. The bill requires a 21-day quarantine period for anyone employed by the school system who participates in states who permit vaccine exemptions. Finally, the bill requires vaccinations and proof of vaccinations by visitors to public schools.

title: Make underage tobacco possession unlawful
description: The purpose of this bill is to make possession or use of a tobacco derived product by a person under 21 unlawful.

title: Requiring all salesperson licensees to submit proof of authorization to work.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require applicants for real estate salesperson's licenses to submit proof of United States Citizenship.

title: Relating to warrantless entry of private lands
description: The purpose of this bill is to set forth limitations of entry onto private lands; clarify the process for law enforcement entry onto posted private lands; and clarify the use of surveillance cameras on or near posted private lands.

title: Pertaining to the right of lawful medical cannabis card holders, and their caregivers
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that lawful medical cannabis card holders and their caregiver have a right to own, purchase, and possess firearms.

title: Establishing the West Virginia Aviation Access and Tourism Growth Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia Aviation Access and Tourism Growth Act.

title: Workforce-Education Partnership Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the Workforce Education Partnership Act.

title: West Virginia Skilled and Ready to Work Internship and Apprenticeship Incentive Act
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the creation of the West Virginia Skilled and Ready to Work Internship and Apprenticeship Incentive Act.

title: To require all West Virginia public employee retirement agencies to provide an annual cost of living adjustment for all retirees who have been retired for over ten (10) years
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a cost-of-living adjustment for retired public employees and school personnel.

title: To include all West Virginia correctional classifications in the Natural Resources Officer Pension System.
description: The purpose of this bill is to include West Virginia correctional classifications in the Natural Resources Officer Retirement System.

title: To amend the law regarding sewer systems.
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit mandatory hook-ups and installation fees for new or expanding sewer systems.

title: Eliminating requirement for write-in candidates to register with Secretary of State in order to qualify write-in candidate votes to be counted.
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the requirement that write-in candidates file with the Secretary of State before votes for said candidates can be counted.

title: Relating generally to drug testing of state legislators
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the random drug testing of legislators.

title: Relating to the hiring requirements of West Virginia law enforcement employees
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the process of appointing eligible law enforcement officers after competitive examinations.

title: Relating to federal involvement in elections
description: The purpose of this bill is to require legislative approval before implementing any new federal guidance on elections, accepting any new federal funds for elections, and mandating that the Governor, Secretary of State, and the Legislature be notified when they receive communications from any federal agency regarding elections.

title: Providing authority for West Virginia law enforcement agencies to fine individual vehicle owners who fail to register their vehicle that have been parked at their residence for more than sixty days
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide authority for West Virginia law enforcement agencies to fine an individual who has a vehicle with out of state license plates that has been parked at their residence for more than 90 days.

title: WV Economic Development and Property Revitalization Tax Credit
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the creation of the West Virginia Economic Development and Property Revitalization Tax Credit Act of 2026.

title: FOIA Database
description: The purpose of this bill is to require custodians of any public records to maintain a public accessible database; protect the identity of persons with FOIA requests; and requiring updates of public online data bases.

title: Election integrity and People’s vote protection act
description: The purpose of this bill is to mandate, in conjunction with the use of electronic voting machines for elections, that poll workers manually count physical ballots at each precinct at the close of the election.

title: Reducing the term of office for Berkeley County Commisioners from six years to four years
description: The purpose of this bill is to direct the County Commission of Berkeley County to hold a referendum election at the next general election to change the term of office for county commissioners from six years to four years.

title: Require Governor to provide at least five days notice to all state legislators when calling a Special Session
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that the proclamation of the convening of the Legislature by the governor be issued not less than five days prior to the convening of the Legislature and to require the governor give not less than five days' notice to state legislators when calling a special session.

title: Relating generally to initiating a West Virginia legislative redistricting commission.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create an independent redistricting commission for the Legislature.

title: Relating to vaccine requirements
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the requirements for compulsory childhood immunizations.

title: Relating to mental health examination requirements.
description: The purpose of this bill is to aligning mental health examination requirements with those required for involuntary hospitalizations.

title: To prohibit the charging of any fees to cash any government issued check.
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit merchants from charging fees to cash a check issued by a governmental entity.

title: Gender identification on forms of ID
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the sex at birth on a birth certificate and require medical documentation or a court order to change an applicant's sex on driver's licenses, identification cards, or instruction permits.

title: Removing the Office of County Surveyor from election ballots
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the office of County Surveyor from elections and ending the office in West Virginia.

title: Requiring candidates to live in the state or local election district for the office for which they are seeking
description: The purpose of this bill is to require candidates to live in the state or local election district for the office for which they are seeking to be elected.

title: Creating a standing legislative oversight committee to approve all West Virginia Economic Development contracts.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a legislative oversight committee to approve all West Virginia Economic Development Authority contracts.

title: To repeal the requirement for automobile inspection.
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the requirement that automobiles be inspected.

title: To allow youth and handicapped hunters to harvest a buck deer or doe during youth/handicapped special hunts
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow youths and those carrying a Class Q special hunting permit to take antlered deer.

title: Limit property tax increases on certain individuals
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit property tax increases for individuals who are over 65, permanently disable, or widowed, and earn less than $20,000 per year.

title: To challenge the necessity of needing a municipal or county license as well as a WV State license for doing business
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that any person who has obtained a business registration certificate to engage in business in West Virginia, may not be required to obtain a business registration license by a municipality or county.

title: To create felony charge for individuals who assault police officers or police dogs
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend penalties for any assault on a police officer or police dog.

title: Provide volunteer firemen free license plates and vehicle registration
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit volunteer firefighters with five or more years of service to be eligible for free vehicle registrations and license plates on their personal vehicle.

title: Permitting middle or high school students to participate in travel sports teams without repercussion.
description: The purpose of this bill is to forbid the West Virginia Secondary School Activities Commission from taking any adverse action against middle or high school student athletes who participate in travel sports.

title: To expand the EMS retirement system
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that an emergency medical services agency designated by a county commission to provide emergency response through a county emergency dispatch center qualifies as a participating public employer in the Emergency Medical Services Retirement System.

title: Exempt non-profits from certain road sign fees
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt nonprofit organizations from paying fees for outdoor advertising.

title: To exempt safe gun storage devices from state sales tax
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt safe gun storage devices from state sales tax.

title: Repeal the West Virginia machinegun ban
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the section of code making it unlawful to possess a fully automatic weapon.

title: Extend the CCW permit payment waiver for Veterans to Active Duty
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt active-duty service members from fees for a license to carry a concealed deadly weapon.

title: Require Certified Fire Investigators to be classified as professionals under the State Sales and Usage Tax exemptions
description: The purpose of this bill is to define professional services for the sales tax code and add certified fire investigators to the definition.

title: Provide tax credit incentive to businesses and individuals that donate to pregnancy/birth centers
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a tax credit for companies who donate to pregnancy and birthing centers in this state.

title: Relating to Hope Scholarships awards
description: The purpose of this bill is to help preserve Hope Scholarship funding resources by placing family income eligibility limitations for Hope scholarships, and providing the county schools be reimbursed for services provided to Hope scholarship recipients.

title: Relating to the restoration of civil rights
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the automatic restoration of civil rights for certain nonviolent first offenders.

title: Relating to providing child care generally
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the tax credit for employers providing child care for employees.

title: Establishing the Tri-Share Child Care Assistance Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide support to West Virginia families by incentivizing employers to contribute to the child-care costs of its employees. In enacting this legislation, it is the intention of the Legislature to enable the Department of Economic Development to facilitate this public and private partnership program and administer program funds to achieve this purpose.

title: Per-Credit Tuition for WV Community Colleges
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the increase of tuition fees for Community and Technical Colleges on a per credit hour basis for all undergraduate credit hours attempted.

title: Community Air Monitoring
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection to install and monitor air quality using fenceline monitors near facilities that emit air pollution, provide technical assistance to individuals and groups that wish to monitor the air quality in their communities, encourage the Department of Environmental Protection to use the collected data; permit individuals to submit the data collected regarding air pollution to the secretary, and enable the secretary to follow up on any data found from fenceline air quality monitoring.

title: Placing a two year a cap on electrical utility rates
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide relief to West Virginia residents and businesses from the rocket ride of rapidly rising utility rates by placing a temporary cap on electrical utility rates.

title: To offer long-acting reversible contraception to patients receiving methadone and suboxone at the treatment facility for the methadone and suboxone
description: The purpose of this bill is to require licensed programs, under the Medication-Assisted Treatment Program Licensing Act, to offer long-acting reversible contraception to patients recovering from addiction to new and current patients.

title: Mandating health insurance coverage treatment of pediatric patients diagnoced with PANDAS or PANS

description: The purpose of this bill is to verify the legal employment status of workers and record-keeping requirements and employer compliance. title: Relating to Medicaid providers
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish uniform and expedited credentialing standards for Medicaid providers and require electronic submission of credentialing applications. The bill further directs the Department of Human Services to transition to a unified statewide electronic credentialing system.

title: relating to standards for a medication-assisted treatment program.
description: The purpose of this bill is to update the drug testing standards for medication-assisted treatment programs.

title: Prohibit the use of school resources in election advocacy efforts and prohibit school employees from political activity during their work hours or on behalf of the school administration
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the use of school resources in election advocacy efforts. The bill also prohibits school employees from political activity during work hours or engaging in such activity on behalf of the school administration.

title: Relating to Eminent Domain
description: The purpose of this bill is to change which properties may be taken by eminent domain and the causes for such takings.

title: Changing the local school board election from the Primary to the General
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the date of the local school board elections from the date of the primary election to the date of the general election.

title: Relating to exemptions of property in bankruptcy proceedings
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a surviving spouse to be able to claim the deceased spouse's homestead exemption so long as the home they owned together is owned by the surviving spouse.

title: Relating to per diem jail costs
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit county responsibility for certain jail costs to 30 days from the date of incarceration when an inmate, incarcerated for a felony conviction, is awaiting transportation to a state correctional facility for a 60-day evaluation period.

title: Relating to state contracts regarding homeless
description: The purpose of this bill is to require entities that contract with the State of West Virginia to distribute funds for homeless shelters to have a board of directors with a member of that board representing each region of the state.

title: Individual Gaming Restrictions
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend individual gaming restrictions.

title: Unconscious patients in the ICU
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Michael Brandon Cochran Act; provide definitions; require certain medical testing of ICU patients; establish a monetary penalty; and create a grant program and fund.

title: Relating to the preservation of missing persons records and evidence
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish specific protocol for preserving records and evidence in missing persons cases that are unresolved after one year.

title: Addressing the number of ambulance squads needed per affected population in every county
description: The purpose of this bill is to require counties to provide ambulance services at a ratio of one ambulance service for every 18,000 residents.

title: To remove income tax from overtime work
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt income received by a full-time hourly waged paid employee as compensation for work performed in excess of 40 hours in a week and all tips and gratuities earned by any employee from West Virginia income taxation.

title: Relating to health insurance for living organ donors
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the denial, cancellation, or other discrimination in policies of life insurance, sickness, disability, or long-term care insurance due to the status of the insured as a living organ donor.

title: Provide volunteer firemen free license plates and vehicle registration
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit volunteer firefighters with five or more years of service to be eligible for free vehicle registrations and license plates on their personal vehicle.

title: Removing certain requirements from WV Jobs Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to specify alternative forms of documentation of employees to be filed with the Division of Labor when the contractors are working on construction of public improvements.

title: Creating a Public Awareness Campaign on the threat of mold in indoor environments
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the public awareness campaign on mold threat in indoor environments with definitions, rules, and mold remediation standard of care.

title: Prohibiting cameras and recording devices in bedrooms and bathrooms of foster children
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit cameras in bedrooms and bathrooms of foster homes and provide for exemptions.

title: Prohibit municipalities from collecting B&O taxes on projects that are funded by state or federal government programs
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit municipalities from collecting business and occupation taxes on projects that are funded by state or federal government programs.

title: Relating to necessity allowance
description: The purpose of this bill is to set forth requirements for foster child clothing allowances.

title: To create a new hunting license stamp for upland game birds
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "upland game bird" stamp to be administered by the West Virginia Division of Natural Resources.

title: Relating to permitting persons to refuse to participate in a irreversible transition surgery
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the requiring of the performance or assistance of an irreversible gender reassignment surgery.

title: Modifying the time to terminate a foster care arrangement
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the time to terminate a foster care arrangement.

title: Establishing pilot program for Public Guardian Ad Litem Services
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a three-year pilot program named the West Virginia Public Guardian ad Litem Services Pilot Program to provide legal representation for children under a framework similar to the West Virginia Public Defender Services.

title: Exempt an existing hospital under certificate of need to move their facility up to 10 miles to a new location
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize a licensed health care facility to move locations, up to 10 miles from the original location, without obtaining a new license.

title: Relating generally to allowing the Supreme Court of Appeals discretion to create uniform pay scales for all levels of judicial support staff.
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow the Supreme Court of Appeals to create pay scales for judicial support staff. This change will encourage employee recruitment and retention efforts and provide more clarity and consistency in pay structure based on job duties and educational requirements.

title: County solid waste assessment fees authorized
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the county solid waste assessment fees by 50 cents per ton.

title: Relating generally to the Municipal Bond Commission governance
description: The purpose of this bill is to change how the Municipal Bond Commission is governed.

title: Establishing a program for camera assisted speed enforcement in active work zones on public highways
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a program for camera assisted speed enforcement in active work zones in this state to be implemented by the West Virginia Division of Highways in cooperation with certified law enforcement agencies.

title: Relating to concurrent juvenile jurisdiction on military installations
description: The purpose of this bill is to address concurrent juvenile jurisdiction and to allow the transfer of exclusive federal legislative jurisdiction back to the state with respect to juveniles.

title: Relating to accessories to a crime
description: The purpose of this bill is to change certain offenses and penalties therefor for certain persons who are accessories to a crime. The bill provides that a domestic partner to a felony offender may not be considered an accessory after the fact; removes prohibition that a servant of a felony offender may not be considered an accessory after the fact; providing that an accessory to a felony who is the brother or sister, parent or grandparent, or child or grandchild of the principal offender is guilty of a misdemeanor; providing that an accessory to a misdemeanor is a misdemeanor.

title: Relating to military interpersonal violence
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that military protection orders may be considered as evidence of need for an emergency protective order or personal safety order and to require law enforcement to make certain notifications when arresting someone who has a military protective order entered against them in the Federal Bureau of Investigation's National Crime Information Center database.

title: Allowing for surplus money collected above voter approved excess levy requests to remain with specific county and placed in general fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow a county to retain and use any surplus amounts when that county approves a special excess levy.

title: Relating to military connected students
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide military connected students access to education and relates to advance enrollment, rights of those students, and teacher and student support.

title: Sales Tax Exemption for Certain Hygiene and Infant Products
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt from sales tax certain infant products and hygiene products.

title: Allowing the concealed carry of firearms on and in Capitol grounds
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the West Virginia code to allow concealed carry on and in Capitol grounds.

title: Relating to legalizing cannabis production, sales and adult consumption
description: The purpose of this bill is to legalize the personal use and possession of cannabis by adults; providing for a county option election to allow for the production and sales in that county; providing for regulation by the Bureau of Health; authorizing an excise and local sales tax on cannabis; prohibiting underage use; and preserving current laws relating to allowing employers and property owners to prohibit use or possession.

title: Permit teachers in K-12 schools be authorized to carry concealed firearms as a designated school protection officer
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize teachers in elementary or secondary schools to carry concealed firearms and be designated as a school protection officer (SPO).

title: To implement a Property Tax Poverty Exemption - School Excess Levy
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow an exemption from payment of a school excess levy to an owner of a residence whose annual household income is at or below the latest federal poverty guidelines

title: Relating to Off Duty LEO and LEOSA Exemptions
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the carrying a of a concealed handgun by off duty or retired law-enforcement officers; to authorize off duty or retired law-enforcement officers to conceal carry on and in the State Capitol Complex; and to define terms.

title: To require the Bureau for Social Services to file the Social Services Manual as a legislative rule
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Bureau for Social Services to file the Social Services Manual as a legislative rule. All subsequent revisions shall be filed as a legislative rule.

title: Say No to Good Old Boy Governance
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit elected officials to any state of local office, from appointing any family member to any West Virginia state or local office. Defining "family member" as wife, ex-wife, father, mother, son, daughter, grandchild, brother, sister, aunt, uncle, niece, or nephew; and designating this amendment as the "Say No to Good Old Boy Governance"

title: Relating to eligibility for workers' compensation benefits by requiring blood test after traumatic injury to determine intoxication
description: The purpose of this bill is to require blood tests of persons being treated for a traumatic personal injury in the course of and resulting from the person's employment to determine whether or not the person is intoxicated.

title: Increasing circumstances where the Department of Human Services is required to seek termination of parental rights
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand circumstances where the Department of Human Services is required to seek termination of parental rights.

title: To enable the Public Service Commission to authorize accelerated rate recovery for advanced transmission technology projects
description: The purpose of this bill is to enable the PSC to authorize accelerated rate recovery for advanced transmission technology projects.

title: B&O Tax Reform
description: The purpose of this bill is to protect small businesses from excessive paperwork and compliance burdens, encourage economic development in both incorporated and unincorporated areas, align tax responsibility with actual presence and infrastructure usage, and modernize West Virginia's tax policy in a way that supports fairness, growth, and simplicity.

title: Relating to disaffiliation from certain conferences
description: The purpose of this bill is to regulate property distribution in cases of local charities disaffiliating from national or regional conferences, denominations, or chapters.

title: Require collection agencies to provide a 30 day notice prior to wage garnishments.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require collection agencies to notify debtors of wage garnishments 30 days prior to that action by certified mail.

title: West Virginia Clean Air in Schools Act of 2026
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia Clean Air in Schools Act of 2026.

title: Providing for temporary suspension of medical power of attorney in certain instances
description: The purpose of this bill is to suspend any medical power of attorney in place for a vulnerable adult when an adult protective services investigation is ongoing and to fully invalidate the medical power of attorney if abuse is substantiated by a court

title: Cap a utility provider’s rates increases at no more than 5% per year
description: The purpose of this bill is to cap any proposed rate increases by public utilities at the amount of 5% per year.

title: Remove age limitations for fire service
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove age limitations for persons employed for fire fighting services.

title: Relating to information submitted by medical examiner to aid in identification of human remains
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the language stating the manner in which information is provided by the Medical Examiner to identify human remains.

title: Creating a special revenue account to expand in-state residential treatment capacity for children
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a special revenue account, the Residential Treatment Capacity Expansion Fund, to support the recruitment, development, and expansion of in-state residential treatment providers for children. The fund may be used for provider incentives, facility development, transition services for children currently placed out of state, and other activities that increase West Virginia's residential treatment capacity.

title: Relating to requiring the Public Service Commission to prepare and submit a report to the Governor and the Joint Committee on Government and Finance including the effects of a performance-based rate making system on West Virginia regulated utilities and rates charged to ratepayers
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Public Service Commission to prepare and submit a report to the Governor and the Joint Committee on Government and Finance relating to the effects of a performance-based rate making system on West Virginia regulated utilities and rates charged to ratepayers.

title: Relating to the temporary payment to a kinship parent of a subsidy equal to that of a foster parent
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that a kinship parent be paid a subsidy equal to that of a foster parent in specified circumstances and set forth the timeframe for such payment.

title: Relating to the imposition of a time limitation on disposition decisions in child abuse and neglect proceedings
description: The purpose of this bill is to impose a deadline for disposition decisions in child abuse and neglect cases to 12 months from the ratification of the initial petition.

title: Banning certain dyes from pharmaceutical products
description: The purpose of this bill is to ban certain dyes from pharmaceutical products.

title: Requiring the development and implementation of statewide prevention plan
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Department of Human Services to develop and implement a prevention plan.

title: The purpose of this bill is to require the Department of Human Services to publicly release a schedule of all adoption subsidy payments to be made in the next year.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Department of Human Services to publicly release a schedule of all adoption subsidy payments to be made in the next year.

title: Relating to investigations of allegations of child safety violations for school personnel.
description: The purpose of this bill is to continue investigations of allegations that school personnel have jeopardized the health, safety, or welfare of a student after the school personnel obtains another job or transfers to another school.

title: Prevent credit card surcharge from including sales tax
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove sales tax from being included in the electronic payment surcharge computation and creating a civil penalty.

title: Relating to privilege tax on holding a license to operate interactive wagering
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the percentage amount for the privilege of holding a license to operate interactive wagering.

title: Relating to privilege tax on holding a license to operate sports wagering
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the percentage amount for the privilege of holding a license to operate sports wagering.

title: Relating to disabled veteran taxpayers
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the definition of a disabled veteran taxpayer.

title: All relating generally to procurement by state spending units and local fiscal bodies of technology and technical infrastructure products and services
description: The purpose of this bill is to streamline procurement by state spending units, so that West Virginia can move to the forefront of government innovation, improve citizen services, and reduce government inefficiency.

title: To modify the calculation of the taxable wage base.
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the calculation of the taxable wage base.

title: Relating to school protection officers
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the appointment, qualifications, certification, authority, compensation, and training of school protection officers by a sheriff, and to provide for limitations on the civil liability of school protection officers in certain circumstances.

title: West Virginia Homeless Shelter Oversight & Safety Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to place homeless shelters under the same enforcement, inspection, and safety requirements as other regulated residential facilities.

title: Increase the allowance for volunteer and part-volunteer fire companies and allowing fire departments to make an expenditure for educational and training supplies and fire prevention promotional materials
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the allowance for volunteer and part-volunteer fire companies and departments to make an expenditure for educational and training supplies and fire prevention promotional materials from $500 to $5,000 per year.

title: Expanding the reasons that an executive director may create, merge, or dissolve a public defender corporation
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the creation of a second public defender corporation when a public defender corporation employs six or more assistant public defenders inclusive of the chief public defender.

title: Relating to formerly incarcerated individuals voting rights
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate restrictions to voting rights following an individual's release from incarceration through pardon, probation, parole, or completion of sentence.

title: Relating to loss of parental rights after a third petition for a child’s removal
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit the number of improvement periods a parent may have per child or actions in abuse and neglect proceedings.

title: To adjust the percent retained by the clerk of the county commission for funding election administration, infrastructure, and security, and other county clerk purposes
description: The purpose of this bill is to adjust the percentage of tax retained by the clerk of the county commission for certain purposes; and authorize the clerk to move funds between accounts with approval of the county commission.
