title: Two party consent for legislative offices
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the enforcement of two-party consent for legislative offices. The bill also provides an expectation of privacy in legislative offices.

title: Relating to special stops required for on-track equipment
description: The purpose of this bill is to define "on-track equipment"; and clarify provisions related to obedience to signal indicating approach of train.

title: To clarify what constitutes trespassing at an institution of higher education
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify what constitutes trespassing at an institution of higher education.

title: Require certain websites to utilize age verification methods to prevent minors from accessing content
description: The purpose of this bill is to create liability for publishers and distributors of sexual material harmful to minors, to provide definitions, to create a cause of action, and to provide for the administration, applicability, exceptions, and penalties for violation of the article.

title: Making syringe exchange service programs unlawful
description: The purpose of this bill is to make syringe services unlawful and provide for penalties for violation of the article. The proposed bill permits the provision of harm reduction services not associated with a syringe exchange program and permits an administrative timeframe for the transition of care. Requiring the Office for Health Facilities Licensure and Certification to seek penalties and the ability to seek injunctive relief for violations of the article.

title: Require registration of persons convicted of abuse
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify how those required to register sex offenders, who have no permanent residence, can satisfy their legal obligation and clarifying reporting obligations.

title: Creating crime of attempting to smuggle contraband into federal correctional institutions within the state
description: The purpose of this bill is to add federal correctional institutions to the list of correctional facilities in which is a criminal offense to deliver any thing unlawfully to a person in custody or confined therein.

title: Classifying forestry equipment for levy purposes
description: The purpose of this bill is to reclassify forestry equipment as Class I property to provide tax benefits to forestry businesses by acknowledging forestry as a part of agriculture.

title: Relating to polling locations
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the definition reference of "precinct" to "polling location".

title: Creating “The Tax Efficiency Act of 2026”
description: The purpose of this bill is to enact the Tax Efficiency Act of 2026, allowing municipal business and occupation or privilege taxes to be paid utilizing the statewide electronic data processing system network.

title: Requiring certain non-discretionary procedures be strictly complied with by the West Virginia Parkways Authority before tolls, rents, fees or charges may be increased
description: The purpose of this bill is to require certain non-discretionary procedures be strictly complied with by the West Virginia Parkways Authority before tolls, rents, fees or charges may be increased.

title: Relating generally to West Virginia Parkways Authority.
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the composition of the West Virginia Parkways Authority.

title: Providing guidelines for the West Virginia Parkways Authority to cease tolls on the West Virginia Turnpike upon completion of all bond payments
description: The purpose of this bill is to cease tolls on the West Virginia Turnpike upon completion of all bond payments.

title: To permit students in eighth and ninth grade to attend summer school in order to raise their grades and establish academic eligibility to participate in extracurricular activities in the fall
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit students in eighth and ninth grades to attend summer school in order to raise their grades and establish academic eligibility to play sports in the fall.

title: Eliminating specific statutory restrictions on outdoor advertisement
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate specific statutory restrictions on outdoor advertisement.

title: To allow landowners to pay hunters to hunt their property
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit landowners or lessees of land whose land is damaged by deer or other wildlife to hire a third party to kill the deer or other wildlife by bow and arrow.

title: To repeal the provision allowing for students to transfer from one school to another without losing eligibility.
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the section of code allowing for the athletic eligibility of transfer students.

title: Ensure State Road Construction Account funds are in addition to general highways funds provided to the DOT districts
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure that funding to counties named in this section from the State Road Construction Account does not affect any funding received by those counties from the State Road Fund.

title: Relating to “unencumbered” special revenue accounts to be surrendered to general revenue under certain circumstances
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the forfeiture of unencumbered funds in special revenue accounts and repayment of certain percentages of the special revenue accounts to the General Revenue Fund if these accounts have been inactive for designated periods. The bill also prohibits expenditures from these accounts pending the forfeiture of the funds.

title: Requiring 50 percent of all reappropriated revenue accounts to be surrendered to general revenue
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Treasurer to transfer 50 percent of the unencumbered balance of each reappropriated revenue account in the State Treasury to the General Fund, under certain circumstances

title: Create a prison work pilot program
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a Work/Incarceration Prison pilot program; to establish guidelines for eligibility; creates one prison; authorizes the Division of Corrections to propose rules; provides sentence reduction to an offender sentenced to the work/incarceration prison; provides that an offender who commits a violation of the rules be sent to a correctional facility and have an additional year added on to their original sentence; provides guideline for appropriation; allows offenders from other counties be accepted to the work/incarceration prison; and provides for an annual evaluation of the work/incarceration prison to be submitted to the Legislature.

title: Eliminating the authority of the West Virginia Parkways Authority to issue further parkway revenue, parkway revenue refunding, or special obligation bonds after July 1, 2025
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the authority of the West Virginia Parkways Authority to issue further parkway revenue, parkway revenue refunding, or special obligation bonds after July 1, 2026. The bill also provides that subsequent to that date, no new bonds may be issued.

title: Requiring the approval of the Legislature and the Governor before additional bonds may be issued by the Parkways Authority
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the approval of the Legislature and the Governor before additional bonds may be issued by the Parkways Authority; and requiring tolls to be removed six months following removal of encumbrances for the bonds.

title: Establishing certain tenant protections and landlord notice requirements at rental properties
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish certain tenant protections and landlord notice requirements at rental properties for house trailers, mobile homes, manufactured homes, and modular homes.

title: Prohibiting Human Smuggling and Trafficking
description: The purpose of this bill is to add a definition for "illegal alien" under human trafficking and provide that illegal aliens are not eligible for restitution.

title: Increasing penalties for Corruption
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the penalties for bribery and corrupt practices and to clarify when a person is disqualified from holding office.

title: Increasing the percentage of precincts to be audited during the election canvass
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the number of precincts to be audited by manual hand count to ensure accuracy of the electronically tabulated results and to lengthen the timeframe that candidates have to demand a recount to ensure sufficient time for the manual audit to be conducted and candidate opportunity to ascertain advisability of demanding a recount following the audit.

title: To require children interviewed by Child Protective Services have their interviews conducted at a child advocacy center
description: The purpose of this bill is to require all interviews of children for abuse and neglect investigations take place at Child Advocacy Centers.

title: To allow Gold Star parents to receive one free Gold Star vehicle registration for personal use.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for one free Gold Star Family license plate to a Gold Star parent.

title: Relating to Sexual Abuse Prevention Screening, Hiring and Dismissal Requirements
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish sexual abuse prevention screening, hiring, and dismissal requirements for all school employees and contractors who work at schools.

title: Creating a special court cost fee on certain criminal convictions dedicated to the emergency medical services equipment and training fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a court fee for all criminal violations to fund grants to equip and train emergency medical service providers and personnel; and to provide that local emergency medical service providers will receive grants on a 70%-30% matching basis, with the local provider providing 30% of the total funds.

title: Permitting law enforcement to issue a citation when students are caught with nicotine in schools.
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit law enforcement to issue a citation when a student enrolled in a public school or public charter school possesses nicotine in those schools.

title: To require anyone operating a vehicle that requires a CDL in WV to be able to read and speak the English language.
description: The purpose of this bill is to add the ability to read and speak English as a requirement to obtain a commercial driver's license in this state.

title: To require state employees making over $75,000 base salary are to become “at will employees of the state”, while all employees making under $75,000 base salary will have the rule of 80 retirement reinstated and accrued sick leave be used to extend service years upon retirement.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create exemptions for Tier II employees making less than $75,000 to use annual and sick leave upon retirement and be eligible for the Rule of 80 and to exempt employees making $75,000 or more from classified coverage.

title: Allow municipality to order suspension of driver’s license when defendant fails to pay traffic fine
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a person owing a judgment to a municipal court to pay, or enter into a payment plan, within 90 days of judgment. The bill further provides that a municipal court may request the DMV to suspend the driver's license of any person who fails to pay costs, fines, fees, and penalties owed within a specified timeframe.

title: Convention of states delegates have penalties for deviating from what they were sent to convention for
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish penalties for any delegate at a convention of states convention who deviates from his or her authority.

title: Relating to sales and service tax exemption for small arms and small arms accessories
description: The purpose of this bill is to reduce the cost of exercising the 2nd Amendment constitutional right.

title: Firefighter Pilot Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Fire Fighter Education pilot program which will be located in four counties that will provide Fire Fighter I and Fire Fighter II education to eligible students, including high school students.

title: Prohibiting the delivery of unsolicited absentee ballot applications to any person who has not specifically requested one from the county clerk
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the delivery of unsolicited absentee ballot applications to any person who has not specifically requested one from the county clerk.

title: Removing bona fide schools, public libraries, and museums from the list of exemptions from criminal liability relating to distribution and display to minor of obscene matter
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove schools, museums, and public libraries from the exemption which protects these types of entities from prosecution for distribution and display to minor of an obscene matter.

title: Permitting cameras in classrooms
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the use of cameras in classrooms.

title: Removing restrictions of taxpayers to access online curriculum, and allow for taxpayers to inspect additional instructional material adopted by the county board pursuant to including books in the classroom
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the restrictions of taxpayers to access online curriculum. The bill allows for any taxpayer to inspect additional instructional material adopted by the county board pursuant to including books in the classroom. Finally, the bill allows for any individual to file a complaint.

title: Relating to establishing the Veteran Justice Act allowing conditional opportunity for veterans to avoid a record conviction
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Veteran Justice Act.

title: To remove Mortmain restrictions on religious organizations
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove "Mortmain" restrictions on religious organizations.

title: Regarding Teacher Pay
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the pay of teachers from 35 years of experience to 45 years of experience.

title: To double the homestead tax exemption
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the Homestead Property Tax Exemption from $20,000 to $40,000.

title: Relating to taxation
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a phased in increase in the homestead exemption; provide that change to exemption contingent on passage of constitutional amendment; remove cap on property tax books, and repeal limitation on levy rates when appraisal results in tax increase.

title: Relating to clarification of a law enforcement agency and cooperation between law enforcement agencies and personnel of states bordering this state
description: The purpose of this bill is to grant additional local and state law enforcement privileges to commissioned law enforcement officers of the National Park Service.

title: Permitting voters not affiliated with a major political party to vote the ballot of that political party in a primary election.
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit voters not affiliated with a major political party to vote one ballot of any political party in a primary election.

title: Creating Substance Abuse Intervention Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Substance Abuse Intervention Act. The bill provides for a short title. The bill provides for involuntary treatment for a substance use disorder and sets forth the rights of a patient. The bill establishes criteria for involuntary treatment. The bill creates a petition for 60-day and 360-day involuntary treatment and a guarantee for costs. The bill provides for proceedings for involuntary treatment, describes the duties of court, and disposition. The bill sets forth a 72-hour emergency involuntary treatment. The bill describes the failure to attend examination, sets forth a summons, and describes transportation to hospital or psychiatric facility. This bill shall be known as "Joel's Law."

title: Relating to Kratom
description: The purpose of this bill is to make kratom a Schedule I controlled substance.

title: Relating to balancing urban and rural sewage treatment needs
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend the requirements for mandatory connections to public sewer systems in both municipalities and public service districts by providing exceptions for properties with functional septic systems in rural or less densely populated areas, while allowing mandatory connections in urban or densely populated areas where septic systems are impractical. It provides an exemption if the connection distance exceeds 200 feet, incorporates objective inspection standards from the National Association of Wastewater Technicians (NAWT), extends the notice period for non-connection penalties to 90 days, removes the ability to bill for sewer services not provided, and provides for financial assistance to homeowners on fixed or limited incomes who are required to connect, citing changes to Â§8-18-22 and Â§16-13A-9 to add provisos for exceptions and assistance.

title: Establishing limitations on billing practices of Internet or telecommunications providers that fail to provide subscribed customers service for five or more days
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure that a consumer is not required to pay for service outages caused by the provider when he or she did not receive services.

title: Prohibition on cell-cultured products
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the sale of cell-cultured food products.

title: Relating to the Board of Sanitarians
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify rules related to the Board of Sanitarians.

title: Relating generally to Underground Facilities Damage prevention
description: The purpose of this bill generally relates to Underground Facilities Damage prevention.

title: Regarding Substitute Teacher Pay
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the pay of substitute teachers to be the same as a full time teacher.

title: Extend the public intoxication of alcohol code to include being under the impairment of narcotics in public
description: The purpose of this bill is to make it a misdemeanor to being under the impairment of narcotics in public; and providing for criminal penalties and education upon conviction thereof.

title: Relating to maternity leave for school employees
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit pregnant women and mothers of newborn children who are employees of a public school system in this state to utilize the sick leave bank.

title: Relating to confidentiality of court files and law-enforcement records
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal certain provisions of code relating to confidentiality of court files and law-enforcement records.

title: Establish residency requirements for county surveyor be a resident of the state and provide exemption for holding more than one office.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require county surveyors to be state residents and create an exemption to run for more than one county..

title: Relating to requiring election officials to capture and publish ballot images, and provide voters with the ability to affix a unique mark on their ballot to identify and verify their ballot cast in a statewide election in West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill is to preserve ballot images and cast vote records on the Secretary of State website which will allow a near 100% verification of cast vote tabulation by citizens and election officials and provide voters with the ability to anonymously identify and verify their ballot cast in a statewide election in West Virginia.

title: Approved sewage systems for rental property
description: The purpose of this bill is to require approved sewage systems for all rental properties.

title: Clarifying that commercial real property insurance policies may be underwritten for less than replacement cost value of the insured property
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that insurance policies covering commercial or industrial real property may be underwritten for any amount agreed-upon by the parties, even if that amount is less than the replacement cost value.

title: Relating to the West Virginia Supreme Court’s power to promulgate rules allowing for the limited practice of law by nonlawyers
description: The purpose of this bill is to enumerate the West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals capacity to create rules regarding the scope of practice in the state of West Virginia while creating a task force to encourage the West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals to create rules allowing nonlawyers the ability to practice law under a limited license.

title: Extending the Alzheimer’s Disease and Other Dementia Advisory Council sunset date.
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend the Alzheimer's Disease and Other Dementia Advisory Council sunset date.

title: Disaster Recovery Acceleration Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the creation of the Disaster Recovery Acceleration Act.

title: To provide for currency rounding on monetary transactions
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Common Cents Act.

title: To give the Secretary of State authority to refer allegations of violations of election laws to West Virginia Prosecuting Attorneys Institute.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide the Attorney General with prosecutorial power over county and municipal elected officials in certain circumstances The bill also requires the Secretary of State to refer potential election fraud to the Attorney General for prosecution instead of a county prosecuting attorney.

title: Relating to racing facilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to create immunity for racing facilities from certain liability.

title: Timber Innovation and Manufacturing Boost for Economic Revitalization Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide tax credits to encourage in-state production of value-added forest products.

title: Relating to Access Management and Entrances to State Highways
description: The purpose of this bill is to creating standards in determining a change of use of existing entrances.

title: WV Load Forecast Accountability Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to enhance transparency and accuracy in electric load forecasting by providing the Public Service Commission with specific oversight responsibilities regarding submissions to PJM.

title: Updating the state tax rates relating to e-cigarettes, e-cigarette liquids, vapor products, vaping systems, and components or accessories for such devices, increasing penalties for violations
description: The purpose of this bill is to update the state tax rates on e-cigarettes, e-cigarette liquids, and components or accessories for such devices and increasing penalties.

title: Relating to funeral service licensure and administration
description: The purpose of this bill is to modernize funeral service licensure and administration; clarify definitions and credentials; update apprenticeship and continuing-education standards; and provide for rulemaking and transitional provisions.

title: To expand each county commission’s ability to sell or lease property.
description: To allow county commissions to have the same flexibility to sell or lease property as municipalities

title: Allow education employees to donate sick leave to co-workers for maternity leave
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow educators in the public school system or in the higher education system to donate leave to employees who use maternity leave. The bill defines maternity leave. Finally, the bill sets forth the process for the leave transfer.

title: Establish fines for any company or organization that knowingly hires an illegal alien
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish stricter penalties for any company or organization that knowingly hires an illegal alien.

title: Allow for monthly payments on property taxes
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow for monthly payments on current real and personal property taxes.

title: To reduce West Virginia sales tax on gasoline and diesel to zero, and make up difference with increase in sales tax equivalent to rate of tax
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the motor fuel excise tax and to replace any income from the tax with an equivalent increase in the state sales tax.

title: Authorizing the DMV to issue certain vital records in the custody of the state registrar
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide the authority to the Commissioner of the Division of Motor Vehicles to issue certain vital records subject to the rules and regulations of the State Registrar, to allow the DMV to collect fees for issuing vital records that will be provided to the State Registrar, and for the Commissioners of the DMV and DH Department of Health to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding to implement a program that allows the DH Department of Health to provide access to certain vital records to the DMV.

title: Relating to certification by the Public Service Commission of advanced small modular and micro nuclear reactors
description: The purpose of this bill relates to certification by the Public Service Commission of advanced small modular and micro nuclear reactors.

title: Limiting broker deposits to $500
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the maximum amount of broker deposits.

title: The West Virginia Real Estate Wholesaling Accountability Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Abolishment of Wholesaling Act, providing definitions; abolishing and prohibiting wholesaling; providing exceptions; and providing remedies and civil penalty.

title: Providing an exemption for a non-resident landowner, their spouse and their children from the requirement of purchasing a non-resident hunting hicense while hunting on their land in this state.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide an exemption for a non-resident landowner, their spouse and their children from the requirement of purchasing a non-resident hunting license while hunting on their land in this state.

title: To allow municipalities to regulate sober living housing in the cities
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide municipalities with the authority to regulate sober living housing within the cities, require that applications must be submitted and approved by the city prior to the facility commencing its operations, granting the municipalities the right to waive or require voluntary certification, and granting municipalities the right to require renewals and inspections of sober living facilities.

title: To force any media/internet creator providing artificial intelligence created videos to have an identifying marker that allows viewers to know that the video is not real.
description: The purpose of this bill is to protect West Virginians by requiring artificial intelligence created media to be disclosed.

title: To not entitle WV students to get aid from any WV schools unless they pass a college qualification exam in the 10th grade
description: The purpose of this bill is to require tenth grade students to pass a college preparedness exam to qualify for public financial aid for colleges and universities.

title: Relating to clarifying the Right to Farm Act relating to residential agricultural operations and the protection of agriculture through Urban Beekeeping
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the Right to Farm Act and the intent of the legislature to promote agriculture through agricultural businesses, promote the health of West Virginians and the West Virginia economy, and promote the protection of West Virginia agriculture through urban horticulture and beekeeping.

title: Relating to eminent domain compensation
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for enhanced compensation for property owners that is equal to twice the fair market value of the property taken, plus damages to any remaining property; and providing for how the enhanced compensation is determined.

title: Permitting the Berkeley County Commission to levy a special district excise tax for the benefit of the Berkeley County Economic Opportunity Development District under certain conditions.
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the Berkeley County Commission to levy a special district excise tax for the benefit of the Berkeley County Economic Opportunity Development District.

title: Relating to Dietitian Licensure Compact
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the joining of the Dietitian Licensure Compact Commission by the state of West Virginia.

title: Create license plate for autism awareness
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the Division of Motor Vehicles to issue special registration plates for autism awareness.

title: Prohibiting driving slow in left lane except under certain circumstances
description: The purpose of this bill is to require operators of vehicles to drive in rightmost portion or lane of roads or highways.

title: Relating to rules for hunting antlered deer
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Director of the Division of Natural Resources to propose rules for hunting antlered deer.

title: Requiring each county school board to employ at least one full time school nurse
description: The purpose of this bill is to require county boards to employ at least one full time nurse for each public school.

title: Allowing members of State Police retirement system to use accrued leave as credit towards retirement
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow members of the West Virginia State Police Retirement System to use accrued leave to acquire additional credited service toward retirement.

title: Relating to allowing a personal income tax exemption for First Responders
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt, from state income tax, salaries of law- enforcement officers, firefighters, EMS workers, and correctional officers.

title: Public Utility Stability Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Public Utility Stability Act, which will set appropriate time frames and procedures for rate increases for water and sewerage utilities.

title: Relating to restoring local jurisdiction to state political subdivisions over certain electric power facilities.
description: The purpose of this bill is to restore local government legal jurisdiction over micro-grid districts and certified high impact data centers.

title: Prohibit the requirement of a COVID-19 vaccination as a prerequisite for any state funded program or activity
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate compulsory COVID-19 vaccinations for participation or employment in any organization that receives state dollars.

title: To require drug testing of foster parents prior to child placement.
description: The purpose of this bill relates to establishing a drug testing program for adults who apply to serve as foster parents, kinship parents, or caregivers to displaced children in the legal custody of the Department of Human Services.

title: Requiring child protective services (“CPS”) workers to record, via audio, all interactions during CPS visits.
description: The purpose of this bill is to mandate audio recording during child protective services investigations and interactions during visits.

title: Authorizing adjustment from federal adjusted gross income for certain law enforcement pension benefit payments
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a pension benefits exemption from income taxation to Division of Natural Resources police, deputy sheriffs, full-time firefighters, and municipal police officers.

title: Modify determination of high 3 years for Sheriff’s Retirement System
description: The purpose of this bill is to compute the final average salary of a member of the West Virginia Deputy Sheriff Retirement Fund based on the average of the highest annual compensation received for covered employment by the member in any three plan years within the member's last 10 years of service. Current law is based on five consecutive year.

title: To remedy an issue relating to the disaffiliation from religious denominations whilst retaining church property
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide provisions for the disaffiliation from religious denominations and the retention and division of property upon disaffiliation.

title: Enacting Water Quality Improvement Programs In Counties By Conservation Districts
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit a conservation district board to partially reimburse services to septic systems in their district.

title: To maximize the utility and accessibility of West Virginia’s child care tax credit for employers
description: The purpose of this bill is to maximize utility and accessibility of West Virginia's child care tax credit for employers.

title: Require DMV and Parkways Auhority to coordinate records for plate transfers
description: The purpose of this bill is to streamline the process of updating a driver's information when getting a new vehicle and using EZ-Pass.

title: Require full cash bail for offenders who are rearrested for certain crimes while out on bond and enhanced criminal penalties
description: The purpose of this bill is to require cash bail for violent or gun-related criminal offenses and to provide for consecutive sentencing for crimes committed while on bail for violent or gun-related criminal offenses.

title: Provide 25% Discount to WV Residents using State Parks
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide West Virginia residents with a discount for lodging and services at West Virginia State Parks.

title: State to reimburse county for inmate costs when conviction results in credit for time served
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the state to reimburse a county for inmate costs when a conviction of an inmate results in credit for time served towards any sentence imposed.

title: Banning Foreign-backed spending on State Ballot Issues
description: The purpose of this bill is to ban foreign backed spending on state ballot issues.

title: To move the election of Supreme Court Justices to the general election
description: The purpose of this bill is to move the election of Supreme Court justices to the general election rather than the primary election.

title: Relating to prohibitions on contracting with companies that boycott Israel
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that the prohibitions on contracting with companies that boycott Israel in the section apply to exempt agencies.

title: To change the election dates for intermediate court of appeals judges to the genreal elections
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the date for election of judges of the Intermediate Court of Appeals to the same date as the general election.

title: Provisions for election observers during any election and at any voting or ballot-reviewing and ballot-counting location within West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a procedure for election observers during any election and at any voting or ballot-reviewing and ballot-counting location within this state.

title: Allow DMV to accept auto-renewals for vehicle registration
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Division of Motor Vehicles to establish an automatic renewal system with automatic billing for the renewals of motor vehicle registrations.

title: Regarding release of juvenile following assault of law enforcement or first responder
description: The purpose of this bill is to strengthen penalties of juveniles accused of assault on a law enforcement officer, reserve deputy, court security officer, or first responder.

title: Relating to requiring local governments to provide matching funds for grants from the Reclamation of Abandoned and Dilapidated Properties Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to require local governments to provide matching funds for grants from the Reclamation of Abandoned and Dilapidated Properties Program unless demonstrated to be fiscally unable; and to require that fines assessed by local governments related to abandoned and dilapidated property be committed to the matching of Reclamation of Abandoned and Dilapidated Properties Program grants or to the demolition of condemned properties.

title: Creating Retail Impact Intersection Improvement Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to improve traffic intersections impacted by high-impact retail operations.

title: Issuing identification documents to homeless individuals residing at homeless shelters
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Division of Motor Vehicles to provide certain identification documents to homeless individuals who are U.S. Citizens, residing at homeless shelters within this state, at no cost.

title: Providing identification documents to homeless youth
description: Providing identification documents to homeless youth

title: Including Potomac State College in the definition of community and technical college education program for participation in the “Learn and Earn Program”
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a program to include Potomac State College of West Virginia as an eligible institution for permanent participation in the "Learn and Earn Program". The bill removes reference to the program being a "pilot" program.

title: To ensure false claims on property titles are not fault of landowner
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Title Protection Act. The bill provides for legislative findings. The bill ensures that rightful property owners retain any and all titles to their property in the event that fraudulent or wrongful claims are listed against their property. The bill provides a mechanism for county clerks to provide notice to rightful landowners when property is transferred, or when titles are filed or modified against their property.

title: Provide certain classes of property protections from creditor collections
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide certain classes of assets exempt from collection, judgment, or garnishment for default of any consumer credit or installment obligation.

title: Allow students who enroll and successfully complete a driver’s education course to waive testing at the DMV
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow students who enroll and successfully complete a driver's education course to receive a certificate which the DMV will accept in lieu of being tested at the DMV.

title: Requiring municipalities take action when potential customers apply for water and sewer service.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require municipalities and public service districts to determine the cost of adding potential customers to water service from the municipality and public service districts, apply through the West Virginia Infrastructure and Jobs Development Council for available funding, and to extend service to potential customers who have made required deposits if a grant or grants are awarded to cover the fees for the service extension.

title: Regarding fines in DOH work zones
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the use of photographic, video, or digital equipment to enforce speed limits in Division of Highways work zones

title: Requiring health insurers provide price information to consumers timely prior to rate change
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide policyholders notice of upcoming rate changes in their policies and establish when rate changes can take effect.

title: To require municipalities issuing tickets to charge the entire fee for tickets
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the suspension of licenses for failure to respond or appear in court when charged with a motor vehicle violation. The bill requires written notice of all fees owed and impending suspension prior to license suspension; and requires the citation issuing magistrate court or municipal court to forward administrative fee collected to division.

title: To require DOH, when abandoning a right of way, to notify the legislative representatives in the county or counties in which this right of way is located via email and first class mail in addition to publication in the newspaper
description: The purpose of this bill is to require notice from the Commissioner of Highways of the discontinuance, vacation, abandonment, or closure of any road or highway be published as a Class I legal advertisement and shall also notify members of the Legislature who represent the area in which the road or highway is located of the proceedings.

title: To extend conditional protection to employees of private child welfare agency or provider
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend conditional protection to employees of private child welfare agency or provider.

title: Prohibit certain individuals from living within 5,000 feet of a school or daycare
description: Prohibit certain individuals from living within 5,000 feet of a school or daycare

title: To create a homeless education coordinator in urban and rural counties.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a homeless education coordinator in urban and rural counties.

title: To require the Department of Human Services to provide child welfare workers with mobile technology that will permit them to conduct investigations and create a digital record.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Department of Human Services to provide child welfare workers with mobile technology that will permit them to conduct investigations and create a digital record.

title: Providing for biennial reporting instead of annual reporting for business organizations.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require biennial reports for limited liability and foreign limited liability companies.

title: To remove barriers to voting for persons with disabilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove voting barriers for disabled voters.

title: WV building and constructions trades code enforcement West Virginia First
description: The purpose of this bill relates to putting West Virginia first. The bill requires employers that receive a local labor utilization waiver to hire at the same qualifications and rates provided to Workforce WorkForce West Virginia; clarifies West Virginia Jobs Act applicability to all public improvement construction projects including West Virginia Development Authority pilot projects; and requires that Division of Labor establish a public database of records from employers performing work on public improvement contracts.

title: Local Government Freedom Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide political subdivisions the authority to hire the lowest responsible bidder enter into project labor agreements.

title: To require the state and/or its agents to provide their appraisal to landowners involved in eminent domain
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the State of West Virginia, or any agency or political subdivision, to provide appraisals to landowners when involved in eminent domain negotiations.

title: West Virginia Safe Trucking Act 2026
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Safe Trucking Act of 2026.

title: Relating to the law-enforcement powers of correctional officers
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the law-enforcement authority of correctional officers of the Division of Corrections and Rehabilitation.

title: To create a tuition reimbursement program for Corrections employees.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a tuition reimbursement for corrections workers in this state.

title: Creating Persons with Disabilities Registry
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a Persons with Disabilities Registry; and provide for a public records exemption.

title: Eliminate sales tax on tax preparation services
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt tax preparation services from consumer sales and service tax.

title: Eliminate net metering in WV
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate net metering of public utilities.

title: To create the felony offense for protestors blocking passage on streets and highways.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the criminal offense of obstructing a highway or other passageway; defining "obstruct"; and establishing penalties for violation of section.

title: Create mechanism for towing companies in WV to quickly access owner information.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide tow companies access to driver registration information on demand and at any hour.

title: To eliminate the restriction of hunting bears over bait
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the restriction on bear kills, when deer baiting is used during concurrent deer and bear hunting season.

title: Move marina gas tax proceeds to DNR Law enforcement division
description: The purpose of this bill is to have the proceeds of fuel purchased at marinas and boat docks in this state be directed to the West Virginia Division of Natural Resources Law Enforcement Division.

title: Clarifying the sheriff’s authority to hire within their office.
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify a sheriff's authority to hire within their own office.

title: Change required service from 25 to 20 years for eligibility for minimum 1k retirement annuity
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the eligibility age for certain retirement benefits within the Public Employees Retirement System and the State Teachers Retirement System.

title: Require EZ Pass transponder be registered to person, not vehicle
description: The purpose of this bill is to require EZ-Passes to be assigned to individual drivers and not automobiles.

title: Increasing the Homestead Property Tax Exemption
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the Homestead Property Tax Exemption from $20,000 to $40,000.

title: Exempt those with 25 years holding an insurance license from attaining additional CEUs
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt persons who have held an insurance license for 20 years or more from the requirement to attend continuing education courses.

title: Increasing penalties for hit and run offenses
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the penalties for hit and run offenses.

title: To require that all in person and online Vape and vape products require an ID scan, similarly to prescription controlled substances and certain cold medicines.
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the sale of vapes and vape products to underage children.

title: Clarifying abuse of process
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit service of process in Family Court and civil actions.

title: Updating law regarding prior authorizations
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit prior authorization forms to be submitted via fax.

title: To make the posting of a summons in a conspicuous place on rental property acceptable service when a tenant is unavailable for personal service
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit service upon tenants for eviction proceedings to be accomplished by publication or by posting the notice conspicuously on the premises if the tenant will not accept service of process in person.

title: Taxpayer Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure individual taxpayers are not misclassified.

title: Rural School Flexibility & Innovation Pilot Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Rural School Flexibility & Innovation Pilot Act.

title: Foster Youth Post-Secondary Transition Awareness Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure West Virginia students with current or former foster care experience receive clear, consistent information about education, job training, housing, healthcare, and independent-living support before graduating high school.

title: Relating to providing for condition-based emergency funding for a financially distressed county.
description: Relating to providing for condition-based emergency funding for a financially distressed county.

title: Making Supplemental Appropriation to State Board of Education
description: Making Supplemental Appropriation to State Board of Education.

title: Relating to the makeup of the State Police Child Abuse and Neglect Investigations Unit
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide retired State Police officers the ability to be reemployed with the Child Abuse and Neglect Investigations Unit and update the makeup of the unit.

title: Relating to driver’s licenses
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a reciprocity agreement with the Republic of Ireland for driver licenses.

title: To provide more local control over educational decisionmaking, differentiation of funding for counties, and to address operational efficiencies within education.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide more local control over educational decisionmaking, differentiation of funding for counties, and to address operational efficiencies within education.

title: Relating to body-worn cameras
description: The purpose of this bill is to require local child protective workers to use body worn camera while conducting abuse and neglect investigations.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to the establishment of a pilot program for the use of mobile devices in child abuse and neglect investigations.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require pilot project to evaluate the effectiveness of the usage of a mobile device interface for CPS investigations, reporting is required. This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to monthly status meeting of county entities
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a structured monthly forum in each county to review the status of the Bureau of Social Services, address inter-agency concerns, and improve coordinated responses to child abuse and neglect.The bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Related to the authority of sheriff’s commission for collection of taxes
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the allowable commission for tax collection by the sheriff.

title: Victims of Communism Day
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish November 7 of each year as "Victims of Communism Day", to be observed in the public schools of this state.

title: Market pay for Teachers
description: The purpose of this bill is to enhance pay for teachers; provide for market pay enhancement for teacher salaries in certain circumstances; provide for certification to the State Auditor; set out distribution of funds; require reporting; make funds subject to personal income tax; providing funds are in excess of minimum salary schedule; make enhancement not subject to state grievance process; and provide for rulemaking.

title: Relating to the Volunteer Firefighter Tax Credit Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify eligibility for volunteer firefighters.

title: Relating to government procurement of electric vehicles
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit governmental entities and spending units of the state of West Virginia from procuring electric vehicles and prohibiting government contracts procuring electric vehicles that may have been made in whole or in part through forced labor; set remedies and penalties for manufacturers; and provide an effective date.

title: Prohibiting public funds from supporting low-earning outcome postsecondary degree programs
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit the degrees for which state funds can be used to obtain.

title: Relating to participating in the federal tax credit scholarship program
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the State Treasurer to participate in the federal tax credit scholarship program; and to identify qualified scholarship organizations and schools.

title: Clarifying that the time limitations provided for filing occupational pneumoconiosis claims do not apply or otherwise limit the ability of a claimant to obtain an evaluation from the Occupational Pneumoconiosis Board
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that the time limitations provided for filing occupational pneumoconiosis claims in this section does not apply to or otherwise limit the ability of a claimant to obtain an evaluation from the Occupational Pneumoconiosis Board.

title: Awarding attorneys fees to prevailing party in eminent domain proceeding
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit a prevailing private property owner in an eminent domain proceeding to recover reasonable costs and attorney's fees.

title: To recognize School Athletic Directors who have achieved a nationally recognized professional certification through the National Interscholastic Athletic Administrators Association (NIAAA).
description: The purpose of this bill is to recognize School Athletic Directors who have achieved a nationally recognized professional certification through the National Interscholastic Athletic Administrators Association (NIAAA).

title: Relating to college campus safety
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify school safety mapping data to include colleges and universities.

title: Allow for PE classes to be optional for students who can demonstrate 5 or more weekly hours of outside physical activity
description: The purpose of this bill is to require each child enrolled in the public schools of this state to actively participate in physical education classes during the school year to the level of his or her ability.

title: Reorganization of the Executive branch
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a single cabinet-level Department of Workforce Services consolidating employment, rehabilitation, adult literacy, and public assistance work requirements (including the 80-hour federal Medicaid mandate) into one body effective July 1, 2027.

title: Approving short-term training programs for eligibility for federal Workforce Pell Grants
description: The purpose of this bill is approval of short-term training programs for eligibility for federal Workforce Pell Grants.

title: Prohibiting subdivisions and local entities from adopting policies that prohibit or restrict cooperation with federal immigration law enforcement.
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit subdivisions and local entities from adopting policies that prohibit or restrict cooperation with federal immigration law enforcement.

title: Increasing Homestead Exemption
description: The purpose of this bill is to incrementally increase the homestead exemption over a period of time.

title: Change Audit Log for annual subscription with Secretary of State
description: The purpose of this bill is to update the voter list information for noncommercial use by requiring the inclusion of change audit data as part of the information provided in the voter lists for the election cycle subscription service.

title: Relating to the WV Cares background check variance process
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the West Virginia Clearance for Access: Registry and Employment Screening Act ("WV Cares") background check variance process.

title: Require all ballots for primary and general elections be received not later than the close of the polls on election day.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require absentee ballots mailed in to be received by 8:00 p.m. on the day of the election to be counted.

title: Relating to the Child Abuse and Neglect Investigations Unit
description: The purpose of this bill is to create an expanded WVSP Unit specifically utilized for investigation of child abuse and neglect cases.The bill has been recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to requiring the Department of Human Services to establish a pilot program to contract for supplemental caseworker aide services for the Bureau for Social Services
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a pilot program to support caseworker administrative tasks with technology and human caseworker aide services to increase the number, frequency and timeliness of caseworker interactions with children and families served by caseworkers within the Department of Human Services.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to the creation of the process of obtaining and adjudicating a pre-adjudicatory alternative disposition
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the process of obtaining and adjudicating a pre-adjudicatory alternative disposition.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to abuse and neglect cases
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase compensation of all panel attorneys and guardians ad litem. The bill also creates an assistant guardian ad litem position and outlines what language is required in juvenile abuse and neglect case orders.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to modifying the school aid formula to provide more support for schools under certain circumstances.
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the school aid formula to provide more support for schools under certain circumstances.

title: Relating to the meaning of residence for the purpose of bail
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that judicial officers consider the residency status of a person charged with a criminal violation in determining bail and conditions of pretrial release.

title: Relating to standards of private schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure equal treatment of private and parochial schools for school building construction.

title: School Board Election Date Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the creation of the School Board Election Date Act.

title: Allowing Magistrates under certain circumstances to be able to order a mental evaluation
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow magistrates, under certain circumstances, to order mental evaluations.

title: Safeguard the Right-To-Try Cutting-Edge Medicine Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit access to individualized treatments for eligible patients.

title: Creating the Hope to Help Community Schools Act of 2026.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the creation of the Hope to Help Community Schools Act of 2026.

title: Issuance of new DMV titles under certain requirment
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify conditions when the division shall issue a new title and provide circumstances which void title issued and initiate a legal investigation.

title: The State Resiliency Office
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the frequency that the State Resiliency Officer updates the Flood Resiliency Plan, add reporting requirements, and require the State Resiliency Officer to report to certain legislative committees.

title: Relating to statewide prevention plan.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Department of Human Services to develop and implement a prevention plan.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to public drinking water storage tanks
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Public Water Supply Reform Act of 2026. The bill provides for definitions. The bill creates a water level status plan for aboveground water storage tanks. The bill provides for transparency. Finally, the bill ensures public service district communication.

title: Relating to the imposition of a time limitation on disposition decisions in child abuse and neglect proceedings
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the court to issue a disposition decision within 12 months of ratification of the initial petition.The bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to requiring the Bureau of Social Service to file a legislative rule.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Bureau of Social Service to file its policy manual as a legislative rule.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to the temporary payment to a kinship parent of a subsidy equal to that of a foster parent.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that a kinship parent be paid a subsidy equal to that of a foster parent in specified circumstances and set forth the timeframe for such payment.The bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to the creation of a special revenue account to expand in-state residential treatment capacity for children
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a special revenue account, the Residential Treatment Capacity Expansion Fund, to support the recruitment, development, and expansion of in-state residential treatment providers for children. The fund may be used for provider incentives, facility development, transition services for children currently placed out of state, and other activities that increase West Virginia's residential treatment capacity.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to clothing and necessity allowance.
description: The purpose of this bill is to set forth requirements for foster child clothing allowances.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families,

title: Relating to requiring the circuit court to make certain designated findings of fact and conclusions of law in its juvenile child abuse and neglect orders
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend the West Virginia Code in relation to juvenile abuse and neglect proceedings to require that circuit courts make certain findings of fact and conclusions of law as it relates to the court's orders.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to the Office of the Inspector General
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the Office of the Inspector General from the Department of Health, where is it for administrative purposes, and to clarify that the Office of the Inspector General has the ability to conduct performance audits, financial audits, evaluations, and attestations engagements of the Department of Human Services, the Department of Health, and the Department of Health Facilities and their independent contractors.

title: Require counties and municipalities to provide public notice for land or building purchases
description: The purpose of this bill is to require counties and municipalities to provide public notice for land or building purchases.

title: To permit the county commission of each county to lease, rent or to permit the use of a county owned wireless tower or any portion thereof, with exceptions
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit county commissions to lease, rent, or permit the use of a county-owned wireless tower or any portions thereof, with exceptions.

title: Relating to quit claim deeds
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend the definitions section of the excise tax on property transfers to add and clarify exemptions and what is a "person".

title: Relating to the establishment of a grant program to fund the United States Food and Drug Administration’s drug development trials with ibogaine
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a grant program to fund the United States Food and Drug Administration's drug development trials with ibogaine for the purpose of securing the Administration's approval as a medication for treatment of opioid use disorder, co-occurring substance use disorder, and any other neurological or mental health conditions for which ibogaine demonstrates efficacy.

title: Mandate free cancer screenings for professional firefighters.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide free preventative cancer screening for professional firefighters.

title: Protecting Everyone from Excessive Police Surveillance (PEEPS) Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to protect citizens from databases created that reveal or contain information that can be used to reveal citizens' or vehicles' historical locations.

title: Relating to medical cessation treatment and research
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide exemptions for distribution to individuals between the ages of eighteen and twenty-one for the purpose of tobacco cessation and/or research in a sanctioned medically supervised program.

title: Pedophilia Prosecution Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove language limiting investigations to law enforcement officers.

title: Internet Reliability Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that Internet Service Providers, or "ISPs", shall be considered a telecommunications utility for regulatory purposes by the Public Service Commission.

title: Right to Keep Bees
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand the right to keep bees, place limitations on the inspection of apiaries by the Commissioner of Agriculture, and clarify the circumstances under which the Commissioner of Agriculture may quarantine the bees in an apiary.

title: Enrollment Stabilizer for Budget Planning
description: The purpose of this bill is provide an enrollment stabilizer mechanism in the Public School Support Program.

title: Support for neglected Schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the creation of the "Support for Neglected Schools Act."

title: To require Public Service Commission to hear requests for rate adjustments from public electrical utilities and issue a recommendation to legislature
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish certain requirements relating to requests for rate adjustments from public electric utilities; limiting the jurisdiction of the Public Service Commission over rate adjustment requests by public utilities to hearing the request and making recommendations to the Legislature; requiring electric utility rate adjustments be approved by the Legislature; and requiring electrical utilities which operate coal fired electrical generation facilities shall maintain an average minimum rate of generation

title: Change the title from Salesperson in State Code to Sales agent for thoses who sell real estate.
description: The purpose of this bill is to replace "salesperson" with "sales agent" in the real estate code.

title: Limit the time Teachers Aides can be pulled from their regular duties to 30 minutes per day.
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit how often a teacher's aide may be pulled from his or her regular, expected job duty.

title: Relating to registration of voters and voluntary registration of organ donors
description: The purpose of this bill is to include an option for persons to indicate their choice to become an organ donor when registering to vote or modifying their voter registration.

title: Repeal code relating to inspection of vehicles
description: The purpose of this bill is to is to repeal the article creating mandatory state inspections of motor vehicles.

title: Relating to drugs and adding a provision relating to the scheduling of crystalline polymorph psilocybin approved by the Food and Drug Administration
description: The purpose of this bill is to add crystalline polymorph psilocybin in the permitted list of distributed and prescribed drugs, if approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration and scheduled by the United States Drug Enforcement Administration.

title: Relating to codifying the guidelines for nutritionally adequate school breakfasts and lunches
description: The purpose of this bill is to codify the guidelines for nutritionally adequate school breakfasts and lunches within Title 7 of the Code of Federal Regulations, as well as the Dietary Guidelines for Americans.

title: Relating to establishing the West Virginia Clean Water Act of 2025
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia Clean Water Act of 2026 in order to enhance water quality standards, test for and remove various contaminants, and to replace lead service lines within all public water systems.

title: Relating to liability shield products
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish regulatory oversight for medical, pharmaceutical, biological, or technological liability shield products.

title: Require that County Superintendents of Schools for the Department of Education be West Virginia residents.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that county superintendents of schools be West Virginia residents.

title: Institue a 50% reduction in the property tax paid by childcare facilities.
description: The purpose of this bill is to reduce property taxes on day care facilities by 50 percent.

title: Remote Schools Support Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the creation of the Remote Schools Support Act.

title: Change the term of the office of sheriff from 4 years to 6 years
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the term of office of sheriff from four years to six years.

title: To ensure felonies or violent misdemeanors are not eligible for personal recognizance discharge from jail
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that persons accused of felonies or violent misdemeanors are required to post bond and are not entitled to release on their own recognizance. The bill also provides that the bail threshold for nonviolent felonies be increased and adjusted for inflation beginning July 1, 2026.

title: Amending the duties of a purchaser to secure a deed
description: The purpose of this bill is to amending duties of a purchaser of property sold by the Auditor for unpaid taxes to secure a deed to include the satisfaction of any municipal lien of record on the property.

title: Modifying the process by which a Defendant is entitled to a trial by jury in municipal court
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish that a defendant who may be fined $5,000 or more is entitled to a trial by jury.

title: Relating to unfair or unconscionable debt collection practices
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the collection of interest or attempts to collect any interest or other charge, fee or expense on a debt when that charge or expense is expressly authorized by either the agreement creating or modifying the obligation or by statute or regulation instead of requiring both the agreement and a statute tor regulation.

title: Exempts from local taxes and fees for a municipal Utility in which the members are elected
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt construction projects from local taxes and fees for a duly elected municipal utility board, its contractors, subcontractors, and vendors.

title: Changing rates of public utilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the Public Service Commission or any separate water or wastewater utility customers of a self-supporting entity such as a water system or a wastewater system from being subsidized or charged for the costs of the acquisition and/or construction, operation, maintenance, or repair of another non-related water or wastewater system and provide that a water system rates shall not include costs of another wastewater system.

title: To require that teachers in grades 7 through twelve, who teach classes with more than 30 students in their classes receive an additional $25 per day per student over the 30 student-limit, with exceptions for physical education, band, chorus, strings, theater, dance, and other classes aimed at artistic performance.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a pay increase for teachers who have more than 30 students in their classroom, and to provide for an exception.

title: Expand the grade level for Laken’s Law
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand "Laken's Law" or the instruction about fentanyl, heroin, and opioids awareness, prevention to grades 3-12.

title: Relating to chronic absenteeism
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove truancy as a status offense, shift the absenteeism focus from punitive to preventative, and clarify the statutory provisions and procedures for chronic absenteeism.

title: Allow the use of unused employee sick time in retirement calculation
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the use of accrued unused sick leave days credited toward retirement.

title: To add to the teacher pay scale the increments of Bachelor’s Plus 30 and Master’s Plus 60 and add that amount in the appropriate increment.
description: The purpose of this bill is to add to the teacher pay scale the increments of Bachelor's Plus 30 and Master's Plus 60.

title: Transfer oversight of childcare from the Department of Human Services to the Department of Education
description: The purpose of this bill is to transfer all childcare services from the Department of Human Services to West Virginia Department of Education. The bill provides for the implementation of Early Childhood Education Centers. The bill provides for funding. Finally, the bill provides for certification.

title: To move any remaining sixth grade classifications from elementary schools to middle schools.
description: The purpose of this bill is to reclassify sixth grade from elementary school to middle school.

title: Allowing death penalty for intentionally killing law-enforcement officer or first responder in line of duty
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the death penalty in limited circumstances; the bill provides for procedures and standards applicable thereto, and automatic review of the penalty, for commission of murder in the first degree. Procedures for carrying out the death sentence are established.

title: Creating additional sentences for convicted inmates who test positive for illegal substances or who are found to be in possession of illegal or controlled substances
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the offense of being in possession of drugs or testing positive for drug use while incarcerated, setting penalties for first, second, and subsequent offenses, and mandating testing after three months of incarceration for illegal drugs.

title: To repeal the requirement for a special license for a multi-vendor private fair and festival.
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the code section relating to special licenses for multi-vendor private fairs and festivals where multiple vendors share liability and responsibility.

title: Relating to increasing compensation for panel attorneys.
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase compensation for panel attorneys of the Public Defender Services; and requiring Public Defender Services to annually provide a report to certain state agencies summarizing legal services that are being provided by the submission of a voucher by panel attorneys serving as guardians ad litem in state courts. This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to pension income of retired law enforcement officers and first responders
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand the state's modifications for tax reducing federal adjusted gross income to retired out-of-state police, first responders, and other retirees who show the work they performed was in the capacity of Law Enforcement Officer, and/or a First Responder.

title: Require medical examiners to review medical and immunization records and document any immunizations or emergency countermeasures given within 90 days before their death
description: The purpose of this bill is to require medical examiners to review medical and immunization records and document any immunizations or emergency countermeasures given within 90 days before their death of any person under age 20 who died unexpectedly and includes penalties for medical examiners who fail to comply with these requirements.

title: relating to the practice of barbering and cosmetology
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that hair braiding and threading are not regulated by the West Virginia Board of Barbers and Cosmetologists, it further provides that blow-dry styling and makeup application are not regulated, and creates a salon training program allowing licensed salons to employ trainees to cut and color hair and, after 1,000 hours, sit for the hair styling exam.

title: To make any accident involving a driver that is driving on a revoked/suspended license or is driving while unlicensed is automatically at fault for the accident
description: The purpose of this bill is to hold people who drive illegally at fault when involved in an accident.

title: Disallowing flouride to be added to public water systems
description: The purpose of this bill is to disallow fluoride from being added to public water systems.

title: To create a pilot program that would exempt certain counties from provisions of the Education code.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for more special education personnel. The bill establishes the West Virginia Educational Freedom Pilot Act of 2026. The bill provides for a short title. The bill sets forth legislative findings. The bill provides for the enactment of the program. Finally, the bill provides for a reporting mechanism.

title: Relating to illegal immigrants
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the punishment of persons with illegal immigration status.

title: Relating to access to original birth certificates to adopted adults or their lineal descendants
description: The purpose of this bill relates to access to original birth certificates to adopted adults or their lineal descendants.

title: To make gold, silver, and crypto currency legal tender in WV
description: The purpose of this bill is to recognize gold and silver bullion and specie as legal tender in West Virginia, to authorize the West Virginia Bullion Depository, and to authorize the depository to issue transactional currency backed by gold and silver.

title: Relating to prohibiting the use or sale of abortifacients
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the use or sale of abortifacients and to enact criminal penalties and permit private causes of action for supplying abortifacients.

title: Relating to “Rain Tax”
