description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit any governmental entity from charging fees for stormwater, rain, or runoff from real property.

title: End open fields doctrine
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the open fields doctrine in this state.

title: To require a warrant for DNR officials or officers to enter onto any private property
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that a natural resources officer possess landowner consent or a warrant prior to entering private property and providing exceptions.

title: Relating to Constitutional Carry
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow those persons 18-20 years of age to be permitted to carry a deadly weapon, as those persons 21 and over are currently permitted to do.

title: To prohibit counties, towns and municipalities from using taxpayer dollars to hire lobbyists to represent them at the State level
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit counties, towns, and municipalities from using tax money to hire lobbyists to represent the counties, towns, and municipalities at state level.

title: Prohibit the shutdown of churches or places of worship
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure that protections are in place to protect religious services during a declared state of emergency by the Governor or other declarations by the executive branch that would impose restrictions upon such houses of worship.

title: To create state civil liability for pharmaceutical companies for vaccine injuries from the Covid 19 vaccines
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow for pharmaceutical companies to be held liable for injuries resulting from the Covid-19 vaccine.

title: Fourth Amendment Restoration Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit law-enforcement officers and political subdivision officials from utilizing, implementing, adopting, or continuing the use of certain specified surveillance and artificial intelligence technologies.

title: Prevent depletion of groundwater and aquifers
description: The purpose of this bill is to protect groundwater and aqueduct supplies from depletion by data center cooling uses.

title: Eliminate all state and county subsidies or tax breaks for solar compounds or wind compounds or other renewable energy corporations
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the tax credit for solar, wind, or other renewable energy systems for corporate or other entities. It also provides restrictions for maintaining renewable energy systems.

title: Relating to Capitol Carry
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the West Virginia Code to allow concealed carry on and in Capitol grounds.

title: Providing that a hunting license is only required for public land
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that a hunting license is only required for public land.

title: To create the State Bank of West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the State Bank of West Virginia as a state-managed depository for bullion and specie within the State Treasurer's office.

title: Eliminate the ban on baiting in all counties for all game animals
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the ban on baiting in all counties for game animals.

title: Relating to allowing localities contiguous to the border of West Virginia to join the state via local elections
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow admission as part of West Virginia, localities or territories that are contiguous to the borders of West Virginia.

title: To repeal obsolete and outdated sections of the Education code.
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal obsolete and outdated sections of the Education code.

title: Relating to election integrity
description: Relating to election integrity

title: Eliminate Governor’s Power for Shutdown
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a full legislative vote regarding all Gubernatorial declarations of a state of preparedness or state of emergency.

title: To declassify Community and Technical Education (“CTE”) teaching positions to allow for counties to provide additional funding for certain positions.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the declassification of community and technical college positions, as well as trades-based high school instructors providing CTE instruction. The bill permits counties to provide additional funding to these positions, regardless of classification. Finally, the bill continues state funding for these positions.

title: To require that when a person’s driver’s license expires, the bar code on the back of the license expires as well.
description: The purpose of this bill is to deactivate barcodes from expired driver's licenses to prevent businesses from selling alcohol and tobacco products to underage children.

title: To double the criminal penalty for anyone found guilty of sexual assault on a minor
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase penalties related to child sexual assault and sexual abuse; to increase penalties for distributing, possessing, and transporting material depicting a child engaged in sexually explicit conduct; to add attempt as a crime; and to clarify that failure to report sexual assault, sexual abuse, or sexual exploitation of a child is a felony.

title: Authorize the Department of Environmental Protection to deposit funds granted pursuant to federal programs
description: The purpose of this bill is to update the Abandoned Mines Lands and Reclamation Act to authorize the deposit of funds granted pursuant to the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA) and the Safeguarding Treatment for the Restoration of Ecosystems from Abandoned Mines Act into the State of West Virginia's Abandoned Land Reclamation Fund.

title: Require that any student in the 11th or 12th grade, who has been placed in a “free/elective/assistant” period, be informed of online college course opportunities available for them
description: The purpose of this bill is to is to require that any student in the 11th or 12th grade, who has been placed in a "free" or "teacher-assistant" period or class, be informed of online college course opportunities available for them.

title: Require adoption awareness material be made available in high school counseling offices
description: The purpose of this bill is to require all students enrolled in grades 9-12 to be provided with adoption awareness material upon request.

title: To create the Substance Abuse Recovery Tax Credit
description: The purpose of this bill is to create an incentive for employers to hire people who are pursuing a formal program of recovery from substance abuse issues by allowing the employer to claim a tax credit for employing eligible individuals, with limits based upon the employer's total number of employees overall. The bill provides for recapture. Finally, the bill provides for an effective date.

title: To require railroad companies to provide alternative entry and exit ways
description: The purpose of this bill is to require railroad companies to provide an alternative entry and exit way to one road communities when performing maintenance, repairs, and construction as a matter of public health and safety.

title: Relating to the creation of the West Virginia Math & Science Teacher Scholarship Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Math & Science Teacher Scholarship Act. The bill provides for a short title. The bill provides for legislative findings and a purpose. The bill provides for the West Virginia Math & Science Scholarship Program and sets forth the amount of scholarship money to be paid to educators who satisfy the thresholds. The bill sets forth criteria and creates a sunset provision.

title: Prohibiting municipal zoning regulations from imposing certain minimum lot sizes
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove minimum lot sizes from zoning ordinances.This section is new; therefore,

title: Improving Medicaid access to durable medical equipment
description: The purpose of this bill is to require Medicaid to cover lymphedema compression treatment items and off-the-shelf orthopedic braces.

title: To exempt daylight fluorescent outer garments from sales
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt daylight fluorescent orange outerwear purchases from sales tax during the first two weeks in November.

title: To require a moment of silence at the beginning of school each day in the state
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a moment of silence at the beginning of each school day. The bill prevents teachers from being able to discuss the substance of what children engage in during the moment of silence. Finally, the bill encourages parents to discuss with their children the substance of their use of time during the moment of silence.

title: Establishing a three month time limit for a purchaser of real property to have a deed recorded.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require purchaser of real property to record their deeds within three months of closing.

title: Modifying compulsory housing for hotels and motels
description: The purpose of this bill relates to hotel and motel housing vouchers programs; prohibiting city or town from requiring hotel or motel participation in housing voucher programs; prohibiting county from requiring hotel or motel participation in housing voucher programs; and prohibiting a housing authority from requiring hotel or motel participation in housing voucher programs.

title: Clarifying how substitute teachers may serve for extended periods.
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the amount of time a substitute teacher holding a restricted substitute teacher permit may teach long term.

title: Relating to changing the process of election litigation
description: The purpose of this bill is to recognize legal standing of the West Virginia Legislature in court actions related to unauthorized changes to election laws and rules; and identify the Legislature as a necessary party.

title: Changing the limit on switching parties before filing to run for office from 60 days to 180 days prior to an election.
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand the time limit on switching parties before the date of filing the announcement from 60 days to 180 days.

title: Accessory dwelling units
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit municipalities from adopting certain regulations in relation to accessory dwelling units.

title: Increasing the criminal penalties for DUI causing death to be known as “Baylea’s Law.”
description: The purpose of this bill is to enact Baylea's Law and increase the penalties for DUI causing death.

title: To provide an exemption of taxes on income derived from tips
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt cash tips from West Virginia personal income tax.

title: To create the West Virginia Inmate Litter Cleanup and Rehabilitation Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand the participation of inmates in county, regional, and state correctional facilities in litter pickup and public works projects across West Virginia; to provide rehabilitation and vocational incentives for inmate participants; and to enhance public safety, environmental cleanliness, and community engagement without creating new funding obligations.

title: To remove restrictions for supervising physicians for Nurse practitioners or physician assistants in West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill is to empower qualified physician assistants and certified nurse practitioners to practice without the supervision of a physician.

title: To enhance the flexibility, responsiveness, and economic development potential of the Industrial Access Road Fund
description: The purpose of this bill relates to enhancing the flexibility, responsiveness, and economic development potential of the Industrial Access Road Fund.

title: Supplemental Appropriation for Rural Health Transformation Program
description: The purpose of this supplemental appropriation bill is to add a new item of appropriation in the aforesaid account for the designated spending unit for expenditure during the fiscal year 2026.

title: Secure Roads and Safe Trucking Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to add identification requirements for nonresident persons operating a commercial vehicle in West Virginia. The bill provides that those persons possess a valid work visa and provide proof of citizenship to validate his or her identity while operating a commercial motor vehicle and that they demonstrate proficiency of the English language sufficient to converse with the general public, understand highway traffic signs and signals in the English language; respond to official inquiries, and make entries on reports and records. Misdemeanor penalties and fines for violations are provided. The bill also allows the Commissioner to adopt the Even Exchange Program of the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA), a military skills test waiver and to permit first responders to apply for a CDL without skills testing.

title: To eliminate the process of vehicle inspection in West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the article creating mandatory state inspections of motor vehicles.

title: Creating Sustaining Opportunities for Academics in Rural Schools Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Sustaining Opportunities for Academics in Rural ("SOAR") Schools Act.

title: Relating to drugs and adding a provision relating to the scheduling of crystalline polymorph psilocybin approved by the Food and Drug Administration
description: The purpose of this bill is to add a provision in Schedule I drugs relating to the scheduling of crystalline polymorph psilocybin, if approved by the Food and Drug Administration and the Drug Enforcement Administration, and declare that will be lawful to prescribe, distribute and market this drug.

title: Relating to false judicial accusations after a determination of falsity
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the crime of false judicial accusation after the determination of falsity.

title: Make it illegal to operate a “squatted” vehicle on West Virginia roads.
description: The purpose of this bill is prohibit the operation of a squatted vehicle in West Virginia.

title: Relating to placing a cap on insurance copays
description: The purpose of this bill is to cap insurance copayments for certain services at $500 a year for insureds who are terminally ill until death.

title: Clarifying the disposition of animal subject to animal cruelty treatment.
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the disposition of animals subject to cruel treatment.

title: Housing assistance for children aging out of foster care system
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the department prioritize housing applications for foster children who have turned 18 years of age and are transitioning from foster care.

title: To provide a 25% pay increase for state teachers (all salary scales)
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a 25% pay increase for state teachers across all salary scales.

title: To require motorists traveling 10 mph or more below the speed limit to activate hazard lights.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the use of hazard lights on cars when the automobile is traveling at more than ten miles below the posted speed limit.

title: To require the Secretary of the State’s Office to issue Tax ID numbers when registering a business in lieu of the State Tax Department.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the West Virginia Secretary of State to obtain and issue tax identification numbers for businesses.

title: Developing a Continuum of Independent Living and Transitional Support Services for Youth Aging Out of Foster Care
description: The purpose of this bill is to develop a continuum of services and supports for youth who are preparing to exit foster care or who have aged out of that care.

title: Relating to establishing the By-Right Housing Development Act to streamline the approval process for development when that proposed development meets all the rules for such development in
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a By-Right Development Act, which would establish a by-right housing development act to streamline the approval process for development when that proposed development meets all the rules for such development in a given community.

title: Relating to zoning ordinances
description: The purpose of this bill is to revise municipal zoning laws to allow for accessory dwelling units; require municipalities to adopt certain regulations in relation to accessory dwelling units; prohibit certain regulations in relation to accessory dwelling units; allow a municipality to charge a fee to review applications to create accessory dwelling units; and establish zoning regulation criteria and guidelines.

title: To mandate coverage for breastfeeding and lactation consultant services
description: The purpose of this bill is to mandate coverage for breastfeeding and lactation consultant services.

title: Sales Tax Exemption for Certain Hygiene and Infant Products
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt from sales tax certain infant products and hygiene products.

title: Creating Corporate Anti-Subsidy Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Corporate Anti-Subsidy Act. The bill permits West Virginia to enter into the "Interstate Compact Agreement Prohibiting Company-Specific Subsidies."

title: Repealing the wine and liquor operating fund and operations fee
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the section of the code that established the Wine and Liquor Operations Fund and operations fees.

title: Relating to municipal regulation of stairway requirements in certain apartment buildings.
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize a municipality to regulate apartment buildings' stairway requirements

title: County authority to impose a vacancy tax
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the ability of the county authority to impose a vacancy tax on vacant or mostly vacant structures. The bill provides for a legislative purpose. The bill grants authority. The bill provides for definitions. The bill provides for the imposition of a vacancy tax. The bill provides for notice and appeal. The bill provides for collection and lien. The bill creates exemptions. Finally, the bill provides rulemaking authority.

title: Junk Fee Prevention Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Junk Fee Prevention Act.

title: Statutory Commitments in Rural Health Transformation Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to make certain changes consistent with relating to creation of West Virginia's Rural Health Transformation Program and the State of West Virginia's commitments to the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services.

title: To require operators of gas and oil wells to withhold royalty taxes due from the lease holder and remit said withholdings to the appropriate County Tax Office.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require lessees of West Virginia real estate who make natural resources royalty payments to withhold West Virginia personal income tax on natural resources royalty payments and provides exceptions, penalties, defines terms, and grants rulemaking authority.

title: Creating a poster providing contact information and resource information on veteran benefits and services
description: The purpose of this bill is to create and display posters with veteran information and resources.

title: Relating generally to asphalt grindings or millings from any WVDOH Right of Way
description: Relating generally to asphalt grindings or millings from any WVDOH Right of Way

title: To update and reflect current inflation rate for all County elected positions
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the increase of the salary of elected county officials to reflect the current rate of inflation, after July 1, 2025.

title: Relating to electric rates
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit an increase in West Virginia electric rate payers for power transmission lines to be built to export electricity to another state. Power that is exported to a neighboring state will be absorbed by that particular state's rate payers or the industry that will ultimately use the electric power.

title: Relating to establishment of the First Amendment Preservation Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to prevent the state or its agencies from contracting with advertising agencies that utilize the services of misinformation or disinformation media monitoring organizations.

title: Creating the Certified Professional Midwife Licensing and Regulation Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Certified Professional Midwife Licensing and Regulation Act.

title: Relating to creating a digital wallet to collect and organize learning and employment records
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a digital wallet for certifications and licensures.

title: Relating to adding requirements to the foster child bill of rights
description: The purpose of this bill is to guarantee that foster children age 13 and older are notified of and supported in attending court hearings that affect them, with counsel present and an explanation of the outcome provided afterward.

title: Clarifying where convicted sex offenders may reside.
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit sex offenders from residing near schools and similarly situated facilities. The bill also provides for exceptions.

title: Relating to the time and place of holding primary elections
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the date for the primary election for the office of the President of United States.

title: Relating to entry upon or recovery of lands
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal a provision of the code relating to the limitation on bringing an action to enter upon or recover lands.

title: Prohibit public utilities from making political or charitable contributions
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit public utilities from making contributions to political candidates or campaigns, political action committees, groups that can make contributions from funds derived from rate payers to political candidates, campaigns, or political action committees; creating criminal offense and penalties for violation; and prohibiting charitable contributions by public utilities to charitable organizations.

title: Prohibiting municipal zoning regulations from imposing certain minimum lot sizes
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove minimum lot sizes from zoning ordinances.

title: Adding Aggravated Vehicular Homicide to the list of qualifying offenses
description: The purpose of this bill is to create enhanced sentencing for repeat offenders of aggravated vehicular homicide, driving under the influence causing serious bodily injury, and third offense driving under the influence.

title: To provide automatic treble damages anytime a non-English speaking commercial truck driver causes an accident in WV
description: The purpose of this bill is to require automatic treble compensatory damages being fined every time a commercial truck driver who cannot comprehend English cause an accident in West Virginia.

title: Establishing privacy regarding medical treatments
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish privacy regarding medical treatment and to prohibit mandatory medical treatments unless the manufacturer of the medical product is liable for any death or serious injury caused by the medical product.

title: Raise the Penalties for Murder and attempted Murder
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the sentence and parole eligibility for inmates serving life sentences and those who have been convicted of murder of the first degree; and modifying eligibility for attempted crimes of murder of the first degree.

title: Modifing the rules for transferring students
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify rulemaking authority of the West Virginia Secondary Schools Activities Commission; require that certain rules be modified and allowing the commission to pull the coaching credentials of any coach found guilty of illegally recruiting student athletes.

title: Requiring insurance to cover certain nutrition and dietary needs
description: The purpose of this bill is to improve health, reduce health care usage and costs and help prevent disease through nutritional wellness and prevention measures and allow for nonpharmacological alternatives to enrollees who choose them. The bill requires that health insurance policies provide coverage for nutritional wellness and prevention that is shown to be beneficial to the enrollee and recommended by the enrollee's physician.

title: Raise the Penalties for Murder and attempted Murder
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the sentence and parole eligibility for the crimes of murder in the second degree; modifying the parole eligibility for inmates serving life sentences and those who have been convicted of first degree murder; and modifying eligibility for attempted crimes of murder in the first and second degree, and allowing the victim's family and prosecutor to attend the parole hearings in person or remotely.

title: Providing veterinarian and veterinary technician reciprocity
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide reciprocity for licensed veterinarians and veterinary technicians who are licensed and in good standing in other states and offer specialized and temporary licensures to foreign graduates through PAVE and ECFVG, and to permit recent graduates to have a temporary license to practice under supervision while awaiting licensure completion.

title: Relating generally to “Flagger Ahead” signs and flaggers on public roads in the State of West Virginia.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create expectations for the removal of "flagger ahead" signs on WV roadways.

title: Disallow candidates for office if back taxes are owed
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit a person from running for public office if the required financial disclosure statement reveals delinquent unpaid taxes.

title: Teacher, School Personnel, and State Police Pay Raise
description: The purpose of this bill is to raise the salaries of certain state employees: WV State Police and certain personnel; public school teachers; and school service personnel.

title: Change the Homestead Exemption
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the Homestead Exemption for certain homeowners from $20,000 to 50% of the assessed value of the homestead, unless the assessed property value is less than $40,000, in which case the exemption would be the first $20,000 of assessed value.

title: Relating to requiring the Bureau for Medical Services to file a legislative rule
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Bureau of Medical Services to file its policy manual as a legislative rule.

title: Relating to updating definitions to incorporate federal law changes to qualified higher education expenses for purposes of 529 accounts
description: The purpose of this bill is to update definitions due to changes in the federal 529 law.

title: Creating plans to protect West Virginia from major crises
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Governor to establish crisis preparedness plans.

title: Establishing limitations on the use of artificial intelligence and artificial intelligence technology to deliver mental health care, with exceptions for administrative support functions
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish regulations governing the use of artificial intelligence in the administration and delivery of mental health care in West Virginia.

title: Relating to access of records in controlled substance monitoring
description: The purpose of this bill is to add qualified examiners with the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration to the persons who have access to the Controlled Substances Monitoring Database maintained by the Board of Pharmacy.

title: Medicaid eligibility verification
description: The purpose of this bill is to require Bureau of Medical Services to verify and remove deceased Medicaid enrollees; the bill requires data matches with official death records; mandates the termination of eligibility upon proof of an enrollee's death; authorizes data-sharing agreements and annual audits; requires an annual report to the Legislature; and provides an effective date.

title: To increase the COLA by 15% for all retired state employees
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a 20 percent cost-of-living adjustment for retired public employees and school personnel.

title: To set the salary of the Associate Superintendent of Schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to set the number of associate state superintendent of schools positions to one instead of the current number of two.

title: Relating to addressing School Discipline in Public Schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to itemize additional disciplinary issues to be addressed by the Department of Education and reports to the Legislative Oversight Commission on Education Accountability. It also requires the Department of Education to include discipline data on its dashboard for public access.

title: Hotel occupancy tax rate
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the maximum hotel occupancy tax permitted by municipal or county ordinances from six percent to eight percent

title: Establishing Summer Feeding for All Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to continue the Summer Feeding for All initiative that will encourage county school systems to look for innovative ways to provide assistance to students in need to access nutritious foods during summer break and other times when school is not in session. The bill requires each county school board to conduct an assessment of the availability of food to students to determine what food insecurities exist in the student population. The bill directs each county school board compile and distribute a list of existing food providers in the community that will provide nutritious food to children with food insecurities on non-school days. The bill directs the Office of Child Nutrition to help facilitate county school boards coordinate and develop the public policy initiative of Feed to Achieve.

title: Relating to Drivers License Address Requirements
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow a person applying for a driver's license or a state-issued identification card who has no permanent address to obtain a license or identification card by verifying that he or she has no permanent address.

title: To require parole boards to take into account the sentencing judge’s recommendation at the time of sentencing
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a board of probation and parole to consider the sentencing judge's recommendation for certain qualifying offenses.

title: Private or government, to pay an additional fee during eminent domain proceedings
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a fee to be paid to counties when property is taken under eminent domain and to establish how those funds can be spent.

title: Insurance coverage for laser hair removal
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide insurance coverage for laser hair removal.

title: Sustainable Child-serving Workforce and Foster Care Modernization Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Sustainable Child-Serving Workforce & Foster Care Modernization Act.

title: Providing equal share of funds from the fire and casualty premium tax to all departments
description: The purpose of this bill relates to providing equal share of funds from the fire and casualty premium tax to the departments.

title: Extending the Qualified Opportunity Zones until July 1, 2032.
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend Qualified Opportunity Zones until July 1, 2032.

title: Relating to compensation for panel attorneys
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase compensation for panel attorneys of the Public Defender Services; and requiring Public Defender Services to annually provide a report to certain state agencies summarizing legal services that are being provided by the submission of a voucher by panel attorneys serving as guardians ad litem in state courts.

title: Clarifies the minimum hours of attendance necessary for child subsidies to be based on monthly enrollment rather than daily attendance
description: The purpose of this bill is to set forth requirements for the reimbursement of child care and afterschool providers receiving child care subsidies.

title: The Anti-Terrorism Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Anti-Terrorism Act; define terroristic acts and groups; declare that specific acts are felony criminal acts of terrorism and establish punishment therefor; create mandatory sentencing; require restitution to be paid to victims of terrorism; clarify unlawful restraint; prohibit obstruction of a terrorism investigation; and require the Attorney General to identify and designate terroristic entities and members engaged in acts of terrorism.

title: Allow school board members to run for the state legislature
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow currently serving members of county school boards to retain their position on the board during a campaign for other public office.

title: Relating to bank merger by interstate branching and providing clarity regarding the disclosure required when an out of bank acquires a West Virginia state-chartered bank
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide clarity regarding the attestation submitted in response to an interstate bank merger.

title: Relating to requirements for licensure as a mortgage lender or broker
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow another acceptable form of financial statement from mortgage brokers to show adequate net worth in compliance with the licensing statute.

title: Relating to joint accounts in banking institutions and eliminating the requirement that the commissioner approve joint account forms to be used by banking institutions
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the requirement that the commissioner of financial institutions approve forms used by financial institutions.

title: Relating to requirements for disclosures and recordkeeping, reinforcing state law regarding late fees, and clarifying that a state-specific closing disclosure is not required as long as federal closing disclosures are given accurately
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that a separate state closing disclosure is not required if appropriate federal closing disclosures are provided to borrowers.

title: Creating the Barber Apprentice Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to

title: Requiring high school students to pass a test on the US Constitution to graduate from high school
description: The purpose of this bill is to require each high school student to pass a test on the United States Constitution as a requirement to graduation from high school.

title: Relating to changing circumstances for when a child may be removed from a foster home.
description: The purpose of this bill is to update the circumstances when a child may be removed from a foster home.

title: Addressing the placement of foster children and creating a central reception center and emergency resource homes.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a central reception center and emergency resource homes for foster children and eliminating the practice of placing children in hotels due to lack of foster care placements.

title: To create the Charlie Kirk Memorial First Amendment Freedom Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create "The Charlie Kirk Memorial First Amendment Freedom Act".

title: Permitting teachers to wear a “mobile alert button” for emergency situations, to be known as “Alyssa’s Law.”
description: The purpose of this bill is to implement a wearable panic alert system, to be known as Alyssa's law, in all schools in the state.

title: To establish the cold case task force for the State of West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the cold case task force for the State of West Virginia.

title: Clarifying the penalty of a dog attacking livestock by adding a proviso to include “any other livestock.”
description: The purpose of this bill is to add "any other livestock" as it pertains to penalties for dogs wounding livestock.

title: Defining Permissible expenditures for municipalities and counties
description: The purpose of this bill is to add the demolition of unsafe and unsanitary structures and planning for reuse or improvement of property owned by municipalities and county commissions as permissible expenditures of revenue from the hotel occupancy tax.

title: Relating to credit for qualified rehabilitated buildings investment
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a credit for qualified rehabilitated buildings investment under the corporation net income tax.

title: Relating to the Deputy Sheriff Retirement System Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide an annual annuity adjustment of 1% for eligible deputy sheriff retirants and surviving spouses when the plan has reached a funded level of 105 percent. The bill permits the board to set the employer contribution rate, and the maximum employer contribution rate will be 13% after the first annual annuity adjustment is paid.

title: To modify deputy sheriff’s retirement pay and the cost of receiving certain reports
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase certain fees collected by county sheriffs and add these increased amounts to the Deputy Sheriff Retirement Fund to provide modest increases in benefits for retired deputies.

title: Relating to environmental clean-up for motor vehicle crashes
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for environmental cleanup for motor vehicle crashes.

title: To raise the salary of Sheriffs
description: The purpose of this bill is to raise the salary of Sheriff's to be 10% above the salaries of the county clerk and circuit clerk.

title: Relating generally to the creation of mental hygiene regions by the Supreme Court of Appeals
description: The purpose of this bill is to create of mental hygiene regions in the state, permit evaluations to be conducted by video, grant civil immunity to providers, and clarify commitment periods.

title: Federally Approved Project Delivery Methods for Airport Capital Improvement Projects
description: The purpose of this bill is to expressly authorize airport authorities under state law to utilize project delivery methods approved or authorized by the Federal Aviation Administration in order to efficiently and safely plan, procure, and construct airport infrastructure projects funded through the Federal Aviation Administration's Airport Improvement Program, including the Federal Aviation Administration Integrated Project Delivery Pilot Program established under 49 U.S.C. Â§47123 and any successor programs.

title: Caregiver Tax Credit
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a tax credit for eligible family members providing caregiver services to an eligible family member.

title: Relating to dental health care service plans
description: The purpose of this bill is to require transparency of dental health care insurance products. The bill requires annual reporting of the medical loss ratio with the Insurance Commissioner. The bill sets forth standards for the methods by which a dental carrier may pay a dental provider. The bill authorizes third party networks and sets standards for such networks. The bill requires an annual rebate to be paid in the form of a premium reduction when the MLR is not met. The bill provides for rulemaking.

title: Creating the False Claims Act
description: The purpose of this bill relates to creating the False Claims Act. The bill amends the fraud and abuse provisions in Medicaid program to provide for damages under the False Claims Act; sets forth prohibited acts, damages, costs and civil penalties, limitations on damages, and responsibilities of the Attorney General; provides for civil actions by private persons, rights of parties to qui tam proceedings, awards to qui tam plaintiffs, the barring of certain civil actions; provides that state is not liable for the expenses of private litigants; provides for private action for retaliatory conduct, limitation of actions, retroactive application, and state intervention in action by private person; addresses estoppel, jurisdiction and venue, non-exclusivity of act, liberality of construction, and distribution of proceeds.

title: To ensure that West Virginia law enforcement entities are not compelled or commandeered by federal authorities to conduct activities that violate our citizens’ Constitutional rights
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Anti-Federal Commandeering Act. The bill provides for a short title, and legislative findings and intent. The bill provides definitions, prohibits federal commandeering, and creates prohibitions on police activity. The bill defines permitted activities, and allows the Attorney General to challenge unconstitutional federal actions. The bill allows the Attorney General to publish model policies, and provides for law enforcement immunity.

title: Exempting from the sales tax all-terrain vehicles and utility terrain vehicles used as farm equipment
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt from the sales tax all-terrain vehicles and utility terrain vehicles used as farm equipment.

title: Relating to creating the Equipment Right to Repair Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Equipment Right to Repair Act; creating a short title; defining terms; establishing jurisdiction of the Commissioner of Agriculture; establishing requirements; establishing limitations; providing for rulemaking; establishing violations; imposing civil penalties; authorizing civil actions, penalties, and injunctive relief; and providing for applicability and effective date of article.

title: Allow community health center to provide sign-on bonus
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize bonus and incentive programs at political subdivision-based community health centers.

title: Relating to municipal fire protection fees
description: The purpose of this bill is relating to municipal fire protection fees.

title: Relating to modifying the Charter Schools Startup Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the Charter Schools Startup Fund; change the name of the fund; require submission of application to the West Virginia Professional Charter School Board in order to receive funds from the Charter Schools Startup Fund; require notice to potential applicants; require certain contents be included in application; expand the uses for the funds; require distribution of money to qualifying charter school applicants and charter schools, subject to availability of funding; allow the West Virginia Professional Charter School Board to establish competitive process when the number of applicants exceed funding; eliminate criteria an applicant must demonstrate as a condition of receiving funds; modify time frame for distribution of funds; require repayment in certain circumstances; and specify the manner of distribution.

title: Relating to providing greater access to unused public buildings for public charter schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide greater access to unused public buildings for public charter schools.

title: Relating to use of criminal records as disqualification from authorization to practice a particular profession
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the use of criminal records in determinations to allow an individual to practice a profession or occupation, by a board, authority, or other agency authorized to issue licenses, certifications, registrations, or other authorizations to engage in a particular profession or occupation.

title: Relating to Good Samaritan Law.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that a person who acts voluntarily and without remuneration aid to a victim of an emergent situation may not be liable for civil damages.

title: Creating the Affordable Medicaid Buy-In Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Affordable Medicaid Buy-In Program. The bill requires the Department of Human Services to develop and administer the Affordable Medicaid Buy-In Plan. The bill creates the Health Care Affordability and Access Improvement Fund. The bill establishes an advisory council to the Affordable Medicaid Buy-In Program. The bill requires a study and reposts be made. The bill defines terms. The bill sets limitations of employers. The bill requires rule-making.

title: To redirect data center tax revenue to PEIA, counties, and schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to redirect any positive tax increment ad valorem property taxes collected from High Impact Data Centers; local school Boards will receive 10% of the funds; redirects the current 50% of the funds from the Personal Income Tax Reduction Fund to 35% to fund the Public Insurance Financial Stability Fund; increases from 30% to 35% of funds to the situs county; and provides 10% of the funds go to the situs county school board. The bill also provides that the fund created to assist electric grid stabilization for regulated utilities includes all utilities, not only coal and gas powered utilities.

title: Allowing for taxes to be paid quarterly
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide an option that real property taxes may be allowed to be paid on a quarterly basis.

title: Relating to utility rate increases
description: The purpose of this bill is to create an infrastructure fund that will be made from 5% from every rate increase granted to public and private utilities that is to be used for infrastructure repairs and improvements.

title: Authorizing municipalities to place signage on state roads within their municipal jurisdiction and boundaries.
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize municipalities to place signage on state roads within their municipal jurisdiction and boundaries.

title: Relating to petition for involuntary treatment for drug and alcohol abuse
description: The purpose of this bill is to describe the process of involuntary treatment for substance use disorder.

title: Provide an increase in salary to WV Birth to Three contracted therapists and employees
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase payment for professional service provided to the West Virginia Birth-to-Three program by therapists and other professionals who are not employed by a state agency by 25 percent.

title: Change the requirement for posting public notices at the state and federal level for PSDs.
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit public service districts to include notices of alleged federal and state violations in one publication.

title: Make speeds that exceed 30MPH over the speed limit reckless driving
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that operating any vehicle at speeds in excess of 30 miles per hour over the posted speed limit is reckless driving.

title: To provide compensation to those who have been adversely affected by the actions of the West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeal’s Judicial Investigative Committee
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide compensation to those who have been adversely impacted by the actions of the West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals' Judicial Investigative Committee or any other division operating under the umbrella of the West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals.

title: To regulate outdoor advertisements
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit "lewd public content" from being advertised anywhere in West Virginia.

title: Relating to the use of state water resources
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that all high impact data centers report water use to the Department of Environmental Projection as part of the Water Resource Protection and Management Act's water use monitoring requirements, authorizes the Department of Environmental Protection to limit, condition or prohibit withdrawals by a high impact data center from a state water resource if harm to that water resource or its future or existing uses will occur; removes references to previously repealed Joint Legislative Oversight Commission on State Water Resources; and requires the Department of Environmental Protection to provide analysis of a high impact data centers on public waters of this state.

title: To remove the cap for municipalities on their stabilization fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the 30% cap on municipal stabilization funds.

title: To permit women’s wrestling in public high schools as a sanctioned event
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit women's wrestling in public high schools and public charter schools as a sanctioned sporting event in this state.

title: Adjusting the timing of traffic lights on divided highways
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that a three-second pause be added to all traffic-control lights and devices on divided highways.

title: Prohibiting non-service animals in stores that sell food
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit a person from taking a dog, cat, or other animal into a grocery store or retail establishment that sells food unless the animal is a service animal.

title: Establish time limits on Legislators becoming lobbyists
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend the one-year prohibition on lobbying by former public officials to five years.

title: To increase the annual registration fees for electric, hybrid and hydrogen vehicles.
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the registration fees for alternative fuel vehicles.

title: Relating to compensation for sworn members of the WV State Police
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a geographic assignment compensation differential for members of the West Virginia State Police.

title: Exempt federally qualified health centers from having to obtain a prior authorization for behavioral health services
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt federally qualified health centers from having to obtain a prior authorization for behavioral health services.

title: Allow county commissions to formally petition the Division of Highways regarding the repair of local roads
description: The purpose of this bill is to enhance maintenance and repair of the state's local roads by authorizing the county commissions to petition the division for road repair for local roads.

title: Relating to civil remedies for the unauthorized disclosure of intimate images.
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the civil cause of action for disclosure of intimate images.

title: Relating to consumer protection and the collection of certain personally identifiable information.
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the use of scanner technology to collect personally identifiable information in certain consumer transactions.

title: Modify the procedure for teachers when using leave
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the procedure for teachers when using leave.

title: Prohibiting entry by illegal aliens
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish certain crimes, processes, and procedures regarding individuals who have illegally entered or reentered the state in violation of state and federal laws and to create prohibitions on the illegal entry into or illegal presence in this state by a person who is an alien. The bill provides for the enforcement of those prohibitions and certain related orders, including immunity from liability and indemnification for enforcement actions. Finally, the bill authorizes and requires under certain circumstances the removal of persons who violate those prohibitions; and creating criminal offenses

title: Relating to valuation of specialized high-technology property
description: The purpose of this bill is to revise the valuation of specialized high-technology property.

title: Local Shares teacher and school personnel pay
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for local shares of school teacher and personnel pay.

title: Requiring certain disclosures of election expenditures
description: The purpose of this bill is to require disclosure of dark money political expenditures to allow the public to know who is paying for political advertisements.

title: Authorize the Superintendent of the county schools district to apply directly to the School Building Authority for emergency funding to facilitate remediation of hazards.
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the Superintendents of the county school districts or the local School Improvement Committees to apply to the School Building Authority for emergency funding to remediate hazards from natural processes.

title: Providing online training for Executors/Executrix of an Estate
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide educational training regarding the fiduciary and other duties of executors and administrators of estates and requiring the West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals to provide this online training.

title: Relating to creating a moratorium on school closures and consolidations pending a West Virginia Department of Education (“WVDE”) school aid formula proposal.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a moratorium on school closures and consolidations pending a WVDE school aid formula proposal.

title: Relating to regulation of foods
description: The purpose of this bill is to define terms related to food ingredients.

title: Relating to hospitals establishing protocols for providing trauma informed care to patients
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish protocol for hospitals to provide patients with trauma informed care.

title: Prohibiting the state or any political subdivision from subsidizing any data center in West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the state or any political subdivision from subsidizing any data center in West Virginia.

title: To the elimination of the West Virginia Department of Education and providing direct funding for education
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the West Virginia Department of Education and provide direct funding for education.

title: Requiring that all state agency P-card rebates received must go toward stabilizing the PEIA fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to require all P-Card rebates to be transferred to the PEIA Rainy Day Fund in order to stabilize that fund.

title: Increasing penalty for transporting telecommunicating devices into jails.
description: The purpose of this bill is to make transportation of a telecommunication device into a state correctional facility a felony.

title: Determine credits for qualified rehabilitated buildings investment
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the tax credit for qualified rehabilitated buildings investment.

title: Allowing a county board of education participating in the operation of a multicounty vocational center to withdraw
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow a county board of education participating in a multicounty vocational center to determine that a career technical education program be part of the local high school; and allow the program to be a state-approved program of study or a locally created program of study.

title: Direct Classroom Funding Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Direct Classroom Funding Act.

title: Authorizing county boards to designate rural anchor schools.
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize county boards to designate rural anchor schools.

title: Relating to the responsibility of a board of a public service district to cooperate with a county commission in the sale of assets of a public service district that is being dissolved, sold or merged with another public service district.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the board of a public service district to cooperate with a county commission when the county commission has authorized the dissolution, sale or merger of the district with another public service district.

title: The West Virginia Refugee Absorptive Capacity Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to enact the Refugee and Immigrant Absorptive Capacity Act. The bill provides a short title. The bill defines terms. The bill sets forth the duties of the state office within the Department of Human Services that deals with refugees and/or immigrants. The bill permits moratorium applications and cessations. The bill requires a fiscal impact assessment. The bill requires reports. The bill requires the Department of Human Services to administer the West Virginia Refugee and Immigrant Resettlement Program Plan. The bill provides a severability provision.

title: Providing for election reform and protections
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for election reform. The bill defines "Public Election Related Information and Data." The bill allows for the public disclosure of this data through the Freedom of Information Act. The bill provides for the maintenance of Public Election Related Information and Data including cast vote records. The bill provides for restrictions of certain electronic software voting systems and contingent hand counting procedures. Finally, the bill provides for the random physical inspection of electronic voting systems.

title: Providing for a program allowing election official trainees to be appointed as election officials
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a program allowing election official trainees to be appointed as election officials.

title: Relating to creating the West Virginia Public Participation Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Public Participation Protection Act. The Act applies to certain causes of action where protection of freedom of speech is concerned.

title: To clarify the process of royalty payments for wells in this state.
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the method of reporting and payments from all oil and gas wells royalties. The bill provides the method of calculations and payment of royalties requiring auditing of information relating to leased premises, and transparency and monitoring of leased minerals.

title: West Virginia Consumer Privacy Act of 2026
description: The purpose of this bill is to enact the West Virginia Consumer Privacy Act of 2026.

title: Establish narrow, clearly bounded guaranteed-issue rights for Medicare Supplement policies in West Virginia.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a narrow, clearly bounded guaranteed-issue rights for Medicare Supplement (Medigap) policies in West Virginia.

title: Determining campaign finance report deadlines during legislative sessions
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend the deadlines for filing campaign finance reports.

title: Make available vegetarian meal option for students enrolled in schools, provided that such meals comply with all applicable federal nutritional guidelines
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide students enrolled in schools with the option of vegetarian meals which comply with all applicable federal nutritional guidelines.

title: To allow for the reinstatement of retired Deputy Sheriffs to their former departments.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide guidelines for reinstating sheriff's deputies to their former departments after retirement and defining applicability, eligibility, and rules for the process.

title: To remove the 2 year timeframe for medical malpractice suits to be filed only for individuals who were minors when they had their procedures performed
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify when a minor may bring a medical malpractice cause of action.

title: Combining rolls of the Assessor’s Office and Division of Motor Vehicles
description: The purpose of this bill is to streamline the process of personal property tax assessment by requiring the Division of Motor Vehicles to supply personal property records of all motor vehicles owned to the Tax Assessor.

title: To provide a 25% pay increase for state school service personnel (all salary scales)
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a 25% pay increase for state school service personnel across all salary scales.

title: Relating generally to child labor
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the requirement that 14 or 15 year old obtain a work permit; establishing that employer seeking to hire a child 14 or older receive an age certificate from the commission prior to employing the child; providing commissioner the authority to issue age certificates for children ages 14 and over; and providing penalties for a person that issues an age certificate in violation of the article.

title: Relating to modifying the priority of insurance coverage for drivers of certain vehicles to make consistent with federal law
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the priority of insurance coverage for persons operating a vehicle for the purpose of test driving or loaned out by the seller of a vehicle to be consistent with federal law governing insurance coverage for rental vehicles.

title: Relating to deadly force
description: The purpose of this bill is to strengthen the West Virginia castle doctrine. The bill provides a complete defense from civil and/or criminal prosecution against persons lawfully using force in defensive actions.

title: To revise and update all provisions of state code relating to the West Virginia State Guard
description: The purpose of this bill is to revise and update the provisions of state code relating to all aspects of the West Virginia State Guard.

title: Protection of deployed service members
description: The purpose of this bill is to create "The Deployed Servicemembers Protection Act", provide legislative findings, provide definitions, and describe protections for servicemembers and penalties for violating them.

title: Relating to obtaining title to abandoned or junked motor vehicles abandoned on the property or place of business of an automobile dealer
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the requirement that the loan value of the motor vehicle be less than $9,500 to allow an automobile dealer, licensed automobile auction, motor vehicle repair facility or towing company upon whose property or place of business an abandoned or junked motor vehicle has been abandoned to obtain a certificate of title and registration for the abandoned motor vehicle or junked vehicle.

title: Repealing vehicle inspection sticker requirements in WV
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the article creating mandatory state inspections of motor vehicles.

title: Abolish the tax on overtime pay
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt personal income tax on overtime pay.

title: To recalculate how child support payments are made
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify calculation to use net pay instead of adjusted gross income.

title: To remove the state tax on gasoline at the pumps
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove taxes on gasoline.

title: Relating to guidelines for home confinement
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify where a person incarcerated on home confinement may travel.

title: Authorizing sheriffs who are members of the public retirement system to retire upon attaining the age of sixty-two with eight or more years of services
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize sheriffs who are members of the public retirement system to retire upon attaining the age of sixty-two with eight or more years of service.

title: To modify child support payments for working parents
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove child support when both parents get equal custody and both parents work.

title: To give state retirees a 10% increase
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a graduated increase in retirement benefits to state employees and teachers over a three-year period.

title: A 10% raise to non-uniformed corrections workers
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a pay raise to administrative employees, staff, and non-uniformed personnel of the Division of Corrections, Division of Juvenile Services, and the West Virginia Regional Jail and Correctional Facility Authority in order to retain current workers and attract new workers to this field.

title: To require all utility companies to absorb the costs of maintenance, upgrades, and repairs for their pipes, cables, utility poles, electrical lines, and other necessities without increasing rates or costs to consumers/customers.
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure that utility companies absorb the costs associated with maintenance and upgrades without passing that cost on to customers.

title: To expand the provisionof the literacy-based promation act in order to provide certin intervention and implementation stratagies for literacy proficiency among students in grade 4 through grade 8
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand the provisions of the Literacy Based Promotion Act in order to provide certain intervention and implementation strategies for literacy proficiency among students in grade four through grade eight.

title: Increase the penalties for contempt of court in a magistrate court
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the penalties for contempt of court in magistrate court.

title: Relating to utility affordability and economic competitiveness
description: The purpose of this bill is to restore utility affordability and reliability.

title: Relating to establishing an unborn child tax credit
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a new $2,000 state income tax exemption, beginning in tax year 2027, for each unborn child carried by a resident individual.

title: Requiring the three Commissioners of the State Public Service Commission to be elected positions
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that Commissioners to the Public Service Commission be an elected position; to establish that during the general election in 2026 three commissioners be elected to the Public Service Commission to a term of four years; to modify ballot to include commissioners; to provide that the Governor fill a vacancy in the office of commissioner for the unexpired term; and to establish requirements for the commissioners.

title: Utility Credit for Private Public-Access Recreation Spaces
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a utility credit for private public-access recreation spaces.

title: Requiring the West Virginia Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation to provide an inmate with one physical copy of their birth certificate and social security card upon release
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that the Division of Corrections provide each probationer with physical copies of their birth certificate and Social Security Administration card upon release from a facility.

title: Requiring all hospitals and medical offices to send a notice to all former or current patients when they turn 18, informing them that if they have had any negative or adverse side effects of a procedure that was performed on them as a child to contact the hospital or office to inform them of the issue
description: The purpose of this bill is to requires persons or entities rendering medical services to patients who were under the age of 18 years at the time of the services to notify these patients after they reach 18 years of age to contact the providers of any adverse or negative effects experienced from the services.

title: To mandate county boards of education to provide feminine hygiene products in all public elementary, middle, and high schools for female students
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide free feminine hygiene products to female students in public schools.

title: Modifying the Occupational Pneumoconiois award categories for Worker’s Compensation
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a set of payment guidelines for pulmonary massive fibroids without current pulmonary impairment in order to care for those who face future impairment that would otherwise fall outside of the timeframe for filing a complaint.

title: Place Correction and Rehab state workers into a separate category from other state workers and increase their salary scales.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a pay equity salary adjustment and increase be provided to all employees of the Division of Corrections and Rehabilitation.

title: Provide a pay equity salary adjustment and increase to certain employees of the Division of Corrections and Rehabilitation
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a pay equity salary adjustment for non-uniformed employees of the Division of Corrections and Rehabilitation.

title: Relating to critical vacancies in public education
description: The purpose of this bill is to define a critical vacancy and require board staff certified in the subject matters where there are vacancies to act as substitutes in those positions until someone is hired to fill that position.

title: Removing fees teachers have to pay in order to obtain any teaching license, certification, or additional continuing education credit hours (reporting fee) to the state Board of Education
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove all fees charged by the West Virginia State Department of Education associated with teacher licensure, certification, and registering the completion of continuing credit hours.

title: To exempt individuals over 70 from real estate taxes beginning tax year 2027
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a real and personal property tax exemption for residents 70 years or older and clarify who qualifies for the Homestead Act.

title: Restricting the use of pesticides
description: The purpose of this bill is to restrict the use of certain pesticides.

title: To require a guilty verdict, before any property of any type are taken from an individual
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the practice of civil asset forfeiture.

title: Relating to consumer protection from fraudulent telephone solicitation
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish comprehensive protections against telephone solicitation fraud, spoofing, and abuse; to require modern safeguards by telecommunications providers; to impose strong penalties on violators; and to direct enforcement proceeds to local fire and emergency medical.

title: To oppose the use of eminent domain in West Virginia for private corporation benefit
description: The purpose of this bill is to protect the citizens of the West Virginia from losing their property to eminent domain.

title: Redefining political party
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the definition of a political party for all state and local elections by providing official ballot status to a political party that has received at least one percent of the votes in the preceding general election for a statewide office or has at least 5,000 voters registered as members. The bill also makes the definition applicable to municipalities.

title: Regarding emergency ambulance fees for owners of collocated rental units
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide fairness in the application of the special emergency ambulance service fee by ensuring that small lodging businesses such as cabin and campsite owners are treated equitably with hotels and motels and not charged disproportionately high fees relative to their capacity and economic scale.

title: Working Farm Property Tax Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Working Farm Tax Protection Preservation Act" that will exempt the first 100 acres of farmland from ad valorem tax.

title: West Virginia Education Freedom and Parental Empowerment Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Education Freedom and Parental Empowerment Act.

title: Sudden Death Reporting and Stransparency Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Sudden Death Reporting and Vaccine Transparency Act." It charges the Chief Medical Examiner with investigating all sudden or unexplained deaths, which are defined as Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS), Sudden Unexpected Infant Death (SUID); Sudden Death in the Young (SDY); Sudden Arrhythmic Death Syndrome (SADS); or Any unexpected, unattended, or unexplained death of an individual under the age of 30.

title: Eliminate state taxes on tobacco, vape, alcohol products, and gambling
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal taxes on alcohol, tobacco, and gambling.

title: Relating to the termination of the authority’s certificate of need program
description: The purpose of this bill is to terminate the West Virginia Health Care Authority; terminate the authority's certificate of need program; providing the termination of the authority's cooperative agreement review process; provide definitions; establishing when the secretary shall propose a repeal; clarify the transfer of the authority's remaining powers, assets, records, and employees to the Secretary of the Department of Health; clarify the money to be transferred to the general revenue fund; and establish exemptions.

title: Mandate the number of School days or hours required
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that county schools shall have either 180 days of instructional hours or 990 hours per year, but flexibility shall be provided to a county to determine when this occurred.

title: To abolish the Department of Economic Development and the cabinet board position
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the article creating the Department of Economic Development.

title: To nullify any ATF powers by the federal government to regulate intrastate firearm sales in West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Second Amendment Preservation Act. The bill states a short title; provides legislative findings; prohibits regulation of intrastate firearm sales and transfers; provides for civil and criminal penalties; authorizes Attorney General to defend and prosecute; and addresses sovereign immunity.

title: Relating to the Second Amendment Preservation Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a misdemeanor offense by federal agents or employees who attempt to enforce decrees or writs not approved by Congress or issued by due process. The Attorney General is charged with enforcement.

title: To exempt all WV residents 65 and older from personal property taxes and real estate property taxes effective Jan 1, 2027
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a real and personal property tax exemption for residents 65 years or older and clarify who qualifies for the Homestead Act.

title: Protecting Due Process in Firearm Confiscation Related to Protective Orders
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a full adversarial hearing before a court of record before a respondent may be prohibited from possessing any firearm or ammunition, under mandatory provisions in protective order and then only by clear and convincing evidence. The bill also provides for automatic appeal by respondent.

title: To prohibiting municipalities participating in the home rule program from establishing on discrimination ordinances that include protected classes in addition to what is designated in state statute.
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit municipalities participating in the home rule program from establishing nondiscrimination ordinances that include protected classes in addition to what is designated in state statute.

title: West Virginia Prime Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia PRIME Act.

title: Second Amendment Reaffirmation and Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the "Second Amendment Reaffirmation and Protection Act."

title: To eliminate the Personal Income tax in WV
description: The purpose of this bill is to abolish personal income tax.

title: To end double taxation on rental properties
description: The purpose of this bill is to lower rent for tenants.

title: Creating the Truth in Taxation Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Truth in Taxation Act.

title: Creating exemption from sales tax for diapers and baby items
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt from sales tax certain infant products and hygiene products.

title: Relating to the protection of firearm owner privacy and prohibition of registries
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Protection of Firearm Owner Privacy and Prohibition of Registries Act.

title: Providing for the use of “A.C.” as a name ending for an accounting corporation.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the use of "A.C." as a name ending for an accounting corporation.

title: Relating to the tax exemption of a citizen who paid to have a cat or dog spayed or neutered
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow a tax credit for the cost of spaying or neutering a dog or cat.

title: Verification of voter’s physical address by Secretary of State
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Secretary of State to provide for verification of voter residence.

title: Relating to requiring paper ballots in all elections
description: The purpose of this bill is to require paper ballots in all elections. The bill prohibits electronic voting. Finally, the bill requires photo identification to vote.

title: Removing the 140 day a year cap placed on the amount of days a year a retired teacher can work before having their retirement penalized
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that the number of days a retired teacher may accept employment may extend beyond 140 days under specific conditions; and to prohibit reduction of benefits or requiring additional contributions for retirement benefits.

title: Establish mandated monthly half days for students to all allow school staff planning time
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a mandated monthly half day for students to allow for school staff planning time.

title: Require county boards of education to train at least one professional staff member at each school in a grant writing procedures.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require county boards of education to train at least one professional staff member at each school in grant writing procedures.
