title: To provide $10,000 a year salary increase for any teacher who goes through the National Board Certification process and becomes nationally certified
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a $10,000 a year salary increase for any teacher who goes through the National Board Certification process and becomes nationally certified.

title: Relating to teacher fundraising
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure that counties or their officers may not prevent crowd-funding, or other meaningful current methods for fundraising, from the available fundraising methods available to teachers.

title: To provide a raise for special education aides, as well as a raise for self-contained special education teachers
description: The purpose of this bill is to match the salaries of Aide I, II, III, IV, V (Special Education Aides) with that of Early Childhood Classroom Assistant Teachers and then increasing that amount by 5% for the Aide V position; increase the pay of self-contained, special education teachers by 10%; define a critical vacancy; and to require board staff who are certified in the subject area of a critical vacancy to go to the classroom and fill that position until someone is hired to do so.

title: To establish requirements for adult supervision on county school buses
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the presence of a second adult on a school bus when elementary children are mixed with middle school aged or high school aged children on a route.

title: Require all students to be taught how to properly handle, fold, treat, honor, display, and retire the American flag
description: The purpose of this bill is to require public school students to learn how to properly handle, fold, treat, honor, display, and retire the American flag and pass an examination on this subject as a prerequisite for graduation.

title: To determine the salaries of all county Superintendent of School based on population.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish maximum salaries of county school superintendents for each of the 55 counties, based on student population of each county.

title: Prohibit the use of electronic devices for learning in all classrooms grades 3 and below
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the use of electronic devices for learning and testing in all classrooms for students in grade three and below.

title: Authorizing a pilot program for a four day school week
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the State Board of Education to authorizing the State Board of Education to implement a two year county pilot program to change the school week from five days to four days subject to compliance with Â§18-5-45 of the code which requires the board to hold at least two public meetings that allow parents, teachers, teacher organizations, businesses, and other interested parties within the county to discuss the school calendar.

title: Allow Religious Exemptions for vaccines
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide exemptions from mandatory immunizations based on religious reasons.

title: To create a buffer zone between a data center and residence, school or house of worship
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a minimum 500-foot buffer zone between the construction or establishment of a data center and a residence or school or house of worship.

title: Relating to Legislative Rules regarding chemicals of emerging concern
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish that certain legislative rules proposed by state agencies regarding chemicals of emerging concern shall be based upon the best available science and the weight of the scientific evidence.

title: To establish the West Virginia Freedom and Innovation Pilot Act of 2026
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia Freedom and Innovation Pilot Act of 2026. The bill provides for a short title. The bill provides for the enactment of the program. Finally, the bill provides for a sunset and review date.

title: Requiring MDs and DOs to complete continuing education
description: Requiring M.D.’s and D.O.’s to complete continuing education

title: Related to the establishment of the Charter School Direct Loan Program and the Charter School Credit Enhancement Program within the West Virginia Economic Development Authority
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Charter School Direct Loan Program and the Charter School Credit Enhancement Program within the West Virginia Economic Development Authority to support the growth of public charter schools.

title: To require all West Virginia high school students to pass a Civics examination and the United States Naturalization Examination
description: The purpose of this bill is to require all West Virginia high school students to pass a civics examination and the United States Naturalization Examination as a prerequisite for graduation.

title: To provide a reduction of the tax for companies who have 75% or more of their workforce as West Virginia residents
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a reduction of the business and occupation tax rate for companies who have 75 percent or more of their workforce as West Virginia residents.

title: To ensure that classroom sizes are equal without losing a teachers aide
description: The purpose of this bill is to make classroom sizes equal so that aides can be best utilized and one-on-one time with teachers and students can be maximized without losing the use of an aide.

title: To change the beginning of the school year to the Tuesday after Labor Day and the end of the school year to the Friday before Memorial Day.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish that the educational instructional term for students shall begin no earlier than the Tuesday after Labor Day and conclude no later than the Friday before Memorial Day.

title: To change the amount of days in a school year from 180 to 160.
description: The purpose of this bill is to set the school calendar to 160 days of instruction.

title: To create the Southern Coalfield Resiliency and Revitalization Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Southern Coalfield Resiliency and Revitalization program to identify and prioritize existing resources that can be directed to support economic development efforts in the Boone, Logan, McDowell, Mingo, and Wyoming counties; establish a revitalization council to manage these activities; and provide technical assistance support, services, and resources to support community revitalization of the Southern Coalfield counties.

title: Limiting amount event tickets can be sold for above original price
description: The purpose of this bill is to forbid reselling tickets to events in this state at more than a 3% markup from the face value of the ticket.

title: Provide an increase in salary to WV Birth to Three contracted therapists and employees
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase payment for professional service provided to the West Virginia Birth-to-Three program by therapists and other professionals who are not employed by a state agency by 25 percent.

title: Cap the amount of family income eligible for Hope Scholarships
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a cap on the amount of family income eligible for the Hope Scholarship.

title: Drug-Related Nuisances
description: The purpose of this bill is to create legal procedures and penalties for drug related nuisances.

title: Relating to establishing an additional modification reducing federal adjusted gross income relating to taxes on tips and overtime
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish an additional modification reducing federal adjusted gross income relating to taxes on tips and overtime.

title: To establish a phased implementation of a Community-Based Child Welfare system in West Virginia.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a community-based child welfare system program.

title: Relating to patient-centered treatment flexibility within the Public Employees Insurance Agency
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow a patient who has received prior authorization from the Public Employees Insurance Agency for treatment of a medical condition to receive an alternative covered treatment for the same condition without additional prior authorization, provided the alternative treatment is medically appropriate and does not exceed the cost of the originally authorized treatment.

title: Increase the penalty for adults who buy vapes and cartiges for underage children
description: The purpose of this bill is to create penalties for adults who purchase tobacco products for underage children.

title: To allow for the WVSSAC to pull coaching certificates of coaches who are found guilty of illegal recruiting
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow the WVSSAC to pull the coaching credentials of any coach found guilty of illegally recruiting students.

title: To exempt the first $20,000 of earnings from the state income tax for West Virginia residents
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt the first $20,000 of income of resident individuals from personal income taxation.

title: To increase the pay for retired state employees by 5% over three years beginning in 2025
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a gradual increase in state retirement benefits through July 1, 2028.

title: To require all state employees, county employees, and employees of county school boards to be subject to random drug testing
description: The purpose of this bill is to require mandatory drug testing for all classes of employees of county commissions, the state of West Virginia, State Board of Education, and in K through 12 schools.

title: Relating to preliminary planning for future electric substations near industrial parks on certain high voltage transmission lines
description: The purpose of this bill is to require electric substations be located near industrial parks for certain high voltage transmission lines.

title: To expressly prohibit motorcycle lane splitting and lane filtering in West Virginia while preserving a motorcycle’s full use of a lane
description: The purpose of this bill is to expressly prohibit motorcycle lane splitting and lane filtering in West Virginia while preserving a motorcycle's full use of a lane.

title: Relating to raising the state minimum salary for teachers to $50,000 beginning in school year 2026-2027
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a minimum salary of $50,000 for teachers and providing at least a $2,000 salary increase for all teachers.

title: Relating generally to persons porhibited from possessing firearms.
description: The purpose of this bill relates generally to persons prohibited from possessing firearms.

title: To consolidate county boards of education and create regional districts.
description: The purpose of this bill is to consolidate county school boards into 11 regional districts.

title: To add definitions for special plates of Class G Vehicles
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the requirements needed before approving production of license plates.

title: Relating to authorizing municipalities to adopt an ordinance to recover demolition costs as special tax assessments
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit municipalities to adopt an ordinance to recover demolition costs as special tax assessments.

title: Permitting Workforce WV to actively reach out to Unemployment Compensation filers with available jobs that fit their prior job history and salary range
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit Workforce West Virginia to provide unemployment claimants with information from private employers, including positions tailored to their prior job history and salary range.

title: Reinstituting the maintenance of actions for alienation of affection and criminal conversation
description: The purpose of this bill is to reinstitute the maintenance of civil actions for alienation of affection and criminal conversation

title: To establish civil liability for judges who knowingly violate the law, conduct unlawful hearings, or abuse litigants in the performance of their duties
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Judicial Accountability and Civil Liability Act."

title: Relating to state psychiatric hospital designations
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish that a psychiatric hospital with an average annual inpatient census patient mix of greater than 95 percent of court-ordered forensic and civil involuntary commitments from state custody or from a state-owned hospital qualifies as a "state-designated facility" for purposes of the statute.

title: Make West Virginia Healthy Act of 2026
description: Relating generally to the reestablishment of a statewide Healthy Lifestyles program

title: Authorizing the Department of Commerce to promulgate a legislative rule relating to certification of a microgrid district or certification as a high impact data center
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the Department of Commerce to promulgate a legislative rule relating to certification of a microgrid district or certification as a high impact data center.This section is new; therefore,

title: Generic use of antipsychotics in Medicaid
description: The purpose of this bill is to narrow the scope of prior authorization mandates for FDA approved antipsychotics.

title: Relating to strategic and critical resources, state preemption of local regulation, and foreign ownership and restricted commerce entities
description: The purpose of this bill is to promote the development and availability of strategic and critical resources through uniform statewide regulation, to reserve regulatory authority to the state and federal governments, and to preempt local regulation except as expressly provided.

title: Relating to providing additional ground for abandonment finding in an adoption proceeding
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the termination of parental rights upon certain convictions of crime.

title: Relating to the creation of the Safety and Violence Education for Students Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Safety and Violence Education for Students Act.

title: To impose a life sentence on fentanyl dealers
description: The purpose of this bill is to impose a life sentence on fentanyl dealers.

title: Professional Firefighter cancer screening
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish an early detection cancer screening pilot program for active and retired firefighters.

title: Relating to crimes using gift cards
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the crime of gift card fraud, providing definitions, and establishing punishments.

title: West Virginia First Energy Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to restore electric-rate stability through the continued utilization of in-state coal generation; preserve employment and investment in West Virginia's coal and natural-gas industries; and coordinate with the Electric Grid Stabilization and Security Fund to sustain dependable baseload and mid-load generation capacity statewide.

title: Relating to the creation of an alternative procurement procedure called the “general contractor/construction manager” procedure, and authorizing the Division of Highways to promulgate rules thereabout.
description: The purpose of this chapter is to authorize the use of certain alternative contracting procedures, to prescribe appropriate requirements to ensure that such contracting procedures serve the public interest, and to establish a process for evaluation of such contracting procedures.

title: Relating to authorizing green flashing warning lights on Division of Highways vehicles, and other equipment at the discretion of the Commissioner of Highways.
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow green flashing warning lights to be used by the Division of Highways, and other vehicles at the discretion of the Commissioner of Highways.

title: Relating to utility lines on the Division of Highways rights of way
description: The purpose of this bill is to is to facilitate timely utility relocation whenever the relocation is properly completed within the dates established by the DOH. This will reduce project delays.

title: Require the use of video cameras in certain special education classrooms
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the creation of "Oscar's Law." The bill addresses video cameras within special education classrooms. The bill provides protections for nonverbal and autistic children.

title: Relating to bail in cases involving terroristic threats to schools or children
description: The purpose of this bill is to creating mandatory bail conditions for individuals charged with making terrorist threats against a school, or a similar location.

title: Relating to residency restrictions for persons convicted of terroristic threats
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit persons convicted of felony terroristic threats under Â§61-6-24 of this code involving schools or children from residing within 1,000 feet of an educational facility, consistent with existing residency restrictions for certain sex offenders under Â§62-12-26 of this code, to enhance public safety and prevent unsafe proximity to child-populated locations post-conviction.

title: Provide for a raise for private investigators hired by public defender offices or court appointed panel attorneys
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the hourly rate for private investigators working for Public Defender Services from $30 to $45.

title: Relating to crimes against athletic officials
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the criminal and administrative penalties for assault or battery on athletic officials or participants.

title: Prohibit the use of school resources in election advocacy efforts and prohibit school employees from political activity during their work hours or on behalf of the school administration
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the use of school resources in election advocacy efforts. The bill also prohibits school employees from political activity during work hours or engaging in such activity on behalf of the school administration.

title: Prohibiting the termination of employment of an employee who defends themselves from an attack inside workplace
description: The purpose of this bill is to protect workers who defend themselves or others from an attack from another from termination of employment.

title: In cases of mine rescues, designate miners as first responders
description: The purpose of this bill is to require mandatory mine safety programs to promulgate rules that provide for the designation of first responders from the crew working in the mine trained to prevent, detect, and fight fires, as well as responding to emergencies, emergency mine evacuation, communication, and assistance and cooperation with mines rescue crews and teams.

title: Relating to the process for involuntary hospitalization
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify who may order involuntary hospitalizations and when mental hygiene petitions may be filed after involuntary treatment.

title: Relating generally to PANS and PANDAS.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide health coverage for PANS/PANDAS.

title: Providing liability protection for video cameras in certain classrooms.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide liability protections for actions against a county board of education, public charter school, or against an employee using a clear and convincing evidence standard.

title: Relating to clarifying secondary sources are not the law and public policy of West Virginia in certain instances
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that secondary sources are not the law and public policy of West Virginia in certain instances; and permitting the use of certified questions on issues of first impression in certain circumstances.

title: Creating an income tax deduction for gym memberships
description: The purpose of this bill is to create an income tax exemption for memberships to gyms in West Virginia and to set the exemption at $60 per month with a total of $720 per year.

title: Relating to a State Water Resources Management Plan
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish reporting requirements for underground water extracted in growth counties.

title: Relating to zoning ordinances and their effects
description: The purpose of this bill relates to zoning ordinances and their effects; and defines the word "use" to mean "domestic use, farming, or activities on the land from where water was drawn, and not extraction for transport to another jurisdiction via bottling, storage, pipeline or otherwise."

title: Prohibiting institutions of higher education and affiliate organizations from accepting gifts partnerships, or other funding relationships from foreign adversaries.
description: The purpose of this bill relates to prohibiting institutions of higher education and affiliate organizations from accepting gifts, grants, contracts, research sponsorships, partnerships, or other funding relationships from foreign adversaries. The bill provides legislative findings. The bill defines terms. The bill establishes reporting and enforcement mechanisms. The bill prohibits Confucius Institutes and other adversary-affiliated programs. The bill authorizes additional adversary designations. The bill sets July 1, 2026, as the effective date.

title: Allow removal of complaints from HRC to Circuit Court
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit removal of matters before the Human Rights Commission to the circuit court.

title: Providing for in-year school personnel movement to meet school needs.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for in-year school personnel movement to meet school needs.

title: Requiring the Commissioner of Highways to develop a formula for allocating road funds among districts
description: The purpose of this bill is to incentivize counties to utilize local revenue sources for the purpose of construction, reconstruction, and maintaining roads and rights-of-way within said counties by requiring the state road commissioner to set aside 20 percent of the state road fund for the purpose of reimbursing said counties on a matching basis and to require the Commissioner of Highways to develop a formula for allocating road funds among districts, for the benefit of the counties; to make legislative findings; to require the commissioner to solicit and consider public comments; to require the commissioner to consider certain factors when developing the formula; and to require the commissioner to submit the formula to the Legislature for approval as a legislative rule.

title: Modification to real property tax requirements for farm structures
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify real property tax requirements for farm structures.

title: Relating to the Respiratory Care Interstate Compact
description: The purpose of this bill is to facilitate the interstate practice of respiratory therapy with the goal of improving public access to respiratory therapy services by providing respiratory therapists licensed in a member state the ability to practice in other member states.

title: To clarify those required to register sex offenders, who must register temporary addresses
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify how those required to register sex offenders, who have no permanent residence, can satisfy their legal obligation.

title: Establishing a one-time American Legion Post Support Grant Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a one-time American Legion Post Support Grant Program administered by the Department of Veterans Assistance. The bill authorizes the department to distribute $10 million in equal amounts to all active American Legion posts in West Virginia without requiring individual applications. The program supports capital needs, operational improvements. and veteran service activities conducted by American Legion posts. The bill further provides for reporting requirements and establishes a sunset provision upon completion of the distribution.

title: All lanes, cul-de-sacs, dead end roads, city streets and non-through routes with an ADT of less than 10 per .1 mile be eliminated from WVDOH maintenance. ROW will be maintained on paper only and county WVDOH budgets will not be reduced.
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate certain roads from the Division of Highway's maintenance and maintaining rights-of-way on paper without reducing county budgets.

title: Relating to requirements for deputy sheriffs
description: The purpose of this bill is to raise all bonds to $500,000.

title: To prohibit a convicted felons of sexual assault, or abuse of juveniles on public school property
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit those listed on the state sex offender database, convicted felons of sexual assault, or persons convicted of abuse of juveniles from entering school property or attending public school activities and events. The bill also requires parent teacher conferences for those persons to be conducted off school grounds. Finally, the bill permits the State Board of Education to promulgate rules.

title: Relating to the limited circumstances in which a registered nurse may administer anesthetics.
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow for registered nurses to administer anesthetics in limited circumstances.

title: Relating to expanding the programs to be included in the annual capitation rate review.
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand the programs to be included in the annual capitation rate review to now include the Aged and Disable Waiver Program, the Personal Care Services Program, and the Traumatic Brain Injury Waiver Program.

title: Relating to permitting a citizen of this state to vote in the election of a municipality in which the citizen does not reside
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit a citizen of this state to vote in the election of a municipality in which the citizen does not reside when the citizen pays service or user fees to the municipality.

title: Relating to the Waiving of Certain DMV Fees for Volunteer Firefighters
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the fees for license plates, vehicle registration, operator's licenses, registration, and inspection fees for volunteer fire fighters. The bill also provides for the issuance of a special license plate for elected officials, military members, organizations, youth organizations, and others.

title: Allowing the burning of obsolete farm structures.
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow the burning of obsolete farm structures under certain conditions.

title: Account for all federal unfunded mandates
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Unfunded Federal Mandate Accountability Act. The bill provides for legislative findings. The bill sets forth definitions. The bill provides for the Governor's authority. The bill sets forth a period of comprehensive review. The bill provides for cost documentation. The bill sets forth the requirements for a report. This bill provides for bill and amendment preparation. The bill provides for integrating the process in the budget report. Finally, the bill provides for an effective date.

title: Relating to eminent domain and use of property taken.
description: The purpose of this bill relates generally to the use of property taken by eminent domain.

title: To create the Small-Town Main Street Recovery Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Small Town Main Street Recovery Act.

title: Relating to Volunteer Fire Departments
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the time in which to pay charges levied for services by a county fire prevention unit from 75 days to 180 days.

title: Authorizing adjustment from federal adjusted gross income for certain law enforcement pension benefit payments
description: The purpose of this bill relates to pension benefits which are exempt from income taxation. The bill adds Division of Natural Resources police, deputy sheriffs, full-time firefighters, and municipal police officers into the class of law-enforcement officers exempted.

title: To standardize reporting practices and improve forensic and public health research by including vaccination history in death investigations
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow the Fatality and Mortality Review Team under the Department of Health to access vaccination records in death investigations.

title: Prevention of data center collection of citizen data
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Citizens' Data Center Transparency Act. The bill creates a prohibition on use of data centers for unconstitutional surveillance.

title: Pro-Growth Regulatory Reform Act of 2026
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Pro-growth Regulatory Reform Act.

title: Relating to biometric privacy
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Genomic Information Privacy Act of 2026, requiring biometric privacy; requiring an entity to provide consumer information regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of genetic data; providing for limitations and exclusions; providing for genomic information storage requirements; prohibiting the use, sale or transfer of genomic information to foreign adversaries; providing for enforcement authority; providing a private right of action and providing definitions.

title: Requiring medication-assisted treatment prgrams to have written policies concerning community relations
description: The purpose of this bill is to require medication-assisted treatment programs to have written policies concerning community relations and provide public notice.

title: The sovereignty of law and judicial authority in the State of West Virginia.
description: The purpose of this bill is to relating to the sovereignty of law and judicial authority in West Virginia, prohibiting parallel legal systems, and providing a cause of action for violations of this article.

title: Protecting our Republic Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to require residents of West Virginia who desire to vote or run for or hold public office to be natural born citizens of the United States, effective January 1, 2028.

title: Establishing the Affordable Electricity and Economic Growth Act of 2026 to facilitate coke production and steel-making in the state
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Affordable Electricity and Economic Growth Act of 2026 to facilitate coke production and steel-making in the state.

title: Fueling Modern Life
description: The purpose of this bill is to abolish the provisions in Â§2-5-1 et seq., Air Pollution Control in said code and in lieu thereof, establish the Fueling Modern Life Act, stating Legislative findings and establishing state policy relating to carbon dioxide.

title: Establishing Comprehensive Highway Paving Plan
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Commissioner of Highways to prepare and present to the Legislature a comprehensive highway paving plan establishing routine repaving of all normally asphalt-surfaced roads.

title: Electric Utility Meter choice
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that all electricity providers give their customers a choice between the smart meters and manually read meters that are installed on their homes, businesses, or rental units.

title: Prohibit a child in the custody of the state from placement in facility not approved by Department of Human Services
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit a child in the custody of the state from being placed in a nonapproved facility. The bill provides for exceptions.

title: Raising salaries for school service personnel
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a $900 monthly increase to state school service personnel.

title: To create the Rural County Stabilization and Grant Flexibility Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the grant process for counties.

title: Changing the recommended guidelines for full-day and half-day cooks to the minimum ratio of one cook for every 110 meals
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the minimum ratio of school cooks to one cook for every 110 meals prepared and served.

title: Modifying the West Virginia State Police Retirement System
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the lowering of the age of retirants from the West Virginia State Police Retirement System that are eligible to receive an annual annuity adjustment.

title: To create the Mobile Career and Technical Education Classroom Program.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Mobile Career and Technical Education Classroom Program.

title: To ensure virtual instruction for foster students while in temporary placement facilities.
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure that foster children awaiting residential placement shall continue to receive education through virtual learning.

title: Provide wardens with ability to use inmates to perform work in the upkeep local cemeteries
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize use of inmates to perform work in the upkeep of local cemeteries.

title: Make all state inmates regardless of sex members of the state convict road force
description: The purpose of this bill is to make all state inmates regardless of sex members of the state convict road force.

title: To modify the teacher retirement system so that Tier 2 teachers may use annual/sick leave towards retirement
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow accrued annual or sick leave to be used for retirement service credit in the Teachers Retirement System.

title: To provide a 5% cost of living increase for state retirees who make under $60,000 per year
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a one-time cost-of-living supplement to retirement benefits of under $75,000 a year.

title: To institute safeguards to verify educational quality for homeschooled students, particularly concerning core subjects and manufactured grades
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a 90-day time limit for a child involved in an active truancy or pre-petition process to withdraw for homeschooling.

title: Relating to requiring the counties particpating in the QMHP Pilot Program to have at least one qualified mental health professional in each public school in that county.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the counties participating in the QMHP Pilot Program to have at least one qualified mental health professional ("QMHP") in each public school in that county. The bill establishes the pilot program. Finally, the bill classifies school counselors as QMHPs.

title: Changing the expiration date on Hunting and Fishing licenses to one year after purchase
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the beginning and expiration of hunting and fishing licenses from the last day of the calendar year for which they were issued to a year from the date of issue.

title: Permit beneficiary under the State Teachers Retirement System to convert to the maximum life annuity if the spouse dies within the first five years of the beneficiary’s retirement
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit a beneficiary under the State Teachers Retirement System who has been approved for a retirement with a joint life annuity to convert to the maximum life annuity if the spouse dies within the first five years of the beneficiary's retirement.

title: To create the Rural Mobile Health and Mental Health Access Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Rural Mobile Health Services Program Act.

title: Require that notice be provided for any lab-grown food served in restaurants.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that any product sold for consumption in a restaurant containing or composed of any "Analogue product", "Cell-cultured product", and/or "Food product" as defined in West Virginia Code Â§19-39-2 be clearly and legibly labeled as such on all menus for the informed consent of consumers considering the purchase of such items for consumption.

title: Relating to cultural heritage institutions
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize cultural heritage institutions to claim title to certain property in possession of the cultural heritage institution after providing certain notices.

title: Relating to Decentralized Unincorporated Nonprofit Associations
description: The purpose of this bill is to make decentralized unincorporated nonprofit associations a recognized legal entity in the state and create the Decentralized Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act.

title: Relating to the consolidation of county school districts in the state.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a commission to formulate a proposed plan to consolidate West Virginia's 55 county-based school districts into no more than 15 or no less than 10 regional school districts.

title: To create the Healthy Moms, Healthy Babies Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to improve maternity and infant care by creating the Healthy Moms, Healthy Babies Act.

title: To permit the county commission to appoint a county commissioner to a convention and visitor’s bureau as a voting member
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the county commission to appoint a county commissioner to a convention and visitor's bureau as a voting member.

title: Relating to municipalities that have failed to complete required financial audits for multiple years
description: The purpose of this bill relates to municipalities that have failed to complete required financial audits for multiple years; modify definitions; clarify fiscal emergency conditions; authorize State Auditor to evaluate a municipality's likelihood of financial recovery; allow for the transition to dissolution; provide notice to municipalities; clarify duties of receiver upon dissolution; and confirm the effect of municipal dissolution on utilities governed by the Public Service Commission.

title: Relating to hotel occupancy tax.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that the proper political subdivision is receiving the collected occupancy tax from a marketplace facilitator.

title: Relating to prohibiting the release of addresses and names of employers of persons who make contributions to political elections
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the release of addresses and names of employers of persons who make contributions to political elections and providing misdemeanor criminal penalty.

title: Relating to the powers and duties of the director of the Division of Administrative Services
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the authority to enter into agreements with law-enforcement agencies of the Department of Homeland Security to seek certain grant funds.

title: Professional firefighter cancer screening
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish an early detection cancer screening pilot program for active and retired firefighters.

title: Establish setback from residential properties for new windmills being constructed throughout the state.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a minimum distance from residences and certain infrastructure for wind turbines in order for the commission to award a siting certificate for a wind energy system.

title: To permit and require real estate brokerage firms to pay realtors leaving the commission they are entitled on open contracts.
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the licensee, after leaving a brokerage and going to a new brokerage, to be actively licensed with two brokerages for 60 days in order to receive payments on open commissions.

title: Creating the oral health and cancer rights act
description: The purpose of this bill is to require health benefit plan coverage for medically necessary dental procedures that result from cancer treatment; create the Oral Health and Cancer Rights Act; explain the scope of procedures covered as a result of certain cancer treatments; and require the use of a specific billing identifier;

title: Creating the TechCred Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the TechCred program.

title: To allow for the transfer of seniority for deputy sheriffs with conditions
description: The purpose of this bill is to transfer seniority with deputy sheriffs who transfer to vacant positions unless they have committed a wrongdoing at the county from where they are transferring.

title: Relating to changing the allocation of proceeds in the Medical Cannabis Program Fund.
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the allocation of proceeds in the Medical Cannabis Program Fund.

title: Relating to non-uniform DCR pay raises
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a 15 percent raise to non-uniformed workers within the Division of Corrections and Rehabilitation.

title: Related to free filing of state tax returns
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a system to prohibit tax preparation software companies from charging taxpayers a fee to electronically file their West Virginia State tax returns.

title: Related to Mental Health Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Mental Health and Substance Use Disorders Insurance Coverage Protection Act.

title: Related to child tax credit
description: The purpose of this bill is to create and authorize a state child tax credit for eligible children.

title: Related to childcare workers
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a subsidy for child care services rendered to children of child care program employees.

title: Related to 12 weeks of paid leave
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a state sponsored medical and family leave insurance program for all persons employed or self-employed in the state; providing eligibility and coverage conditions; directing the Insurance Commissioner to administer the program; providing up to 12 weeks of eligible coverage annually; requiring employers to allow family leave to insured employees; protecting employees from retaliatory actions; providing notice of availability to employees; providing for a special revenue account; establishing public education program; annual reports to the Legislature; and legislative rules to implement the program.

title: Related to establishing a free business registration holiday
description: The purpose of this bill is to waive the $100 fee for a new for-profit business or domestic corporation to obtain a license in this state.

title: Related to menstrual products in correctional facilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that free feminine hygiene products be provided to female prisoners in all jails, regional jails or state correctional facilities and female juveniles in juvenile detention.

title: Related to paid leave
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a paid parental leave pilot program.

title: Related to refundable child tax credit
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the non-refundable child tax credit and create and authorize a refundable child tax credit.

title: Related to troubled teen industry
description: The purpose of this bill is to regulating private alternative adolescent residential or outdoor programs by the Director of the Office of Health Facility Licensure and Certification.

title: Relating to peer support services
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow for privileged testimonial communications between a peer support team member and an individual receiving peer support services or advice from the team member.

title: Relating to Interstate Cosmetology Licensure Compact.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Interstate Cosmetology Licensure Compact, create the Interstate Cosmetology Licensure Compact Commission, and provide for the administration of the Compact.

title: Relating to Natural Resource Police Officer Retirement
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the West Virginia Natural Resources Police Officer Retirement System accrued benefit for members who retire after July 1, 2026, and to provide funding for the benefit,

title: Relating to public school acceptance of student transcripts or other credentials
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for verified mastery of content standards for transcripts when a student enrolls or re-enrolls in a public school in this state.

title: To eliminate all vaccine requirements for school children
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit mandates for vaccinations of school children.

title: Relating to duties of licensees under the West Virginia Real Estate License Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a written agency agreement prior to engaging in brokerage services.

title: Relating to certification of a patient’s eligibility for medical cannabis
description: The purpose of this bill is to grant authority to attending physicians to use his or her professional judgement to certify that a patient's serious medical condition would benefit from the use of medical cannabis.

title: Permitting certain felons to work in licensed behavioral health facilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit certain felons to work in licensed behavioral health facilities. The bill sets conditions and limitations. The bill requires rulemaking.

title: Prohibiting the private ownership or operation of a prison
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the private ownership or operation of prison facilities in West Virginia.

title: Providing tax credits to provide vehicles to certain persons
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a tax credit to facilitate the purchase of reliable and affordable vehicles to low-income working West Virginia men and women to expand access to employment opportunities.

title: Relating to removing services from requiring a certificate of need
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove personal care services and Intellectual development disabilities services from certificate of need.

title: Require hospitals with no ASL interpreter on staff provide technology for hearing or speech impaired patients to communicate
description: The purpose of this bill is to require facilities to provide patients and family members or caregivers of deaf and hard of hearing patients with effective means of communication assistance.

title: Creation of the MOBILE ID.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the MOBILE ID Act and to establish the Mobile Outreach for Bound or Immobile Lifelong Ensurance of Identification Program within the Division of Motor Vehicles.

title: Relating to restitution payments for the support of a child whose parent or guardian is a victim of intoxication manslaughter
description: The purpose of this bill is to require restitution payments for child support of a child whose parent or guardian is a victim of a DUI causing death.

title: Transferring all regulatory and enforcement responsibilities for CBD and Kratom from the Department of Agriculture to the Alcohol Beverage Control Administration.
description: The purpose of this bill is to transfer all regulatory and enforcement responsibilities for CBD and Kratom from the Department of Agriculture to the Alcohol Beverage Control Administration.

title: The Joanna Phillips Domestic Violence Prevention Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Joanna Phillips Domestic Violence Prevention Act; create and increase penalties for certain acts of domestic violence; and change bail requirement for domestic violence.

title: Relating to coverage for the treatment of stuttering
description: The purpose of this bill is to require habilitative speech therapy as a treatment for stuttering insurance coverage.

title: Relating to requiring the Office of Health Facility Licensure and Certification to inspect office-based medication-assisted treatment programs at least every 24 months
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Office of Health Facility Licensure and Certification to inspect office-based medication-assisted treatment programs at least every 24 months.

title: Relating to requiring a parolee or probationer found to have suffered with addiction to participate in a support service
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that any inmate found to have exhibited signs of abuse or patterns of addiction of drugs and alcohol to require counseling for the inmate for a minimum of 60 days upon being released on parole.

title: Relating to financial exploitation of a person in recovery
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the financial exploitation of a person in recovery.

title: Relating to the Greater Huntington Park and Recreation District
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the funding of the Greater Huntington Park and Recreation District by permitting the Cabell County Board of Education to provide funds available to the board through special and excess levies to the park district.

title: Relating to requiring a court to verify certain conditions are met before a child who has been removed from a home may be returned to that home
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a court to verify that before a child who has been removed from a home may be returned to that home, that if a parent is participating in a medication-assisted treatment program he or she shall be successfully fulfilling their treatment obligations in the program.

title: To fund the Tobacco Use Cessation Initiative
description: The purpose of this bill is to fund the Tobacco Use Cessation Initiative.

title: Update the regulation of pharmacy benefit managers
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the duties and definition of pharmacy benefits management.

title: Amend section providing for waiver of tuition and fees for senior citizens auditing certain college classes
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand tuition and fee waivers or adjustments for senior citizens by including in the statute certain nonresident students and by decreasing the eligibility age from 65 years to 60 years of age or older.

title: To prohibit public colleges and universities in this state from requiring vaccines for admission.
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit vaccine mandates at all institutions of higher education.

title: Prohibiting laws requiring person to receive or use medical products
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure that no law may require a person to receive or use a medical product and to ensure that there will be no penalties associated with refusing the medical product or refusing to disclose whether the product has been used or not.

title: Relating to a patient’s right to choose physician
description: The purpose of this bill is to require medical professionals to obtain consent for a resident to treat a patient in advance of the appointment or procedure.

title: Remove sales tax on gun safes and certain firearm safety devices
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt sales of tangible personal property to safely store firearms, including, but not limited to, safes and trigger locks from the consumer sales tax.

title: To implement trauma-informed practices in schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the State Board of Education to implement trauma-informed practices in grades K-12.

title: Creating the Katherine Johnson and Dorothy Vaughan Fair Pay Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to state an employee's right to inquire about wages under the Katherine Johnson and Dorothy Vaughan Fair Pay Act. It requires an employer to provide wage range to applicants; and provides for civil and criminal penalties for violations.

title: Remove felonies from reason to disqualify from voting
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the prohibition on persons convicted of certain felonies from voter registration and to allow persons to re-register to vote following completion of their sentence or pardon; requiring the Division of Corrections to notify persons of their renewed eligibility to vote upon release; and requiring the Division of Probation to notify persons of their renewed voter eligibility upon discharge.

title: Provide for statewide participation in the federal Community Eligibility Provision for its duration
description: The purpose of this bill is to support statewide expansion of Healthy School Meals for All through maximizing participation in the Community Eligibility Provision or other meal options or by prioritizing expansion at the local level for under-resourced school districts with the greatest need.

title: Establishing the right to contraception
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a right to contraception.

title: MAHA - Menstrual Labeling Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to require packaging of menstrual products sold in this state to contain a plain and conspicuous printed list of all ingredients listed in order of predominance. The bill also imposes a civil penalty for violations.

title: To mandate county boards of education to provide feminine hygiene products in all public elementary, middle, and high schools for female students
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide free feminine hygiene products to students in public schools.

title: Creating the Affordable Medicaid Buy-in Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Insurance Medicaid" Buy-In Program. The bill requires the Department of Human Services to develop and administer the Insurance" Medicaid" Buy-In Plan. The bill creates the Health Care Affordability and Access Improvement Fund. The bill establishes an advisory council to the Insurance\ Medicaid "Buy-In Program. The bill requires a study and reposts be made. The bill defines terms. The bill sets limitations of employers. The bill requires rule-making.

title: Consumer Data Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to protect consumer data privacy by establishing a consumer right to request copy of personal data collected; establishing a consumer right to have personal information deleted or corrected; establishing a consumer right to request personal data sold or shared; establishing a consumer right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information to third parties; prohibiting discrimination against consumers who exercise their right under this article; establishing procedures for requests for personal information under this article; establish a form to opt out of sale or sharing of personal information; creating a private cause of action; empowering the West Virginia Division of Consumer Protection to establish rules under this article for enforcement; and empowering the West Virginia Division of Consumer Protection to bring suit for violation of this article.

title: Relating to the eligibility of nonpublic schools and education service providers to participate in the Hope Scholarship Program
description: The purpose of this bill generally relates to the eligibility of nonpublic schools and education service providers to participate in the Hope Scholarship Program.

title: Relating to fines for local fire departments
description: The purpose of this bill is to enhance penalties relating to crimes against law enforcement, firefighters, governmental representatives, health care providers, utility workers, correctional employees, and emergency medical service personnel; create a felony offense for attacking or hindering or obstructing a firefighter or emergency equipment; and create criminal penalties.

title: To make it explicit that both the lottery fund and the excess lottery fund can be utilized for early childhood education throughout West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that funds from the Lottery Education Fund, the State Lottery fund, and the Excess Lottery Fund be used for childhood education in the state.

title: Allowing the Secretary of State’s office to transmit electronically the total ballots cast, counted, and rejected
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that the boards of canvassers transmit electronically to the Secretary of State, on a form prescribed by the Secretary of State, the total ballots cast, counted, and rejected.

title: To amend the section of child marriage under 18
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that any 16 or 17 year old who seeks a marriage license from the county clerks of this state be a West Virginia resident.

title: Change the powers of the West Virginia Water Development Authority regarding funding of Infrastructure Projects
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the power of the Water Development Authority; to fund infrastructure projects recommended by the Secretary of Commerce, the Secretary of Economic Development and/or the Secretary of Tourism; and providing that funding may only be used for in-state eligible projects.

title: Permitting civil remedies for the unauthorized disclosure of intimate images
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit a civil action for the unauthorized disclosure of an intimate image, to permit civil remedies for the unauthorized disclosure of intimate images, to provide a short title, to create definitions, to provide for a civil action, to provide exceptions to liability, to provide for plaintiff's privacy, to provide for remedies, to create a statute of limitations, to provide for construction, to provide for uniformity of application and construction, and, finally, to create an effective date.

title: Establish food desert produce pilot program
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a food desert program to provide communities with access to fresh and affordable produce.

title: Develop a new method to determine the minimum number of hours per day and per school year to be spent on instructional time.
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the 180 mandatory days of school and move to a model based on hours.

title: Permitting anyone age of 65 or older to vote absentee
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow voters 65 and older to vote absentee.

title: Small Business Investment Grant Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Small Business Investment Fund.

title: Establish Food Waste Task Force
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the food waste task force.

title: Authorizing certain motor vehicle manufactures to operate as new car dealers
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize certain zero emission motor vehicle manufacturers to operate as new car dealers in West Virginia.

title: Exempting county school buses from paying the toll fees
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt school buses from having to pay toll fees.

title: Relating to law enforcement warrant for third party information
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a warrant for the disclosure of certain third-party information.

title: Authorizing municipal fire departments specialized license plates
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the Division of Motor Vehicles to issue special motor vehicle plates for municipal fire department vehicles.

title: Employer discriminatory practices
description: The purpose of this bill is to include certain employers with two or more employees subject to actions for discriminatory practices before the human rights commission; to include individual independent contractors in the definition of "employee"; and to increase the time period in which to bring an action before the human rights commission to three years after the alleged act of discrimination.

title: Requiring medical insurance providers to include infertility services in their policies
description: The purpose of this bill is to require medical insurance providers to include infertility services in their policies. The bill makes findings. The bill provides for determination of infertility. The bill provides prohibited and permissible limitations on coverage. The bill requires rule-making. The bill establishes an effective date. The bill provides for severability. The bill defines terms.

title: Relating to vintage distilled spirits
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the sale and distribution of vintage distilled spirits by the drink.

title: Relating to Social Media privacy and educational institutions
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish social media privacy for current and prospective students or employees of higher education institutions operating in the state of West Virginia for content not publicly available on the internet.

title: Relating to wholesale importation of prescription drugs
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Wholesale Prescription Drug Importation Program for the purpose of importing drugs from Canada on behalf of the state. The program will operate in compliance with the federal Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) regulations governing importation of prescription drugs and with approval of the secretary of HHS.

title: Relating to portable benefit plans
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for voluntary portable insurance plans.

title: Relating to drug scheduling
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove certain substances from schedule I of the Uniform Controlled Substances Act, including marihuana, Psilocybin, and Tetrahydrocannabinols.

title: Requiring full text of proposed Constitutional amendments be included on official ballots
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that the full text of proposed amendments to the Constitution of the State of West Virginia be included on ballots used in the election at which amendments are submitted to the voters of the state.

title: Student Bill of Rights
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the creation of the Student Bill of Rights.

title: Establishing the West Virginia Prescription Drug Affordability Board
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia Prescription Drug Affordability Board; provide definitions; provide for the creation of a Board and the composition, compensation, and duties associated with the Board; provide for the creation of a stakeholder council and the composition, and duties associated with the Council; provide disclosures of conflicts of interest and requiring adherence to the Ethics Act; require a study and report on transparency data on prescription drug products; provide a cost review of prescription drug products with affordability challenges; require confidentiality; establish a fund; provide for enforcement; clarify drug products eligible; provide remedies; and list all report requirements.

title: Establishing the West Virginia Secure Choice retirement program
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a Secure Choice trust as an instrumentality of the state to hold employee payroll deductions, contributions, and earnings on the contributions and to establish a Secure Choice administrative fund in the state treasury as a fund separate and apart from the Secure Choice trust for employers engaged in a business, industry, profession, trade, or other enterprise in West Virginia, whether for profit or not for profit, who have five or more covered employees and the employers do not sponsor or contribute to and did not in the immediately preceding 12 months sponsor or contribute to a retirement savings plan for its employees.

title: Creating the Office of Entrepreneurship within the Office of Economic Development
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish an Office of Entrepreneurship within the Office of Economic Development.

title: Relating to the disconnection of residential utility during a State of Emergency
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit public utilities from terminating or disconnecting services during a state of emergency declared by executive order; to create a duty to restore service; to require public utility to enter into deferred payment agreement with residential customer during state of emergency; to prohibit public utility from disconnecting service for 180 days providing notice to residential customer; and to establish right of public utilities to recover funds owed in normal course following the state of emergency.

title: To provide for the coordination of programs to prevent and treat obesity
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide insurance coverage for GLP-1 class medications with a valid script.

title: Relating to statute of limitations for discrimination
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend the definition of employer and the number of persons employed to qualify as an employer; and to extend the period of the statute of limitations to file a complaint for an alleged unlawful discriminatory practice under the Human Rights Commission.

title: To prohibit convenience fees for tenant’s of rental properties
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit convenience fees for tenants of rental properties.

title: Second Look Sentencing Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a procedure for modification of a prison sentence when a person has served at least 10 years of a sentence.

title: Relating to childcare subsidies within DHHR, paid based on monthly enrollment
description: The purpose of this bill is to require child-care subsidies to be based on monthly enrollment rather than daily attendance.

title: Men’s Equality Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Men's Equality Act requiring 100 percent coverage under the West Virginia Public Employees Insurance plan for voluntary male sterilization.

title: Relating to withholding tax on income of nonresidents from natural resources royalty payments
description: The purpose of this bill is to require lessees of West Virginia real estate who make natural resources royalty payments for in-state property to any nonresident lessor to withhold West Virginia personal income tax on natural resources royalty payments and provides exceptions, penalties, defines terms, and grants rulemaking authority.

title: Prohibition of geoengineering
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Atmospheric Intervention Oversight and Public Safety Act.

title: To create the West Virginia Rural Mobility and Transportation Access Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Rural Mobility and Transportation Access Act to expand access to transportation in rural areas of West Virginia by maximizing federal funding, encouraging private, nonprofit, and local participation, supporting innovative transportation models, and coordinating existing resources, without the State owning or operating transportation systems.

title: Relating to the sales of tax liens
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the sale of tax liens.

title: Relating to exempting child-care programs operated by a county board of education exclusively for the children of its employees from certain licensing requirements
description: The purpose of this bill relates to exempting child-care programs operated by a county board of education exclusively for the children of its employees from certain licensing requirements. The bill also establishes rules to ensure the health, safety, and welfare of children enrolled in such programs.

title: Relating generally to the state fire marshal
description: The purpose of this bill relates generally to the qualifications and responsibilities of the State Fire Marshal.

title: To create the West Virginia Rural Property Safety and Clean Land Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Rural Property and Clean Land Act and establish objective, non-aesthetic, health- and safety-based standards governing excessive accumulation of waste materials, while preserving agricultural, industrial, and rural property uses.

title: To provide notice to any political committees violating the filing requirements prior to assessing any civil fines and giving the Secretary of State authority to grant additional time for compliance not to exceed an additional 14 days.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide notice to any political committees violating the filing requirements prior to assessing any civil fines and giving the Secretary of State authority to grant additional time for compliance not to exceed an additional 14 days.

title: Creating the Taxpayer Accountability for Public Service Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Taxpayer Accountability for Public Service Act providing that to be eligible as a candidate for public office a person shall prove that payment of taxes has been made.

title: To increase funding for EMS first responders.
description: The purpose of this bill is to transfer, after the end of each fiscal year from any remaining and available net profits in the State Lottery Fund, the sum of $12 million to the Emergency Medical Services Salary Enhancement Fund.

title: To provide a tax credit for new parents in this state in certain circumstances.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a state tax deduction for parents whose children qualify for a "Trump Account," as set forth in 26 USC 530A.

title: Relating to Capitol Carry
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the West Virginia Code to allow the constitutional right of open carry on and in Capitol grounds.

title: Relating to salary schedule adjustments for elected county officials.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a new salary schedule for county officials.

title: Relating to establishing the Low Earth Orbit Broadband Internet Connection Fund.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a new fund for expenditure to provide the installation of equipment used to receive Low Earth Orbit Broadband Internet Connections throughout the state.

title: To create the West Virginia Rural Littering and Illegal Dumping Prevention Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Littering and Illegal Dumping Prevention Act and enhance the penalties.

title: Legalize use of a 4" pan to pan for gold in the state
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize gold panning and have dates published showing when the season is open.

title: Relating to the Municipal Police Officers and Firefighters Retirement System.
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify unused leave accruals eligible for campus police officers to use for additional service credit upon retirement and technical clean up.

title: Relating to creating the animal abuse database within the West Virginia State Police.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the animal abuse database within the West Virginia State Police.

title: Sales tax rebate for qualifying materials used in the construction of modest homes of 1 600 square feet or less
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a state sales tax rebate for qualifying materials used in the construction of modest homes of 1,600 square feet or less, to limit the rebate to the state six percent sales tax, to permit voluntary municipal participation, to establish fixed material quantity limits.

title: To provide asset preservation for minors who earn income from artistic or creative services for us of their name, image, or likeness
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide asset preservation for minors who earn income from artistic or creative services for use of their name, image, or likeness.

title: Relating to auctioneers
description: The purpose of this bill is to update and clarify the laws on auctioneering.

title: When schools have events the school needs to sell tickets at the gate as well as online and accept cash
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that all public schools in this state who hold athletic events and charge admission shall sell tickets at the gate, accept cash as a form of payment, and offer the ability to purchase an admission ticket online.

title: Relating to removing the Certificate of Need moratorium on opioid treatment facilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the Certificate of Need Mortarium on opioid treatment programs.

title: Relating generally to authorizing security personnel employed by the State Treasurer to carry concealed weapons while performing his or her official duties
description: The purpose of this bill relates generally to authorizing security personnel employed by the State Treasurer to carry concealed weapons while performing his or her official duties.

title: Directing the Supreme Court of Appeals to create a pilot domestic violence court in Kanawha County
description: The purpose of this bill is to direct the Supreme Court of Appeals to assign appropriate judicial officers for a pilot domestic violence court in Kanawha County.

title: Prohibiting expanding drug and alcohol treatment facilities and services in certain counties
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the prohibition of adding more licensed substance abuse treatment beds in counties who currently have more than 250 substance abuse treatment beds.

title: Increasing access to contraceptive drugs, devices, and procedures
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide easier access to contraceptives and sterilization services.

title: Establishing of the West Virginia Public Participation Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia Public Participation Act. The bill provides additional protections to individuals and entities engaged in the exercise of the protected constitutional rights of free speech, freedom to petition, and freedom of association by allowing for the filing of a motion to dismiss in response to strategic lawsuits against public participation. The bill establishes procedures for reviewing strategic lawsuits against public participation and sets forth the applicability and limitations of the defense.

title: Relating to the members of the Public Service Commission
description: The purpose of this bill is to create greater accountability and public input in the operations of the Public Service Commission; to remove the appointment process so Commission members are elected by non-partisan elections; revising the removal process in commission to allow citizens to initiate removal for malfeasance and conflicts of interest; providing for reduced rates for qualifying low-income customers; and providing an accessible and more transparent method for consumers to participate in the utility ratemaking process.

title: Authorizing possession and smoking of medical cannabis by approved persons
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow the possession and smoking of medical marijuana by authorized persons.

title: Relating to the use of technology in child abuse and neglect investigations
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Department of Human Services to provide child welfare workers with mobile technology that will permit them to conduct investigations and create a digital record. This will upload to the system automatically and reduce the need for a child protective services worker to input data manually into a system. This will enhance service delivery to children. This data will allow managers to have real time access to data to conduct quality improvement analysis.

title: Increase conservation funding by $300,000, with the increase only to be allocated based on the head count of cattle and/or large livestock
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase conservation funding by $300,000, with the increase only to be allocated based on the head count of cattle and/or large livestock.

title: To place rumble strips on all double-yellow lined roads and highways.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require rumble strips on double-yellow lined roads.

title: School funding calculations should be the last three-year running average or the current enrollment, whichever is highest
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that the school funding calculations shall be the last three-year running average or the current enrollment, whichever is highest.

title: To eliminate adverse possession from the state code of West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill is to abolish the right to obtain title to land by adverse possession.

title: To ban calculators and math computational devices from K-8 grade classrooms.
description: The purpose of this bill is to ban calculators and math computational devices from K-8 grade classrooms.

title: Related to the authority of sheriff’s commission for collection of taxes.
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the allowable commission for tax collection by the sheriff.

title: Relating to allowing intergovernmental agreements with the Land Stewardship Corporation
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow intergovernmental agreements with the Land Stewardship Corporation.

title: Relating to Civil Action to Set Aside a Tax Deed
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the right to set aside deed when one entitled to notices was not properly notified. The bill changes the time that such parties have to institute a civil action to set aside the deed against state and local governments and their subdivisions from two years to one year.

title: Relating to crimes against the intellectually disabled
description: The purpose of this bill is to enhance the penalty for crimes committed against persons with a mental disability.

title: Relating to county parks and recreation commission
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize county courts to establish county PERCs, or county Parks, Entertainment, and Recreation Commissions.

title: Creating Office of entrepreneurship
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the office of entrepreneurship, provide for legislative oversight, authorize rulemaking authority, create an associated fund, and to provide an appropriation.

title: Requiring DOH public notification of traffic change 48 hours in advance
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide the public with 48 hours' notice of construction traffic changes.

title: Relating to permitting access to funding for public water utilities subject to the Public Service Commission’s jurisdiction
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend access to loan and grant funding from the Water Development Authority to non-governmental public utilities for assistance with distressed public water systems.

title: To forbid any municipality from issuing an ID for the purpose of voting in a municipal election
