description: The purpose of this bill is to forbid any municipality from issuing an ID for the purposes of voting in a municipal election.

title: Relating to establishing the Child Captivity Prevention Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure that when a child moves to this state and the parents or guardians intend to home school, that a student education and wellness assurance visit to the residence be conducted to verify that the child is not being abused or neglected.

title: Requiring the State Board of Education to create model policies on the use of technology and artifical intelligence in a public school classroom
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Balance Act. The bill provides for artificial intelligence standards. The bill sets forth definitions. The bill sets forth a county board of education policy for the use of artificial intelligence. The bill creates definitions for artificial intelligence. The bill provides resources for a student with a technology-related learning difficulty. Finally, the bill creates an AI sandbox course.

title: To make certain acts of panhandling and solicitation unlawful
description: The purpose of this bill is to make certain acts of panhandling and solicitation unlawful. The bill exempts fire departments, school organizations, and 501(c)(3) organizations. The bill provides misdemeanor penalties.

title: To increase the protections for the welfare of domestic animals
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide increased protections for the welfare of domestic animals in the care of animal shelters and private individuals.

title: The Family Justice Restoration and Due Process Act of 2026
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Child Protective Services Due Process and Child Protection Act.

title: Create a registry of persons convicted of animal abuse
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish an animal abuse registry.

title: Comprehesive reform of the state’s water infrastructure systems.
description: The purpose of this bill is to comprehensively reform the state's water and wastewater infrastructure, streamline and clarify the process for issuing certain state grants and loans for water and wastewater infrastructure projects, eliminating the Water Development Authority Board and reassigning any necessary functions, requiring additional reports and on-going training for city and county operators of public water and wastewater systems, allowing public water and wastewater systems to enter into Regional Cooperative Agreements, creating an Early Intervention Pilot Program for struggling public water and wastewater utilities, updating the methodology for the watch list for troubled public water and wastewater utilities, establishing an improvement period for public water and wastewater utilities on the watch list, and allowing for required memorandums of understanding when an identified acquiring utility is exempt from forced consolidation.

title: Relating to the identification of noncitizen residents on a driver’s license.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the designation "NC" on all lawful noncitizens' driver's licenses, identification cards, and temporary identification documents issued by the Department of Motor Vehicles for voter identification purposes and to ensure that all such licenses and identification cards issued are distinguishable from those of citizens' to ensure noncitizens are not capable of utilizing such documentation to vote.

title: Relating to financial aid for post-secondary education.
description: The purpose of this bill is to revise, update, and streamline the requirements for higher education grants, scholarships, loans, and financial aid for postsecondary education programs, workforce development initiatives, and workforce grants.

title: Relating to involuntary commitment process pilot program.
description: The purpose of this bill is to add counties to the involuntary commitment process pilot program.

title: Relating to drug testing of parents who have had abuse and/or neglect claims substantiated against them prior to reunification.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require parents with abuse and/or neglect claims substantiated against them to be drug tested prior to reunification.

title: Relating generally to limiting landowner liability for the purpose of operation of all-terrain vehicles.
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit landowner liability when certain persons operate an all-terrain vehicle.

title: Relating to community paramedicine programs
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the creation of community paramedicine programs.

title: Providing for a filing fee for a write-in candidate
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a filing fee for a write-in candidate.

title: Providing that the Secretary of State shall notify a respondent of an election law complaint
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that the Secretary of State shall notify a respondent of an election law complaint, and that the respondent shall provide a response within 10 business days.

title: Relating to defining residence for the purpose of registration and voting in West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill is to define residence for purposes of registration and voting.

title: Relating to clarifying persons permitted to be present in a polling place during an election period for non-voting activities that normally occur at that location
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify individuals permitted to be present in a polling place during an election period while voting is taking place for normal non-voting activities that normally occur at the location.

title: Relating to increasing the civil penalties for failure to file required campaign finance reports
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase civil penalties for failure to file required campaign finance reports.

title: Providing for an increase service of process fees and fees in shipping and handling expenses for execution of service of process
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for an increase in service of process fees and fees in shipping and handling expenses for execution of service of process by certified mail upon any defendant and to provide for certain exemptions for foreign veteran-owned businesses.

title: Relating to requiring contact information for the chair of a political committee
description: The purpose of this bill is add contact information of the committee chair and require and acknowledgment in the statement of organization that the committee must adhere to the reporting requirements set forth in the campaign finance laws of West Virginia.

title: Creating a personal income tax credit for election officials in West Virginia.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a $100 tax credit per election for service by an election official to West Virginia Personal income tax liabilities. The tax credit shall not exceed $200 for any taxable year.

title: Relating to prohibiting any person to operate an unmanned aerial vehicle over a polling place on election day
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit any person from operating an unmanned aerial vehicle over a polling place or within the electioneering zone on election day.

title: Providing that in no case shall a filing fee paid be returned to the candidate
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that a candidate's filing fee is not refundable, even if the candidate withdraws from the race or does not make it onto the ballot.

title: Relating to Secretary of State annual reports, fees, and veteran-owned business logotypes
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow the Secretary of State to charge a fee of up to $5 plus any amount passed on by a financial institution for any returned or dishonored check, money order, or draft. This fee covers the administrative costs for handling the returned item. The bill allows the Secretary of State discretion to waive late fees under certain circumstances. The bill provides that the Secretary of State shall design and provide a veteran-owned logotype.

title: Relating to clarifying the definition of electioneering
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the definition of electioneering; describe certain prohibited electioneering information or activity; exempt from the definition of "electioneering" certain activity and materials; permit certain persons to enforce election laws and maintain law and order inside the prohibited zone; and permit certain persons to seek assistance from law-enforcement officer.

title: Relating to filing of a fraudulent financing statement.
description: The purpose of this bill is to update acts constituting the filing of a fraudulent financing statement; filing of an affidavit and notice to secured parties; investigative powers of the Secretary of State; removing outdated provisions of code.

title: Modifying retirement and disability benefits for dependents of State Police
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the awards and benefits to dependents of State Police officers who must take disability retirement to better match the awards and benefits of the dependents of State Police retirants who serve 20 years without disability retirement.

title: The purpose of this bill is to require counties to utilize separate voting machines from those used for voting in an election, and to require testing of the automatic tabulating equipment prior to its use in an election.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require counties to utilize separate voting machines for training from those used for voting in an election, and to require testing of the automatic tabulating equipment prior to its use in an election if the machine was used for training purposes.

title: Creating the Police Partnering with Communities Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Police Partnering With Communities Act and create a new fund within the West Virginia State Treasurer's Office.

title: Relating to living anatomical gift
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish procedures and requirements for making a living anatomical gift.

title: Relating to requiring certain information with an absentee ballot
description: The purpose of this bill is to protect absentee voters' personal information from being displayed on the outside of an absentee ballot envelope sent through the mail, and to require personally identifiable information to be provided with an absentee ballot, which information is to be reviewed by county election officials and verified against official registration records to confirm the identity of absentee voters.

title: Back to school sales tax holiday
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the back-to-school sales tax holiday amount.

title: The purpose of this bill is to ensure compliance with state law requiring ballot tabulating equipment to not be connected to the internet, by requiring random inspections by the Secretary of State, including all necessary reporting.
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure compliance with state law requiring ballot tabulating equipment to not be connected to the internet, by requiring random inspections by the Secretary of State, including all necessary reporting.

title: Maintaining the solvency of the Unemployment Compensation Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the Governor to borrow money from the Revenue Shortfall Reserve Fund to fund the Unemployment Compensation Fund when federal layoffs deplete the Unemployment Compensation Fund.

title: Screening for adverse childhood experiences
description: The purpose of this bill is to require screenings for adverse childhood experiences.

title: To increase the minimum starting salary for a teacher to $50,000
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the state minimum salary schedule for teachers; and to raise the state minimum salary for teachers to $50,000.

title: Authorizing a temporary foreign brewers import license
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize temporary 30-day licenses for out-of-state nonintoxicating beer brewers to import beer for test marketing and distribute to festivals and samplings.

title: Relating to insurance coverage for breast cancer screening
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish insurance provisions required relating to breast cancer screenings.

title: State Living Donor Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit an insurer from declining or limiting coverage on a person under any life insurance policy, major medical coverage policy, disability insurance policy, or long-term care insurance policy solely due to the status of that person as a living organ donor.

title: Allowing a bar to purchase liquor from a distillery or a mini-distillery
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow a bar to purchase liquor from a distillery or a mini-distillery if it is within 10 miles of the distillery or mini-distillery.

title: To institute the Learn and Earn program for four-year schools.
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand the Learn and Earn Program to the state baccalaureate institutions for a two-year pilot period.

title: Creating the Governor’s Cup competition
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the "Governor's Cup Challenge" to provide scholarships for high school student-athletes who did not receive an athletic scholarship to a West Virginia higher education institution and are perusing an education at their preferred in-state institution of higher education.

title: Safe Play Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the penalties for persons convicted of assault or battery upon athletic officials: the Safe Play Act.

title: Establishing a pilot program to develop school-based mental and behavioral health services
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the State Department of Education to develop a pilot program to provide mental and behavioral health services as an alternative to suspending students for disruptive behaviors.

title: To create an initiative to provide minorities and males with an incentive to join the public education field
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a statewide initiative to promote teacher preparation programs aimed at underrepresented groups. The bill provides that the West Virginia State Board of Education will create an initiative for this purpose. The bill provides that county boards of education in this state will create initiatives for this purpose. The bill establishes a scholarship fund and provides for funding. The bill provides for definitions. The bill sets forth criteria for the scholarship. Finally, the bill enacts the scholarship.

title: Limiting the use of state funding under the Hope Scholarship Program for out-of-state private schools and providers
description: The purpose of this bill is to prevent the use of state funds to pay costs for attending out-of-state private schools or receiving other services from an out-of-state provider.

title: Clarifying that the legislature cannot impede the judiciary’s duties to assure the fair administration of justice when it or a member of a legislative body is a party in a proceeding relating to legislative actions
description: The purpose of this bill is to create an exception in the right of a member of the Legislature or a legislative body when a party to a judicial proceeding relating to legislative actions, and delay of the legal proceeding will prevent the judiciary from fulfilling its constitutional duty to assure fair and timely administration of justice.

title: Adding “sexual orientation” and “gender identity” to the categories covered by the Human Rights Act and WV Fair Housing Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to add "sexual orientation" and "gender identity" to the categories covered by the Human Rights Act, prohibiting discrimination in employment and places of public accommodation. The bill adds "age", "sexual orientation" and "gender identity" to the categories covered by the Fair Housing Act prohibiting discrimination in housing. The bill defines "sexual orientation" and "gender identity".

title: Creating the Independent Redistricting Commission of the Joint Committee on Government and Finance
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the Redistricting Office of the Joint Committee on Government and Finance to propose redistricting plans during census years. The main task of the Redistricting Office is to propose a plan to the Legislature which is based on constitutional and legal requirements and considerations. The bill provides specific criteria that the redistricting office must observe in proposing district mappings. The bill requires the redistricting office to advertise a proposed draft map of districts to the public. The bill requires the redistricting office to recommend redistricting plan to the Legislature. The bill requires the full Legislature to vote on plan ratification. The bill provides for subsequent submissions of plans and vote by Legislature. The bill requires that the commission certify to the Secretary of State that its final proposal for district boundaries is in accordance with constitutional and legal requirements. The bill prohibits certain persons from influencing or attempting to influence district mapping proposals of the redistricting office.

title: Creating a domestic violence registry
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a domestic violence registry. The bill provides a purpose. The bill directs the criminal identification bureau of the West Virginia State Police to establish and maintain the registry. The bill provides for confidential inquiry of persons on the registry. The bill establishes criteria for placement on and releasing information from the registry. The bill requires prosecuting attorneys to provide certain information. The bill defines terms.

title: Establishing the Minority Health Advisory Team
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize model Community Health Equity Initiative Demonstration Projects which use existing state and local resources to promote community health and well-being. The bill authorizes the Commissioner of the Bureau for Public Health to establish projects with eligibility requirements; and provides for the administration of projects. Additionally, the bill establishes the Minority Health Advisory Team including its composition and duties.

title: Relating to consumer protection of new manufactured home warranties
description: The purpose of this bill is to place upon the manufacturers of manufactured homes the duty to meet their obligations and responsibilities under the terms of the express warranties extended to the consumers in this state. The bill provides consumers additional remedies to enforce the warranties.

title: Relating to wages of persons with disabilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for fair pay and maximized employment of disabled persons; create a state "Employment First" policy that encourages agencies to facilitate employment of disabled persons; establish a task force to initiate these policies; provide for the Bureau for Behavioral Health, Division of Rehabilitation Services, Department of Education, Bureau for Medical Services (State Medicaid Agency), and Workforce WV to implement the policy; and remove current exemption for paying minimum wages to persons in nonprofit workshops.

title: Relating to education to children and adults housed in correctional facilities and regional jails
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove language requiring specific appropriations in order for the State Board of Education, State Department of Education, and the State Superintendent of Schools to provide education to children and adults housed in correctional facilities and regional jails.

title: Relating to the juvenile justice reform oversight committee
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Juvenile Justice Reform Oversight Committee to recommend averted costs reinvestment; create a juvenile justice account and provide its purpose, funding, and disbursements; require new data to be collected and compiled to allow calculation of juvenile recidivism and the outcome of programs and make this information available to the public.

title: Relating to the cultivation of medical cannabis
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit qualifying patients to grow and cultivate up to 10 cannabis plants for their own use with no more than five reaching maturity simultaneously.

title: Relating generally to medical cannabis
description: The purpose of this bill is to improve patient safety in the medical cannabis program by authorizing permitted, regulated medical cannabis processors to manufacture medical cannabis in edible form for dispensing to certified patients in the state; to specify certain requirements applicable to medical cannabis dispensed in edible form; and to require information relating to the dispensing of medical cannabis be input into the controlled substance monitoring database.

title: Relating generally to forfeiture of contraband
description: The purpose of this bill concerns forfeiture of contraband. The bill establishes criminal forfeiture and the items and property subject to forfeiture. The bill sets forth additional procedures for forfeiture. The bill establishes dates. The bill permits a court to waive a conviction requirement. The bill protects innocent owners. The bill permits seizure of personal property with and without process. The bill provides that there are no additional remedies and no joint and severable liability. The bill establishes title. The bill sets forth the disposition of forfeited property and proceeds. The bill establishes prohibition on retaining property. The bill establishes sales restrictions, return of property, damages, and costs. The bill permits the transfer of forfeited property to the federal government. The bill provides for preemption. The bill defines terms.The bill repeals Â§60A-7-704, Â§60A-7-705a, Â§60A-7-706, Â§60A-7-707, and Â§60A-7-708.

title: Providing a tax credit for obtaining certain certifications by the United States Green Building Council Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design green building rating system
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a tax credit for obtaining certain certifications by the United States Green Building Council Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design green building rating system or the Green Globes Building Initiative green building rating standard. The bill sets forth the amount of the credit, who may take the credit, the criteria for taking the credit and the amount of the credit. The bill also provides rule-making authority and defines terms.

title: Relating to use of credit scores in applications for insurance
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit the use of a credit score to banking institution credit scoring for casualty insurance rate filings. The bill prohibits the use of credit scoring as a consideration in calculating insurance rates in homeowners or automobile liability policies. The bill prohibits the number of inquiries or the contents of a credit report or the use of credit score report from adversely affecting an application for insurance when disputed by the applicant; and when a credit score or report is utilized that it can only be generated by a banking institution.

title: Establishing workers cooperative corporations
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish workers cooperatives which are employee-owned corporations created to be operated for the benefit of the employees and the local community; providing guidelines and criteria for their incorporation and a process for their dissolution.

title: Relating to calculating max number of students at alternative and year-round schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to calculate the maximum number of students during the course of a year at alternative and year-round schools based on the maximum attendance for that school year.

title: Requiring West Virginia Medicaid managed care organizations to contract with any otherwise qualified provider
description: The purpose of this bill is to require West Virginia Medicaid managed care organizations to allow in their network any willing provider which is otherwise qualified and credentialed, at the same reimbursement rate and other terms the same as comparable providers.

title: Providing for the reintegration of inmates in correctional facilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to require correctional facilities to assist juvenile and adult offenders to obtain a Social Security number and card, a birth certificate, and a driver's license.

title: Mountaineer Games Sports League
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Mountaineer Games Sports League.

title: The Young Professional Tax Credits
description: The purpose of this bill is to create "The Young Professional Tax Credits" for student loans. The bill provides that the credit applies to college graduates from ages 18 to 40 or until the student loan is repaid. The bill also provides for a refundable child care credit.

title: To allow public high schools to have full time athletic trainers
description: The purpose of this bill is to have full-time athletic trainers at public high schools in West Virginia.

title: Granting full time employees of county boards of education three months of paid leave following the birth of a child
description: The purpose of this bill is to grant full-time employees of county boards of education three months of paid leave, following the birth of a child, or the placement of a child in the home through adoption or foster care. The bill provides that the leave is in addition to any other leave available to the employee.

title: Appropriations from the state Revenue Shortfall Fund and the Income Tax Reserve Fund be utilized to initiate investments in flood prevention initiatives to reduce the impact of severe flooding
description: The purpose of this bill is to jumpstart the state's State Resiliency and Flood Protection Act to allow the Resiliency Office to begin the work off assisting areas of the state prone to flooding to undertake actions to reduce or prevent future flooding.

title: Relating to campaign financial statements by candidates for municipal office
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase transparency into county and municipal campaign finance activities by requiring all campaign finance reports for all elected offices in the state to be published online within 48 hours of the deadline, and to require municipal candidates file their campaign finance reports with the County Clerk of the County in which they are running.

title: Allowing the Secretary of State administer oaths and affirmations.
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow the Secretary of State administer oaths and affirmations, issue subpoenas, involve the aid of the circuit court in the execution of its subpoena power, and request legal and investigative assistance from the Attorney General, when investigating a charitable organization, professional fund-raising counsel or professional solicitor.

title: Providing the circumstances that a qualified voter is authorized to vote an absentee ballot by mail
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide the circumstances that a qualified voter is authorized to vote an absentee ballot by mail.

title: Camping ban on certain public property.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish misdemeanor crimes for camping in or storing personal property, including camp facilities and camp paraphernalia upon governmental or public property. It also provides definitions and criminal penalties, with exceptions.

title: Welcome Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to address the housing shortage and encourage residential development by allowing a subdivision to retain its original tax classification until individual lots are sold.

title: To guarantee timely educational evaluations and continuity of services for children entering foster care.
description: The purpose of this bill is to guarantee timely educational evaluations and continuity of services for children entering foster care or transition homes.

title: Relating to Animal Abuse
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit activities connected with sexual abuse of an animal; establish criminal penalties; provide for forfeiture of animals, payment of associated costs, and restrictions on owning animals upon conviction.

title: Relating to indexing of license and stamp fees
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the director of Natural Resources to propose legislative rules changing indexing of license and stamp fees.

title: Amending the procedures for determining liability for exposures to asbestos or silica.
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend the procedures for the handling of asbestos and silica litigation and to enhance the ability of the judicial system to manage such litigation.

title: Creating an emeritus license status for retired physicians, podiatric physicians and physician assistants who meet eligibility criteria.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create an emeritus physician license for professionals regulated by the West Virginia Board of Medicine.

title: Raise cost of living threshold for retired municipal police officers
description: The purpose of this bill is to raise the cost-of-living increase from the first $15,000 to the first $30,000 for supplemental pension benefits for certain municipal employees.

title: West Virginia ALS Care Services Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the ALS Care Services Act.

title: Relating to regulatory classification of bars, taverns, and restaurants.
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the regulatory classification of bars, taverns, and restaurants; commercial wastewater standards; and septic system oversight.

title: Expand the usage of impact fees for county development
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the creation of an operational sinking fund for impact fees.

title: Allow expedited partner treatment for bacterial vaginitis
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow for expanded expedited partner treatment.

title: To provide special consideration for municipalities to be allowed to join NPFRS for their paid firefighters
description: The purpose of this bill is to give special consideration for municipalities to join the Municipal Police Officers & Firefighters Retirement System (MPFRS) for their paid firefighters.

title: Agricultural Right to Repair Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Agricultural Right to Repair Act. The bill promotes farmer repair choice and competition by requiring manufacturers of agriculture equipment to make available to owners and independent repair providers, on fair and reasonable terms, the documentation, parts, and tools used to diagnose, maintain, and repair such equipment.

title: To allow patients to refuse residents and medical students from observing or performing medical care on patients
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow for patients to refuse to have their procedures observed by residents of the hospital or medical students.

title: Relating to lease termination and tenant privacy
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a tenant's right to contact emergency services, leave a lease due to violence or threats of violence, and to ensure tenant privacy from landlords.

title: Relating to Animal Abuse
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit activities connected with sexual abuse of an animal; establish criminal penalties; provide for forfeiture of animals, payment of associated costs, and restrictions on owning animals upon conviction.

title: Relating to coercive control in domestic violence
description: The purpose of this bill is to update the definition of domestic violence.

title: Relating to protection of personal information
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that protection of personal information applies to members of the Legislature.

title: Health Freedom for Teachers and Students Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Health Freedom for Teachers and Students Act of 2026.

title: Prevent public school districts or supervisors from taking adverse action against public school employees for expressing opinions on social media or in public.
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit retaliation toward school employees for opinions expressed on social media.

title: Establishing a new classification for managed timberland leased for substantial income
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a new classification for managed timberland leased for carbon credit income.

title: To create a domestic violence registry
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a Domestic Violence Registry.

title: Relating to the cancellation of contract by purchaser
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify how resales of real property units can be cancelled by purchasers in the event that a resale certificate is not provided, providing steps to be taken by a seller in the event that a resale certificate is unavailable, and providing a time period for cancellation when none is specified in the sales contract.

title: Establish a medical Adult day care pilot program in Fayette County.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a medically supervised, community based option for older adults and adults with disabilities who require daytime medical oversight and support but do not meet criteria for institutional placement.

title: Relating to the definition of firearm
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the definition of an antique firearm.

title: To require child care subsidy payments in West Virginia to be based on enrollment rather than daily attendance
description: The purpose of this bill is to require child-care subsidies to be based on monthly enrollment rather than daily attendance.

title: Creating the school aid formula study commission
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a School Aid Formula Study Commission to make recommendations to the Legislature regarding what can be done to modernize the current school funding system.

title: Relating to eligibility requirements for allocation from the Fire Protection Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to add a requirement that volunteer or part volunteer fire companies or departments must be members in good standing with the West Virginia State Firemen's Association to be eligible for revenues from the Fire Protection Fund, to objectively define "good standing", and to specify compliance with applicable federal and state laws.

title: Relating to pedestrians standing in or near the right of way
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit pedestrians from standing in roadways or right of ways.

title: Requiring the Public Employees Agency and other health insurance providers to provide mental health parity
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Public Employees Insurance Agency and other health insurance providers provide mental health parity between behavioral health, mental health, substance use disorders, and medical and surgical procedures.

title: Exempting from sales and use tax materials and appliances used in the manufacture of certain manufactured homes.
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt from sales and use tax materials and appliances used in the manufacture of certain manufactured homes designed for permanent affixation to a permanent foundation.

title: Relating to modernization of fees generated from emergency communication service users
description: The purpose of this bill is to modernize fees generated from emergency communication service users.

title: Prohibit the WV National Guard to be sent into combat OVERSEAS without a congressional Declaration of War.
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the deployment of the National Guard by the Governor to another country for combat without a Congressional declaration of war.

title: To bring virtual currency kiosks within the purview of money transmission licensure and create disclosure requirements and daily transaction limitations for new and existing customers.
description: The purpose of this bill is to bring virtual currency kiosks within the purview of money transmission licensure and create disclosure requirements and daily transaction limitations for new and existing customers.

title: Relating to authorizing legislative rules regarding higher education
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the Higher Education Policy Commission to promulgate rules regarding administrative exemption and mental health loan program; and to repeal rules regarding purchasing efficiencies and research trust fund program; and to authorize the Council for Community and Technical College Education to promulgate a rule regarding the STAND program; and to repeal a rule regarding purchasing efficiencies.

title: If a person who is not certified is holding a teaching position in a WV public school - that position has to come up for bid every year until it is held by a certified person.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that a teaching position held by a person not certified to teach that position may be considered vacant and open for bid every year until filled by a person certified to teach that position.

title: Modify Funding to Mountaineer ChalleNGe Academy
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify funding for the Mountaineer Challenge Academy.

title: Tree removal at state expense
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for removal or cutting of trees on state owned or leased property or rights-of-way threatening structures on private property.

title: Authorizing the West Virginia Commissioner of Highways to offer locality pay to Division of Highways employees working in certain jurisdictions
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide employees working for the Division of Highways with locality pay for working in certain jurisdictions designated by the commissioner as jurisdictions that are necessary for maintaining planning, engineering, construction, reconstruction, maintenance, and traffic regulation of state road projects.

title: To provide a funding stream from property taxes collected as a result of new high voltage electric transmission projects being constructed to lower electric rates to benefit West Virginians
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a funding stream from property taxes collected as a result of new high voltage electric transmission projects being constructed to lower electric rates to benefit West Virginians.

title: Providing a cost-of-living provision for certain persons retired under the Public Employees Retirement System and the Teachers Retirement System
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a cost-of-living increase, based on the annual increase in the consumer price index, for persons under the Public Employees Retirement Act and Teachers Retirement System who are at least 60 years of age and that have received retirement payments for at least five years.

title: Relating to federal law enforcement in specific locations
description: The purpose of this bill is to restrict certain immigration enforcement actions in specific locations.

title: Relating to Hope Scholarships awards
description: The purpose of this bill is to help to preserve funding for public schools and insure fairness in the use of Hope Scholarship funds; allowing Hope tuition reimbursements only to instate schools; establishing a family income eligibility schedule for Hope scholarships; requiring Hope recipients reimburse public schools the costs of providing individualized instruction programs; requiring Hope participants to utilize college exam and testing preparation course available in public school schools; requiring the state Board of Education to provide rules for implementation of cost and payment reimbursements for public school costs for services provided to Hope recipients; and to provide directives to assure county schools are reimbursed for services provided to Hope scholarship recipients.

title: Authorizing counties to establish a county daycare
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow for the creation of a county daycare by any county commission, allowing a petition process to cause an election relating to the establishment of a county daycare; requiring a county commission, when petitioned by voters or by its own directive, develop a plan for the daycare and propose a fee, tax, or levy to pay for it; allowing counties to establish a county daycare authority to manage the operation; and granting a county daycare general authority to do what is necessary to establish and manage a daycare.

title: Reforming Boards and Commissions
description: The purpose of this bill is reform of state board and commissions system by eliminating unnecessary, expired, or outdated board, shifting essential functions of several boards or commissions to various agencies or entities, reducing the number of members on several continuing boards and commissions, modifying or eliminating several reports of various boards or commissions, and technical cleanup throughout.

title: Relating to the regulation of pharmacy benefit managers providing services to the Public Employees Insurance Agency.
description: The purpose of this bill is to update the authority of PEIA.

title: Relating to rules governing the practice of law
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the confidentiality of certain material in possession of the Supreme Court of Appeals.

title: Refugee Absorptive Capacity Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to enact the Refugee Absorptive Capacity Act.

title: Establish a registry for domestic violence offenders
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a Domestic Violence Registry for offenders with at least two qualifying convictions.

title: West Virginia Rural School Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Rural School Protection Act.

title: Require a 24 -hour hospital hold for persons deemed addicted to specific substances
description: The purpose of this bill is to enact "Caitlyn's Law," which will require a mandatory 24-hour hold in a hospital or other qualified facility pending an evaluation from a mental hygiene commissioner for all individuals suspected or known to have an addiction or dependency on pending evaluation from a mental hygiene commissioner.

title: Relating to allowing the carry of firearms on Capitol grounds and in buildings, with exceptions
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow for the carry of a firearm or deadly weapon on the Capitol grounds and surrounding streets and sidewalks that border the capitol complex and the carrying of a firearm in the Capitol Building with certain exceptions.

title: Creating WV Constitutional Carry Act of 2025
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow those persons 18-20 years of age to be permitted to carry a deadly weapon as those persons 21 and over are currently permitted to do.

title: To modify the process of holding charitable raffles
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize two or more charitable or public service organizations to hold a joint raffle occasion.

title: Prohibiting or at least limiting unsolicited phone calls pushing benefits under medicare, auto insurance, or soliciting donations for various causes or benefits
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit unsolicited robocalls for sales and charity donations.

title: Truancy Reform Act
description: This bill creates a Truancy Pretrial Diversion Program that allows parents, guardians, and custodians of truant children an opportunity to remedy the truancy prior to conviction, allows for additional delays in sentencing to address the underlying truancy, and requires the Department of Human Services to provide home-based family preservation services when ordered by a magistrate or circuit court judge.

title: Requiring auto accident toxicology test be performed
description: The purpose of this bill is to require toxicology tests after a fatal vehicle crash.

title: Burial Equity Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create burial equity in the state cemetery for veterans for former members of the National Guard and military reserves. The bill prescribes eligibility criteria; states its retroactive application; establishes a Burial Equity Grant Program to be administered by Veterans Affairs; and creates a Burial Equity Fund.

title: Modifying the requirements for compulsory childhood immunizations to provide for exemptions based on religious and philosophical objections
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the requirements for compulsory childhood immunizations to provide for exemptions based on religious and philosophical objections.

title: To require payment by insurers directly to the out-of-network emergency medical services agency and the prompt payment of clean claims.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require payment by insurers directly to out-of-network emergency medical services agencies and promptly pay clean claims.

title: Removing the one-time limit on the expungement of certain criminal convictions
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the one-time limit on the expungement of certain criminal convictions. The bill also removes burglary and conspiracy to commit burglary from the specific crimes for which eligibility for expungement is limited.

title: Relating to developing a comprehensive energy development policy and plan for the Office of Energy
description: The purpose of this bill is to consolidate several disparate energy development entities under the Office of Energy and to empower the Office of Energy to develop a comprehensive energy development policy and plan, a comprehensive grid stabilization plan, and to test the stability of West Virginia's energy grid.

title: Relating to the Neighborhood Investment Program.
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend the Neighborhood Investment Program.

title: To require real estate agents to disclose water and sewer utility rates, if applicable, at the point of sale
description: The purpose of this bill is to require real estate licensees to disclose water and sewer utility rates to buyers.

title: To authorize the HEPC to be able to adjust the required composite testing score for ACT and SAT in regard to PROMISE scholarship year to year in order to maximize the number of awards
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the Higher Education Policy Commission ("HEPC") to adjust the qualifications for the PROMISE scholarship in order to maximize the number of students who may be eligible for the award.

title: To repeal laws relating to adverse possession
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal sections of code relating to adverse possession laws.

title: Relating to candidate’s certificate of announcement.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Secretary of State and the county clerks to provide candidate information for display on the Secretary of State's website within five business days after receiving a certificate of announcement.

title: Relating to high school graduation requirements
description: The purpose of this bill relates to high school graduation requirements. The bill removes a mandatory stand-alone computer science graduation requirement. The bill establishes a computer literacy proficiency requirement. The bill restores local flexibility. Finally, the bill preserves advanced computer science pathways.

title: Creating the official motorist services logo signing program
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a tax credit for certain West Virginia businesses participating in the official motorist services logo signing program.

title: Veterans Housing Redevelopment Tax Credit Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to incentivize the redevelopment of existing structures into permanent or transitional housing for homeless veterans through a transferable tax credit, without creating a new entitlement or ongoing state operating obligation.

title: Establishing fiscal notes submitted to the Legislature constitute sworn testimony
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish that fiscal notes submitted to the Legislature constitute sworn testimony, imposing criminal penalties for knowingly false or materially misleading fiscal notes, requiring referral for prosecution, and creating a safe harbor for those fiscal notes submitted and made in good faith.

title: Amending the Emergency Medical Services Retirement System.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the EMS Retirement Equity, Tax Relief, and Workforce Support Act.

title: Public Adjuster Professional Standards Reform Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "West Virginia Public Adjuster Professional Standards Reform Act." The bill providing a title. The bill creates the application for licensure. The bill details the public adjuster and insured contract requirements. The bill creates an insured's rights. The bill provides requirements for funds received or held by a public adjuster. The bill creates fees and commissions for a public adjuster. The bill provides for penalties. The bill creates rules. Finally, the bill provides for an effective date.

title: Relating to resident protection
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a surviving spouse to be able to claim the deceased spouse's homestead exemption so long as the home they owned together is owned by the surviving spouse.

title: Recall of county commission or county board of education positions
description: The purpose of this bill relates to providing for the process of a recall election for elected officials, county commissioners or county board of education officials.

title: Authorize raffle licensees to offer alcoholic beverages as raffle prizes.
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize raffle licensees to offer alcoholic beverages as raffle prizes.

title: Allow the use of credit cards for raffles.
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow the use of credit cards for charitable raffles.

title: Remove sales tax from firearm suppressors.
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt sales of firearm suppressors from consumer sales and service tax.

title: Relating to dates and deposits for Oil and Gas Well Plugging
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow for the receipt of the oil and gas severance tax into the Oil and Gas Abandoned Well Plugging Fund if there is not more than $6 million in unencumbered funds by September 30 of each year.

title: Relating to providing a tax credit related to the establishment and operation of biochar manufacturing facilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to encourage private investment in biochar manufacturing facilities located in this state by leveraging existing federal tax incentives through a limited, performance-based state income tax credit.

title: Relating generally to punishment for child neglect resulting in death.
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the criminal penalties imposed on a parent, guardian, custodian, or person in a position of trust in relation to a child for child neglect resulting in death.

title: Relating to voting in West Virginia elections while residing overseas
description: The purpose of this bill relates to voting in West Virginia elections while residing overseas.

title: Relating to creating a Distribution Center Refundable Toll Payments Tax Credit Act.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Distribution Center Refundable Toll Payments Tax Credit through use of RFID Tag Reader systems at qualified distribution centers to compile refundable toll payments. The bill allows the promulgation of administrative rules. Finally, the bill provides for an effective date.

title: Relating to fire safety requirements for agritourism businesses.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide reasonable minimum safety standards for fully enclosed buildings participating in the state's agritourism program.

title: Creating an Office of Entrepreneurship
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Office of Entrepreneurship within the Secretary of State's Office.

title: Designate landowners who own 1,000 or more acres within West Virginia as institutional landowners.
description: The purpose of this bill is to define landowners of 1,000 or more acres within West Virginia as institutional landowners; to require reports filed by the owners to the Secretary of State relating to the use of this acreage, and annually from the Secretary of State to the Joint Standing Committee on Agriculture and Rural Development.

title: Relating to driving under the influence
description: The purpose of this bill is to make the West Virginia State Police Forensic Laboratory the entity responsible for the certification, standards, and administration of secondary chemical tests. The bill also makes the West Virginia State Police Forensic Laboratory responsible for approval of the devices and methods of preliminary breath analysis. The bill transfers rule-making authority from the Bureau of Public Health to the State Police.

title: The purpose of this bill is to facilitate the participation of mental health providers in juvenile abuse and neglect cases.
description: The purpose of this bill is to facilitate the participation of medical, dental, and mental health providers in juvenile abuse and neglect cases.

title: Relating to personal information disclosure
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit the information given by government agencies for the purpose of enforcing federal immigration laws.

title: Relating to the ownership of water and minerals in dissolved or undissolved form in produced liquids and solids related to oil and gas drilling.
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the ownership of minerals and other substances (other than hydrocarbons) in produced liquids and solids related to oil and gas drilling.

title: Relating to requiring quarterly reporting by water and wastewater utilities that are political subdivisions of the state to their governing bodies.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require quarterly reporting by political subdivisions of their water and wastewater utilities to their governing bodies, and require annual continuing education for board members and senior management.

title: Establishing the Energy Freedom and Fairness Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Energy Freedom and Fairness Act, permitting retail competition for the purchase and sale of electric power for certain non-residential retail customers.

title: Future Ready Education Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Future-Ready Education Act, to enable local boards of education to enter into long-term contracts for textbooks resulting in fiscal savings, to expand the Mountain State Digital Literacy Program, to requires educators to be trained in the science of reading, and to provide funding for the science of reading training.

title: Relating to the Central Abuse Registry
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the obligations of the West Virginia State Police regarding the Central Abuse Registry and the collection of fees for the same.

title: New Oil and Gas Well Plugging Assurance Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to prevent new horizontally drilled oil and gas wells that in the future have ceased production with no bona fide future use from remaining unplugged after they have not produced for a continuous period of 12 months and prevent them from becoming orphaned on a surface owner's land with no responsible driller or operator with the resources to plug the well. The bill requires new wells to either post an individual single-well, full-cost plugging bond, or in the alternative to start at the beginning of production to set aside money in an earnings bearing escrow account in a bank to pay itself to plug the well at the end of the well's life. The escrow provisions are based on West Virginia Coalbed Methane Review Board CBM pooling orders and their master escrow agreement attachments. It does not make any changes in bonding requirements for wells that have already been drilled or permitted.

title: New and existing Orphan Well Prevention Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the prevention of oil and gas wells being orphaned on surface owner's land with no responsible driller or operator with the resources to plug the well, to provide for the procedures for prevention of orphaned wells, and to require plugging money be set aside in an escrow account in a bank for the operator to pay itself later to plug the well.

title: relating to authority and notice requirements for religious organizations
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure continuity of title, protection of third parties, and orderly transition from trustee-based governance to corporate governance for churches and religious organizations.

title: Relating to authorizing the use of professional fireworks displays on public school property
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize county boards of education to permit fireworks displays on school property when conducted by licensed professional pyrotechnicians under the regulation of the State Fire Marshal.

title: Relating to dog racing requirements
description: The purpose of this bill is to

title: Providing protection for search and rescue group dogs
description: The purpose of this bill is to include police canine units and community search and rescue group canines assisting law-enforcement officers in the search and rescue for individuals and cadavers in definitions of "law enforcement officers" in relation to crimes against law enforcement officers and the level of force allowable to protect the canines as law enforcement officers.

title: Require the teaching of classical informal logic in public middle schools and implmenting rquirements for teachers to teach logic courses
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Logic for Living curriculum in public schools for grades seven through ten, with phased implementation and involvement of the Washington Center for Civics, Culture, and Statesmanship at West Virginia University.

title: To require drones used by state and county personnel to be produced in the United States
description: The purpose of this bill is create the Act to Prohibit the Purchase of Small Unmanned Aircrafts Manufactured or Assembled by a Covered Foreign Entity. The bill provides for definitions. The bill prohibits the purchase of small unmanned aircraft from covered foreign entities. Finally, the bill provides for the drone replacement grant program.

title: Relating to Home Rule Reform
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit municipalities participating in the Home Rule program from establishing additional protected classes of persons beyond what is designated in state statute.

title: To ensure that illegal aliens do not vote or operate a motor vehicle in the state.
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure that undocumented immigrants do not vote or operate a motor vehicle in the state.

title: Verifying legal employment status of workers.
description: The purpose of this bill is create the Worker Citizenship Verification Act of 2026.

title: Relating to acquisitions of properties by land reuse agencies and urban renewal authorities.
description: The purpose of this bill is to update the reporting process used by land reuse agencies.

title: To add the Bradford Peat Pear (Pyrus calleryana) to the noxious weeds list
description: The purpose of this bill is to designate the Bradford Peat Pear (Pyrus calleryana) to be a noxious weed.

title: To prohibit the malicious publication of personally identifiable information with intent to harass, intimidate, threaten, stalk, or facilitate harm.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Anti-Doxxing and Privacy Protection Act."

title: Relating to providing traumatic event counseling for peace officers.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a program to provide traumatic event counseling for peace officers, firefighters and 911 dispatchers.

title: Luggage for foster care children transfered between homes
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide luggage to foster care children so that they may transport their personal belongings.

title: Relating to pharmaceutical benefits
description: The purpose of this bill is to is to regulate pharmacy benefit managers and state pharmacy purchasing by requiring an annual pharmacy dispensing fee study, limiting amounts charged by pharmacy benefit managers, prohibiting certain pharmacy benefit manager contracts with West Virginia Medicaid and the West Virginia Public Employees Insurance Agency, and requiring implementation of a pharmacy cost containment tool.

title: Relating generally to bonded indebtedness of the State of West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill relates generally to bonded indebtedness of the State of West Virginia; requires recommendation from the State Treasurer prior to issuing refunding bonds beginning on a certain date; authorizes legislative rules related to refunding bonds, includes emergency rules for a limited period; sets forth legislative intent and findings; defines terms; clarifies application of new article; specifies when the Treasurer may issue general obligation bonds; sets forth amount, form, and terms of general obligation bonds; declares general obligation bonds to be covenants of the state and lawful investments; provides for manner of sale of general obligation bonds; requires creation of a debt service fund for each general obligation bond series; specifies permissible use of a debt service fund; authorizes investment of a debt service fund; authorizes the Treasurer to issue certain refunding bonds; requires the Treasurer to determine the bond counsel and financial advisor for general obligation bonds; exempts selection of bond-related services from certain state purchasing requirements; authorizes the Treasurer to pay general obligation bond issuance expenses from the debt service fund; prohibiting conflicts of interest; creates a criminal misdemeanor offense and providing penalties for violation on conflict of interest provisions; authorizes legislative rules related to general obligation bonds, including emergency rules; relocates statutory language concerning the state's outstanding general obligation bonds to a single chapter of code; declares legislative intent; provides for statutory construction; and makes various technical corrections.

title: Relating to establishing disaster repair and recovery effort tax credit for taxpayers subject to the severance and business privilege tax in certain circumstances
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a credit against the severance tax to encourage private companies to assist with repair and recovery efforts following disasters in this state. The bill limits the total amount of repair and recovery effort credits which can be certified by the Secretary of the Department of Environmental Protection. The bill requires the Secretary of the Department of Environmental Protection and the Tax Commissioner to propose legislative rules and emergency legislative rules for promulgation to implement the provisions of the bill The bill will increase economic opportunity in this state. The bill authorizes the claiming of the credits. Finally, the bill provides for an effective date.

title: Require all state‑regulated health insurance plans to provide meaningful coverage for hearing aids and to cover at least one annual audiological evaluation.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require health insurance coverage of hearing aids.

title: Creating a moratorium for two years on school closures and providing for a pause on impending school closures.
description: The purpose of this bill is to pause school closures to allow for revisions to the school aid funding formula. The bill also creates a moratorium on school closings and consolidations to allow for an optional emergency levy election to be held.

title: The purpose of this bill is to increase funding for rural counties in this state by adding a multiplier to the IEP calculation.
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase funding for rural counties in this state by adding a multiplier to the IEP calculation.

title: Make it a felony to kill a canine officer
description: The purpose of this bill is to include canines in definitions of "law enforcement officers" in relation to crimes against law enforcement officers and the level of force allowable to protect said canines as law enforcement officers.

title: Creating the Vape Safety Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Vape Safety Act."

title: To modify the foundation allowance to improve instructional programs.
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the foundation allowance to improve instructional programs.

title: Creaing a pollinator planting program
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Pollinator Protection Act; and provide program criteria.

title: Allowing healthcare workers to refuse to perform procedures related to sex reassignment or gender identity transitioning for religious or conscientious objection
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Medical Ethics Defense Act.

title: Reforming State Personnel System
description: The purpose of this bill is to streamline and simplify the state hiring system of the Division of Personnel. The bill terminates the State Personnel Board, defines the role of the director and the Division of Personnel, transfers to the Division all State Personnel Board responsibilities, eliminate Division of Personnel exemptions for the Department of Transportation, State Tax Division, and Bureau of Social Services, transferring new hires and promoted employees within the Department of Transportation into the classified-exempt system and exempting these employees from the grievance board. This bill right-sizes state government and refocuses the Division of Personnel to broadly categorize employees, provide training to our agencies, and to act as an advocate for attracting and retaining employees.

title: Relating to training on the uses and indications of certain drugs for pregnant women.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require training on the uses and indications of certain drugs for pregnant women.

title: Relating to the reimbursement for panel attorneys and guardian ad litems
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase compensation of all panel attorneys and guardians ad litem. The bill also creates an assistant guardian ad litem position and specifies required language in certain juvenile abuse and neglect case orders.

title: Relating to increasing the amount of fees to be paid by parolees for supervision.
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the amount of fees to be paid by parolees based on his or her ability to pay, not to exceed $50 per month to defray the costs of supervision, which would be an increase from not to exceed $40 to not to exceed $50.

title: Revising the statute authorizing the West Virginia Division of Homeland Security and Emergency Management to run background checks.
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the West Virginia Division of Homeland Security and Emergency Management to run background checks on persons applying to be a Statewide Interoperable Radio Network ("SIRN") Radio Programmer and on persons seeking approval to work in SIRN network facilities.

title: Relating to the jurisdiction of the State Fire Marshal
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend and reenact Â§15A-10-3 and Â§15A-10-5, as amended, to extend State Fire Marshal inspections, generally, to include municipalities with certified fire code officials, certified fire code inspectors and certified fire code plans examiners to perform duties in occupancies under the jurisdiction of the State Fire Marshal; to clarify the difference between certified and uncertified fire officials, fire inspectors, and fire plans examiners; to explain how training and examination for Fire Code Disciplines and Categories are completed; and to delineate the approved categories of examinations.

title: Changes to the requirements for do not resusitate orders.
description: The purpose of this bill is to add explicit recognition of Do-not-resuscitate -Comfort Care Arrest (DNR-CCA) and Do-not-resuscitate -Comfort Care (DNR-CC) that is feasible and legally coherent, promoting clearer and more patient-centered care.

title: Revising the statute relating to the state emergency response commission meetings.
description: The purpose of this bill is to revise the statute to allow for the purposes of committee and board meetings any member of the state emergency response commission to delegate authority for an employee to serve as a designee in his or her stead as it is not always feasible to honor all requirements to attend and participate in such meetings.

title: Repealing the Addiction Treatment Pilot Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to address the Addiction Treatment Pilot Program and repeal all portions of the legislation as the pilot program no longer exists.

title: Relating to appeals of certification decisions by the Department of Homeland Security
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the responsibility to hear appeals of certification decisions by the subcommittee from the Deputy Cabinet Secretary or his or her designee to the Office of Administrative Hearings and clarify that the Office of Administrative Hearings is to hear appeals from decisions or orders of any of the subcommittees of the Governor's Committee on Crime, Delinquency and Correction. to the Office of Administrative Hearings.

title: Relating to survivor’s benefit payment for first responders
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the language in the statute to make it consistent with W.Va. Code Â§5H-1-2(b) for survivor's benefit payment for first responders for purposes of payment for funeral expenses of law enforcement, safety, and emergency workers; amend the internal effective date; and make technical corrections to the section.

title: Relating to the standard of proof required for a final parole or probation revocation hearing.
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the standard of proof required for a final parole or probation revocation hearing is proof by a preponderance of the evidence.

title: To modify the school aid funding formula.
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a revised method of school aid funding.

title: Relating to the select committee for the West Virginia Fusion Center
description: The purpose of this bill is to define the authorities of the select committee's oversight of the West Virginia Fusion Center, to direct the Legislative Auditor to conduct an annual audit of the Fusion Center, and to define the parameters of that audit.

title: Relating to special license plates
description: The purpose of this bill is to direct registration fees from all special license plates to the State Road Fund; authorizing voluntary donations at the time of registration or renewal; requiring donation options to correspond with the theme of the license plate; establishing deposit and administration of donated funds; and providing legislative findings and intent.

title: Relating to disability pay for West Virginia State Troopers
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase pay for State Troopers with permanent total disability from injuries received in the line of duty in accordance with the pay increases the Trooper would have received from seniority had the Trooper not been injured.

title: To allow partial credits for times of disability service in the CPRB for Troopers.
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide one-half service credit for periods of disability service to count toward retirement for State Troopers.

title: Relating to professionals to be licensed by the West Virginia Board of Medicine
description: The purpose of this bill generally relates to professionals to be licensed by the West Virginia Board of Medicine.

title: Relating to a tax on managed care organizations
description: The purpose of this bill is to bring the health care provider tax on healthcare managed care organizations into compliance with new federal regulations.

title: Construction Cost Relief Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a tax rebate for new home construction.

title: Creating the “Financial Accountability Stable Token Act,” for financing and state payments
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Financial Accountability Stable Token Act," or "FAST Act," for finance and state payments; authorize the use of qualifying stable tokens for payments to state vendors and contractors; establish eligibility and reserve requirements; provide for administration and oversight by the State Treasurer; provide for rulemaking and reporting; and provide for severability.

title: Relating to Mine Subsidence
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify limitations on mine subsidence insurance recovery limits.

title: Relating to Decreasing Board of Education Limits
description: The purpose of this bill is to decrease mandatory liability minimums and remove excess coverage requirements for county boards of education.

title: West Virginia First Live Racing Jobs Act of 2026
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide West Virginia Certified Thoroughbred eligibility, reallocate interstate simulcasts by licensed racetracks, increase West Virginia Restricted race caps, provide inflation adjustment to the net terminal income at a licensed racetrack deposited in the state Excess Lottery Revenue Fund and reallocate a certain amount of said income to the thoroughbred and greyhound development funds at the licensed racetracks of origin.

title: Allow anyone with a master’s degree to sit for WV Bar exam and become licensed attorney
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit persons with master's degrees, regardless of the course of study, to take an examination for admission to practice law in the courts of this state.

title: Relating to Abuse Prevention Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to rename the intervention and prevention program, clarify the definitions of the program, and update the code with the renamed program.

title: To increase the Deputy Sheriff retirement multiplier from 2.75 to 3.0
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the multiplier for the deputy sheriff retirement accrued benefit from two and a half percent to three percent.

title: Allotting counties $5,000 per deputy position to only be used for deputy pay raises
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide funding to counties in the amount of $5,000 per deputy position in that county to be used exclusively for deputy pay raises.

title: Allowing for a paid commission for sheriffs
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a $15,000 commission to sheriffs.

title: Relating to financial or product assistance for prescription drugs
description: The purpose of this bill is to bring the tax on healthcare managed care organizations into compliance with new federal regulations

title: To provide pay increases to members of the judiciary
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide pay increases to members of the judiciary and clarify retirement contributions.

title: Formally recognize Mine Rescue teams as first responders in West Virginia.
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend benefits and recognition applicable to emergency responders to mine rescue personnel.

title: Relating to providing a civil remedy when a federal officer or employee violates a constitutional right.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a civil cause of action under West Virginia law allowing a person to seek relief against a federal officer or employee when that individual acts outside the scope of federal employment and violates rights secured by the Constitution of the United States. This bill does not authorize suits against the United States, does not waive federal sovereign immunity, and is intended to operate within the framework established by federal law.

title: Gateway to the Gorge Outdoor Recreation Industry Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create of a tax incentive to encourage the continued growth of the outdoor recreation economy in West Virginia to be known as the "Gateway to the Gorge Outdoor Recreation Industry Act".

title: To make the Public Service Commission an elected position
description: The purpose of this bill is to have members of the Public Service Commission be elected to six-year terms from three divisions in nonpartisan elections.

title: Require monitoring of electronic records maintained by hospitals.
description: The purpose of this bill is to require health care providers to maintain a complete copy of an individual's health care records and to prevent unauthorized altering or tampering of health care records.

title: Relating to federal immigration enforcement.
description: The purpose of this bill relates to federal immigration enforcement. The bill supplements and expands existing cooperation requirements. The bill mandates participation by state-supported law enforcement agencies in the federal 287(g) program. The bill requires detention facilities of a specified operational capacity to seek and maintain the Jail Enforcement Model. The bill authorizes use of the Warrant Service Officer Model only upon written federal denial. The bill establishes minimum operational standards. The bill provides for reporting and audits. The bill authorizes enforcement by the Attorney General. The bill requires withholding of certain state funds for noncompliance. The bill provides immunity. The bill provides for rulemaking. Finally, the bill provides for severability and an effective date.

title: Establish a statewide pilot program to improve kindergarten readiness.
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Kindergarten Readiness Touchpad Pilot Program.

title: Relating to prohibiting concealment of a law-enforcement officer’s identity or authority.
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit the intentional concealment of a law-enforcement officer's identity or authority, including the use of masks or face coverings, during warrantless, non-custodial investigatory stops that are not supported by probable cause.
