description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Proxy Advisor Transparency Act.

title: Creating Safer Communities Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Safer Communities Act. The bill states legislative findings and declarations; provides definitions; authorizes counties to levy a public safety sales or amusement tax; requires notification to certain offices; provides for severability; and provides exclusions.

title: Removing cap on number of investigators and examiners in Tax Department
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the cap on the number of investigators for the criminal investigation division of the state Tax Department, and to remove the cap on the number of examiners by the special audits division in the state Tax Department.

title: West Virginia First Energy Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to restore electric-rate stability through the continued utilization of in-state coal generation; preserve employment and investment in West Virginia's coal and natural-gas industries; and coordinate with the Electric Grid Stabilization and Security Fund to sustain dependable baseload and mid-load generation capacity statewide.

title: Requiring Department of Human Services use mobile technology to assist in certain investigations
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Department of Human Services to provide child welfare workers with mobile technology that will permit them to conduct investigations and create a digital record. This will upload to the system automatically and reduce the need for a child protective services worker to input data manually into a system. This will enhance service delivery to children. This data will allow managers to have real time access to data to conduct quality improvement analysis.

title: Creating mechanism for towing companies in WV to quickly access owner information
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide tow companies access to driver registration information on demand and at any hour.

title: Creating Public Electrical Savings Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Public Electrical Savings Act.

title: Establishing Affordable Electricity and Economic Growth Act of 2026
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Affordable Electricity and Economic Growth Act of 2026 to facilitate coke production and steelmaking in the state.

title: Requiring minimum time be served for first degree murder before parole eligibility
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a minimum time to be served upon a conviction of first degree murder with a sentence of life with mercy.

title: Preventing damage to underground facilities
description: The purpose of this bill generally relates to Underground Facilities Damage prevention.

title: Relating to loan form
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the type of writing required to be maintained by a licensed residential mortgage lender, broker, or servicer regarding loan fees or points

title: Creating three separate job titles for school bus operators
description: The purpose of this bill is to create three separate job titles for school bus operators based on years of service.

title: Child Care Workforce Scholarship Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create The Child Care Workforce Scholarship Act (categorical eligibility) for child care workers for the West Virginia Child Care Subsidy Program. The bill provides benefits for the children of eligible workers regardless of household income. The bill appropriates funds to support the expansion. Finally, the bill directs the Department of Human Services to promulgate emergency rules.

title: Relating generally to State Fire Marshal
description: The purpose of this bill relates generally to the qualifications and responsibilities of the State Fire Marshal.

title: Prohibiting sale of certain Kratom products
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the sale, distribution, or advertisement of Kratom products that resemble, are designed as, or are intended for use with vapor or electronic cigarette devices. The bill provides definitions, enforcement mechanisms, penalties, and an effective date.

title: Issuing identification documents to homeless youth residing in WV shelters
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Division of Motor Vehicles to provide certain identification documents to homeless youth who are U.S. Citizens, residing at homeless shelters within this state, at no cost.

title: Relating generally to reimbursement for costs of incarceration
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide reimbursement for costs of incarceration.

title: PEIA Stability and Sustainability Act of 2026
description: The purpose of this bill is to stabilize and sustain the Public Employees Insurance Agency (PEIA) by establishing a permanent reserve fund, protecting retirees, requiring transparency in rate-setting, and promoting fair cost-sharing and responsible management.

title: Requiring health policies cover oral health medical procedures due to side effect from cancer
description: The purpose of this bill is to require health benefit plan coverage for oral health medical procedures that are necessary as a side effect of cancer treatments.

title: Relating to statewide prevention plan
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Department of Human Services to develop and implement a prevention plan.

title: Fair State Aid Formula Act of 2026
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Fair State Aid Formula Act of 2026. The bill provides an equitable method of distributing state aid to county boards of education. The bill recognizes the additional costs associated with rural, small, and high-need schools. Finally, the bill promotes fairness, transparency, and adequacy in education funding.

title: Relating to circumstances of parental rights
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase circumstances where the Department of Human Services is required to seek termination of parental rights. The bill also increases circumstances where the time limit for a respondent parent's improvement period, or combination or extension of the respondent parent's improvement period, applies.

title: Creating Residential Treatment Capacity Expansion Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a special revenue account, the Residential Treatment Capacity Expansion Fund, to support the recruitment, development, and expansion of in-state residential treatment providers for children. The fund may be used for provider incentives, facility development, transition services for children currently placed out of state, and other activities that increase West Virginia's residential treatment capacity.

title: Increasing penalty for transporting telecommunication devices into jails
description: The purpose of this bill is to make transportation of a telecommunication device into a state correctional facility a felony.

title: Issuing identification documents to homeless individuals residing at homeless shelters
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Division of Motor Vehicles to provide certain identification documents to homeless individuals who are U.S. Citizens, residing at homeless shelters within this state, at no cost.

title: Creating homeless education coordinator position in counties designated by State Board as urban county
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a homeless education coordinator in counties designated by the state board as an urban county.

title: Granting municipal fire marshals authority to assist in lawful execution of law-enforcement officer's official duties
description: The purpose of this bill is to grant municipal fire marshal the authority to assist in the lawful execution of a law-enforcement officer's official duties.

title: Enhancing flexibility, responsiveness, and economic development potential of Industrial Access Road Fund
description: The purpose of this bill relates to enhancing the flexibility, responsiveness, and economic development potential of the Industrial Access Road Fund.

title: Adding Potomac State College as eligible institution for participation in Learn and Earn Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a program to include Potomac State College of West Virginia University as an eligible institution for participation in the "Learn and Earn Program". The bill removes reference to the program being a "pilot" program.

title: Including certain mental health disorders in existing public health programs
description: The purpose of this bill is to include postpartum depression, anxiety, psychosis, and obsessive-compulsive disorders in existing public health programs.

title: Relating to Industrial Access Road Grant Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the terms of the Industrial Road Access Program.

title: Relating to brain injury screening training
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Division of Corrections and Rehabilitation to train its personnel to screen incoming and incarcerated individuals for brain injury with a screening process designed in conjunction with a study group. The bill lists the agencies that must enter a memorandum of understanding to share confidential health information that is pertinent to the study group's study.

title: Relating to teaching and instructing world languages in public schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow all public schools to instruct students on world languages. The legislature finds learning a world language can improve student math and reading outcomes, improve academic focus, and provide additional career opportunities after graduation. The legislature further finds that an educator obtaining professional learning hours related to teaching world languages may use those hours to satisfy continuing education requirements.

title: Relating to tax credit for qualified rehabilitated buildings investment
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia historic rehabilitated building tax credit.

title: Extending time frame for Department of Human Services to identify relatives and fictive kin
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend the timeframe for the department to identify relatives and fictive kin of the child.

title: Preventing home insurers from canceling policy for isolated event
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit cancellation of homeowners insurance for an isolated incident.

title: Providing tax deduction for medical payments
description: The purpose of this bill is to deduct payment of medical expenses from state tax payment.

title: Stop Non-Consensual Distribution of Intimate Deep Fake Media Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Stop Non-Consensual Distribution of Intimate Deep Fake Media Act.

title: Ensuring equal financial support to kinship parents and fictive kin
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure that all financial support presently available to certified foster parents is provided to kinship parents and fictive kin. The barriers and burdens placed upon kinship parents and fictive kin are too onerous.

title: Limiting cost of prescription medications for senior citizens
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit the price of prescription drugs to older West Virginians to the lowest price that drug is available in the United States.

title: Providing water filtration equipment to residents whose water is deemed unsafe
description: The purpose of this bill is regarding water quality affecting residents of the state; establishing findings; requiring Department of Health to evaluate whether public water sources contain levels of contaminants making them unsafe; providing water filtration equipment or technology to residents whose water is deemed unsafe; and providing for rulemaking.

title: Providing pay raise for state road employees
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a $5,000 raise to state road employees.

title: Ensuring meaningful contact between child and step-siblings
description: The purpose of this bill is to add meaningful contact with step-siblings to be considered a factor in determining the child's best interests.

title: Establishing no tax on tips or overtime compensation
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt tips and overtime from state personal income taxes to encourage economic development through workforce participation and to encourage tourism by supporting the service industry.

title: Requiring any PSC rate increase to have legislative approval
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit the jurisdiction of the Public Service Commission to holding hearings on rate adjustment requests by all utilities, to make recommendations to the Legislature, and to permit all utility rate adjustments to be vetoed by the Legislature, if it so chooses.

title: Using E-Verify to verify legal employment status of workers
description: The purpose of this bill is to verify the legal employment status of workers and record-keeping requirements and employer compliance. The bill defines "employment verification" as the electronic verification system or "E-Verify." The bill prohibits local governments from enacting ordinances that contravene or limit the commissioner; and provides civil protections for employers using E-Verify.

title: Requiring Bureau for Public Health to test for mucopolysaccharidosis type 1
description: The purpose of this bill is to enact a mandate for newborn testing for mucopolysaccharidosis type 1 (MPS1), a metabolic disorder, which although not curable, can be treated if diagnosed in young infants.

title: Requiring insurance coverage for biomarker testing
description: The purpose of this bill is to require insurance coverage for biomarker testing.

title: Creating Caregiver Tax Credit Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a tax credit for eligible family members providing caregiver services to an eligible family member.

title: Defining drugs as adulterated when they contain specified food dyes and additives
description: The purpose of this bill is to define drugs that contain specified food dyes and additives as adulterated drugs.

title: Allowing enforcement of Purple Heart parking spaces taken by non-Purple Heart recipients
description: The purpose of this bill is to grant authority for enforcement of the Purple Heart parking spaces so that only those who have earned this medal may use those spaces, and establish penalties for those who park in these spaces without having earned the designation.

title: Relating to payment rates for child care services
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Bureau for Family Assistance to increase the base rate paid to childcare providers and to study a performance-based model of incentive payments to increase quality and to provide reporting.

title: Requiring dredging of flood prone waterways
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide dredging and clearing for waterways that are prone to flooding.

title: Allowing for doula reimbursement under Medicaid
description: The purpose of this bill is to require doula services to be covered by Medicaid.

title: Authorizing physician assistants to own business
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow physician assistants to own a practice, to allow the Board of Medicine to deny a license or other authorization to physician assistants who make unlawful referrals where that physician assistant has a proprietary interest, provide definitions, and to authorize physician assistants to form a medical corporation and designates physician assistant as a professional service eligible for establishing a professional limited liability company.

title: Relating to agency responsible for administering SNAP and TANF programs
description: The purpose of this bill is to transfer the SNAP and TANF programs from the Department of Human Services to WorkForce West Virginia.

title: Creating felony offense of using electronic device to threaten violence
description: The purpose of this bill is to create felony criminal penalties for using electronic communication devices to threaten crimes of violence.

title: Creating Truth in Taxation Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Truth in Taxation Act.

title: Relating to legislative rules regarding chemicals of emerging concern
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish that certain legislative rules proposed by state agencies regarding chemicals of emerging concern shall be based upon the best available science and the weight of the scientific evidence

title: Selecting Neutral Accreditors Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the creation of the "Selecting Neutral Accreditors Act." The bill provides for legislative findings. The bill sets forth definitions. Finally, the bill provides for the selection of accrediting agencies and enforcement.

title: Authorizing pharmacists to dispense ivermectin
description: The purpose of this bill is to enable pharmacists to dispense Ivermectin for human use pursuant to a collaborative pharmacy practice agreement and without a prescription, once the FDA approves of it for over-the-counter use.

title: Second Amendment Reaffirmation and Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the "Second Amendment Reaffirmation and Protection Act."

title: Requiring hair follicle drug testing of substantiated child abusers before restoring unsupervised visitation rights
description: The purpose of this bill is to enhance and improve child well-being by requiring a hair follicle drug test of a substantiated child abuser before restoring visitation rights.

title: Relating generally to underground facilities damage prevention
description: The purpose of this bill generally relates to Underground Facilities Damage prevention.

title: Relating to elections
description: The purpose of this bill is to change "precinct" to "polling location" for voting places.

title: Creating WV Driver Safety Modernization Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create The West Virginia Driver Safety Modernization Act. The bill deals with age-based renewal and screening requirements for advanced age and medical conditions and senior mobility planning and safe-driving longevity resources and mature driver safety course incentive.

title: Creating WV Officials Training Program Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Officials Training Program Act, a training program for certain government officials administered by the State Auditor's Office.

title: Creating Intoxicating and Nicotine Retail Licensing and Public Safety Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to regulate intoxicating, nicotine and controlled retail products. The bill creates The Intoxicating and Nicotine Retail Licensing and Public Safety Act; and creates within the Alcohol Beverage Control Administration the Division of Regulated Products & Retail Compliance.

title: Establishing WV Behavior-Based E-Bike and Multi-Use Trail Mobility Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Behavior-based E-bike and Multi-use Trail Mobility Act.

title: Relating to WV Board of Barbers and Cosmetologists
description: The purpose of this bill is to add the definition of "Master aesthetician" who is authorized to practice using laser technology, intense pulsed light ("IPL") devices, microneedling, and radiofrequency treatments.

title: West Virginia Trails, Access, and Stewardship Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Trails, Access, and Stewardship Act.

title: Creating State Council on Competitive Government
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Council on Competitive Government.

title: Creating High School Educator Flexibility Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a course-specific teaching permit system allowing certified educators to teach high-quality academic or career-technical courses outside their formal endorsement areas once they complete approved professional learning tied to that course.

title: Approving short-term training programs for eligibility for federal Workforce Pell Grants
description: The purpose of this bill is to codify federal law and give the Governor, via the West Virginia Workforce Development Board, approval of short-term training programs for eligibility for federal Workforce Pell Grants.

title: WV Volunteer State Defense Guard Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia Volunteer State Guard. The West Virginia National Guard is often called to other duties such as filling roles as corrections officers in West Virginia prisons, filling staffing shortages in our West Virginia hospitals, etc. Knowing that natural disasters often plague our state, West Virginia is left vulnerable when the National Guard is called to other duties. This volunteer state guard will not cost the taxpayers any money.

title: Establishing additional modification reducing federal adjusted gross income relating to taxes on tips and overtime
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish an additional modification reducing federal adjusted gross income relating to taxes on tips and overtime.

title: Relating to open captioning for motion pictures
description: The purpose of this bill is to require exhibitors of motion pictures who operate two or more theaters in more than one location in this state to provide open captioning during at least two showings per week of each motion picture that is produced and offered with open captioning. The bill requires, when requested, audio description to be provided for any motion picture that is produced and offered with audio description.

title: Permitting dedicated lottery tickets for special interests
description: The purpose of this bill is to create instant scratch off lottery ticket games to fund various projects of interest to the public; to create a fire department lottery ticket to fund the All County Fire Protection Fund; to create an emergency medical services lottery ticket to fund the Emergency Medical Services Equipment and Training Fund; to create an schools lottery ticket to fund the Innovation in Education Fund; and to create a roads lottery ticket to the fund the State Road Fund.

title: Outdoor Solid-Fuel Heating Appliance Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to set statewide minimum standards for installation, operation, and enforcement of outdoor wood-burning and coal-burning appliances; provide rulemaking authority to the Department of Environmental Protection; establish enforcement mechanisms, penalties, and reporting requirements; and provide an effective date.

title: Relating to modifications reducing federal adjusted gross income related to retirement
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the federal adjusted gross income with respect to retirement income.

title: Relating to vehicles exempt from payment of registration fees
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt vehicle registration fees for veterans, by lowering the percentage of a service-connected disability required for exemption from 100 percent to 50 percent or greater.

title: Relating to pornography access for minors
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the distribution and display of pornographic material to minors through online platforms, to establish strict age verification protocols, and to impose severe penalties on entities that fail to comply.

title: Requiring auto accident toxicology test be performed
description: The purpose of this bill is to require toxicology tests after a fatal vehicle crash.

title: Prohibiting of sex offender living within 1000 feet of any school, park, or playground
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit sex offenders from residing near children.

title: Expanding digital mapping of unimproved public roads
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand the digital mapping of primary and secondary roads in this state.

title: Women’s Collegiate Sports Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Women's Collegiate Sports Protection Act.

title: Displaying official US motto in state buildings
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the display of the national motto, "In God We Trust," in state office buildings.

title: West Virginia Rural School Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Rural School Protection Act.

title: Providing Medicaid coverage for postpartum health care
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide Medicaid coverage for postpartum healthcare.

title: Permitting certain use of county-owned wireless tower
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit county commissions to lease, rent, or permit the use of a county owned wireless tower or any portions thereof, with exceptions.

title: Extending statute of limitations for bringing actions for gender reassignment surgeries
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend the statute of limitations for bringing actions for gender reassignment surgeries, provide for additional damages in actions filed against surgeons for medical injuries from gender reassignment surgeries and the prescribing of medications related to gender reassignment procedures and therapies.

title: Permitting businesses to receive tax credit for using WV manufactured products
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a tax credit for businesses to cover up to 50 percent of the costs of the purchase of products that are produced or manufactured in West Virginia. These sections have been completely rewritten; therefore, they have been completely underscored.

title: Prohibiting certain medical exams on anesthetized patients
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit certain medical practices; prohibit medical providers from performing pelvic, prostate, rectal, and breast exams on an anesthetized or unconscious patient except in specific circumstances; and establish an effective date.

title: Using criminal records as disqualification from practicing particular professions
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the use of criminal records in determinations to allow an individual to practice a profession or occupation, by a board, authority, or other agency authorized to issue licenses, certifications, registrations, or other authorizations to engage in a particular profession or occupation.

title: Imposing time limitations on disposition decisions in abuse and neglect proceedings
description: The purpose of this bill is to require courts to render a disposition decision in an abuse and neglect proceeding no later than 12 months after the date of the initial ratification of the petition.

title: Relating to cost-sharing calculations on behalf of insured persons
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the administration of cost-sharing calculations on behalf of an insured.

title: Requiring courts to interpret statutes and regulations
description: The purpose of this bill is to require courts and administrative officers to interpret statutes, regulations, and regulatory documents anew and not defer to the agency's interpretation of the rule or statute.

title: Prohibiting geoengineering activities
description: The purpose of this bill is to ban geoengineering activities in this state and provide for penalties for engaging in such activities.

title: Requiring drug testing for individuals receiving office-based medication-assisted treatment
description: The purpose of this bill is to require drug tests for individuals receiving office-based medication-assisted treatment.

title: Increasing state minimum salary for teachers
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a minimum salary of $50,000 for teachers and providing at least a $2,000 salary increase for all teachers.

title: Clarifying deadlines for autopsy reports
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify deadlines for autopsy reports.

title: Relating to cost-sharing requirements for breast examinations
description: The purpose of this bill is to require insurance providers to provide diagnostic and supplemental breast examinations without cost sharing.

title: Establishing insurance provisions requiring coverage for annual breast cancer screenings
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish insurance provisions that require coverage for annual breast cancer screenings.

title: Preventing foreign financial contributions in domestic political processes
description: The purpose of this bill is to safeguard election integrity and national sovereignty by preventing foreign governments, corporations, or individuals from influencing domestic political processes (elections, ballot initiatives, etc.) through financial contributions.

title: Developing and implementing statewide prevention plan
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Department of Human Services to develop and implement a prevention plan.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Creating WV Jobs Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "West Virginia Jobs Protection Act," to mandate the use of the federal E-Verify system for employment eligibility verification by all employers in the state.

title: Increase circumstances where Department of Human Services is required to seek termination of parental rights
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand when the Department of Human Services must seek termination of parental rights and by limiting the total duration of parental improvement periods while a child remains in out-of-home placement.This bill has been recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to monthly status meetings of county entities
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a structured monthly forum in each county to review the status of the Bureau of Social Services, address inter-agency concerns, and improve coordinated responses to child abuse and neglect.The bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Establishing pilot program for use of mobile devices in child abuse and neglect investigations
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a pilot project to evaluate the effectiveness of the usage of a mobile device interface for CPS investigations reporting is required. This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to PEIA Cost Sharing Provisions
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify PEIA's cost sharing provisions.

title: Creating process of obtaining and adjudicating pre-adjudicatory alternative disposition
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the process of obtaining and adjudicating a pre-adjudicatory alternative disposition.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Designating permanent daylight saving time as official time of state
description: The purpose of this bill is to designate daylight saving time is the official time of the state if Congress enacts legislation to recognize daylight saving time year round.

title: Requiring Department of Human Services to establish pilot program to contract for supplemental caseworker aide services
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a pilot program to support caseworker administrative tasks with technology and human caseworker aide services to increase the number, frequency and timeliness of caseworker interactions with children and families served by caseworkers within the Department of Human Services.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to Child Abuse and Neglect Investigations Unit
description: The purpose of this bill is to create an expanded WVSP Unit specifically utilized for investigation of child abuse and neglect cases.The bill has been recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Establishing First Amendment Preservation Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the First Amendment Preservation Act; providing definitions; prohibiting state contracts with media monitoring organizations; requiring written certifications that state purchasing contracts are in compliance with the act; and clarifying the applicability of the act to state contracts.

title: Relating to certified public accountants
description: The purpose of this bill to update the provisions governing the education, examination and experience requirements for certified public accountants and to clarify substantial equivalency practice privileges and the issuance of certificates to out-of-state applicants/practitioners.

title: Relating to disaffiliation from religious denominations
description: The purpose of this bill is to relates to disaffiliation from religious denominations and generally relates to property of religious organizations; requires a two-thirds vote of the membership for disaffiliation; establishes classes of property for purposes of disaffiliation; treats each separately deeded parcel of real property as a distinct unit for Class A purposes; provides that a local religious organization that disaffiliates from a parent religious denomination or conference may retain ownership of each parcel of real property (Class A) if more than 50 percent of the costs for acquiring and improving that specific parcel were raised locally by or from the organization, subject to reimbursement of investments made by the parent religious denomination or conference; provides for ownership of chattel and personal property (Class B) based on the purchaser; provides for pro rata ownership of intangible property (Class C) based on sources of funds over a two-year lookback period; provides a catch-all provision for classification of property by a court, mediator, or arbitrator; establishes a burden of proof on the parent religious denomination or conference; requires the parent religious denomination or conference to provide accounting within a specified timeline; and provides for severability and application to affiliations entered into or reaffirmed on or after the effective date.

title: Relating to Kratom Consumer Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Kratom Consumer Protection Act and establish the Kratom Consumer Protection Fund under the jurisdiction of the Tax Department.

title: Imposing one-year moratorium on approval of certain public utility rate increases
description: The purpose of this bill is to impose a one-year moratorium on utility rate increases pending a study on reducing utility rates.

title: Relating to qualifications for serving on certain academic boards
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow members of institutional boards of governors to serve on the state Professional Charter School Board if otherwise qualified and to permit appointed members of the Professional Charter School Board to be appointed as lay members of institutional boards of governors if otherwise qualified.

title: Creating Closed Captioning Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to enact the Closed Captioning Act. The bill requires public places that have televisions for use by the public to have at least one half of those televisions to have their closed captioning feature activated at all times. The bill creates an exception. The bill defines terms, and establishes an effective date.

title: Increasing compensation for panel attorneys
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase compensation for panel attorneys of the Public Defender Services; and requiring Public Defender Services to annually provide a report to certain state agencies summarizing legal services that are being provided by the submission of a voucher by panel attorneys serving as guardians ad litem in state courts. This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to abuse and neglect cases
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase compensation of all panel attorneys and guardians ad litem. The bill also creates an assistant guardian ad litem position and outlines what language is required in juvenile abuse and neglect case orders.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to audio recording during CPS investigation
description: The purpose of this bill is to require local child protective workers to use body worn camera while conducting abuse and neglect investigations.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to circuit court's responsibilities in juvenile abuse and neglect proceedings
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend the West Virginia Code in relation to juvenile abuse and neglect proceedings to require that circuit courts make certain findings of fact and conclusions of law as it relates to the court's orders.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Imposing time limitation on disposition decision in child abuse and neglect proceedings
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the court to issue a disposition decision within 12 months of ratification of the initial petition.The bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Requiring Bureau for Social Services to file legislative rule
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Bureau of Social Service to file its policy manual as a legislative rule.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to temporary increase in payment to kinship parent
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that a kinship parent be paid a subsidy equal to that of a foster parent in specified circumstances and set forth the timeframe for such payment.The bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Creating special revenue account to expand in-state residential treatment capacity for children
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a special revenue account, the Residential Treatment Capacity Expansion Fund, to support the recruitment, development, and expansion of in-state residential treatment providers for children. The fund may be used for provider incentives, facility development, transition services for children currently placed out of state, and other activities that increase West Virginia's residential treatment capacity.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families.

title: Relating to clothing and necessity allowance
description: The purpose of this bill is to set forth requirements for foster child clothing allowances.This bill was recommended for introduction by the Joint Committee on Children and Families,

title: Creating Truth in Giving Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Truth in Giving Act and to provide civil and criminal penalties for violations.

title: Requiring transparency of dental health care insurance products
description: The purpose of this bill is to require transparency of dental health care insurance products. The bill requires annual reporting of the medical loss ratio with the Insurance Commissioner. The bill sets forth standards for the methods by which a dental carrier may pay a dental provider. The bill authorizes third party networks and sets standards for such networks. The bill requires an annual rebate to be paid in the form of a premium reduction when the MLR is not met. The bill provides for rulemaking.

title: Phasing in increase in daily rate of juror pay
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase juror pay from 40 per day to $100 per day.

title: Providing for nonpartisan election of commission members
description: The purpose of this bill is to have members of the Public Service Commission be elected to six-year terms through statewide, nonpartisan elections.

title: Restoring voting rights to faculty, student, and employee members of institutional boards of governors
description: The purpose of this bill is to restore voting rights to faculty, student, and employee members of the state's institutional boards of governors.

title: Authorizing county boards of education to designate schools as rural anchor schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize county boards of education to designate certain schools as "rural anchor schools" and to provide for specialized treatment of rural anchor schools under the public school support plan. The bill sets eligibility criteria, specifies funding treatment, provides for the use of funds, and requires reporting by county boards.

title: Providing for transfer of license to contractor’s qualifying immediate family member
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize certain transfers of a contractor's license to a license holder's immediate family member.

title: Establishing enrollment stabilizer mechanism within public school support plan
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a mechanism to smooth year-to-year enrollment fluctuations in county school systems to permit county boards to responsibility responsibly plan for staffing and services. The bill provides for an enrollment stabilizer mechanism within the public school support plan, and for additional enrollment stability protections for rural counties.

title: Establishing Essential Personnel Bridge Grant Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish an Essential Personnel Bridge Grant Program within the West Virginia Department of Education. The bill provides for financial support to county boards of education for certain essential personnel not fully funded by the public school support plan. It establishes grant application procedures, sets award criteria, provides for the use of grant funds, requires reporting, and provides for rulemaking.

title: Modifying priority of insurance coverage for drivers of certain vehicles provided by entities
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the priority of insurance coverage for persons operating a vehicle for the purpose of test driving or loaned out by the seller of a vehicle to be consistent with federal law governing insurance coverage for rental vehicles.

title: Requiring Child Protective Services workers to wear body-worn cameras
description: The purpose of this bill is to require local child protective workers to use body worn camera while conducting abuse and neglect investigations.

title: Relating to school bus safety violations by vehicle operators
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Protect Our Children at the Bus Stop Act.

title: Protecting Children from Illegal Vapes Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Protecting Children from Illegal Vapes Act.

title: Relating to financing and state payments
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Financial Accountability Stable Token Act," or "FAST Act," for finance and state payments; authorize the use of qualifying stable tokens for payments to state vendors and contractors; establish eligibility and reserve requirements; provide for administration and oversight by the State Treasurer; provide for rulemaking and reporting; and provide for severability.

title: Relating to disaffiliation from religious denominations
description: The purpose of this bill relates to disaffiliation from religious denominations and generally relates to property of religious organizations; requires a two-thirds vote of the membership for disaffiliation; establishes classes of property for purposes of disaffiliation; treats each separately deeded parcel of real property as a distinct unit for Class A purposes; provides that a local religious organization that disaffiliates from a parent religious denomination or conference may retain ownership of each parcel of real property (Class A) if more than 50 percent of the costs for acquiring and improving that specific parcel were raised locally by or from the organization, subject to reimbursement of investments made by the parent religious denomination or conference; provides for ownership of chattel and personal property (Class B) based on the purchaser; provides for pro rata ownership of intangible property (Class C) based on sources of funds over a two-year lookback period; provides a catch-all provision for classification of property by a court, mediator, or arbitrator; establishes a burden of proof on the parent religious denomination or conference; requires the parent religious denomination or conference to provide accounting within a specified timeline; and provides for severability and application to affiliations entered into or reaffirmed on or after the effective date.

title: Establishing Food Is Medicine Program under Medicaid
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the authorization for Food Is Medicine to be eligible under Medicaid.

title: Repealing exemptions from Division of Personnel
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal provisions of code that exempt the Department of Transportation, the Tax Division, and the Bureau for Social Services from the Division of Personnel.

title: Modifying requirements for volunteer firefighters to qualify for volunteer firefighter tax credit
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the amount of volunteer firefighters who can qualify for the volunteer firefighter tax credit.

title: Requiring PEIA and other health insurance providers to provide payment parity for certain services
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide payment parity for mental health care delivered by non-physicians for identical services provided by physicians.

title: Imposing limit of three terms on elected public officials in state
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit the number of terms of elected officials to three consecutive terms.

title: Prohibiting charging Hope Scholarship students fees for extracurricular program-related services
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit a county board or charter school governing board from charging any fees to a Hope Scholarship student for any extracurricular program related services; and modify the academic achievement requirement for Hope Scholarship students choosing an individualized instructional program and choosing to be assessed through a review of the student's academic work.

title: Creating Oral Health and Cancer Rights Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to require health benefit plan coverage for medically necessary dental procedures that result from cancer treatment; create the Oral Health and Cancer Rights Act; explain the scope of procedures covered as a result of certain cancer treatments; require the use of a specific billing identifier; and set an effective date.

title: Transparency In Financial Services Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Transparency in Financial Services Act which prohibits a financial institution from discriminating against someone for religion, expressions, or participation in lawful economic activity.

title: Supplemental Appropriation to Department of Health, fund 8802
description: The purpose of this supplemental appropriation bill is to add a new item of appropriation in the aforesaid account for the designated spending unit for expenditure during the fiscal year 2026.

title: Relating to WV Rural Health Transformation Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to make certain changes consistent with relating to creation of West Virginia's Rural Health Transformation Program and the State of West Virginia's commitments to the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services.

title: Allowing election official trainees to be appointed as election officials
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a program allowing election official trainees to be appointed as election officials.

title: Relating to requirements for disclosures and recordkeeping by persons making mortgage loans
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that a separate state closing disclosure is not required if appropriate federal closing disclosures are provided to borrowers.

title: Relating to bank merger by interstate branching
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide clarity regarding the attestation submitted in response to an interstate bank merger.

title: Relating to refusal review hearings
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify county prosecuting attorneys' obligations for DMV refusal review hearings.

title: Relating to powers and duties of Secretary of Department of Health Facilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Secretary of Department of Health Facilities to continue operating state-owned health facilities and to otherwise prohibit the department's sale or divestment of the operations of, or the real estate related to, Mildred Mitchell-Bateman Hospital, Welch Community Hospital, or William R. Sharpe Jr. Hospital, without approval of the Legislature.

title: Relating to electric and natural gas utility rate increases
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a one-year moratorium on electric and natural gas utility rate increases in West Virginia. The bill provides legislative findings, directs the Public Service Commission to implement the one-year moratorium, provides for exceptions to the moratorium for approving emergency rate increases, and requires a legislative interim study of electric and natural gas rate increases.

title: Relating to consumer protection and new motor vehicle warranties
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide protections for new motor vehicles not conforming to express warranties apply to all portions of new motor homes that are covered by those warranties

title: Improving school district efficiency
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow a county board to exempt itself and all noncharter public schools under its jurisdiction from all statutes and rules as provided for public charter schools; require any county board making such an election to engage an external auditor to perform an independent audit of the county's finances once every three years; and limit the county board's annual cost for the salaries of administrators to not more than six percent of the overall total annual budget of the county.

title: Updating practice act for WV Medical Imaging and Radiation Therapy Technology Board
description: The purpose of this bill is to update the requirements to practice medical imaging or radiation therapy in the state and to update the powers and duties of the Medical Imaging Board.

title: Eliminating requirement that commissioner approve joint account forms used by banking institutions
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the requirement that the commissioner of financial institutions approve forms used by financial institutions.

title: Relating to requirements for licensure as mortgage lender or broker
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow another acceptable form of financial statement from mortgage brokers to show adequate net worth in compliance with the licensing statute.

title: Creating emeritus physician license
description: The purpose of this bill is to The purpose of this bill is to create an emeritus physician license for retired physicians. The bill provides that when granted, a license is valid for life, unless revoked by the West Virginia Board of Medicine.

title: Decreasing service period for notice of tax lien sales
description: The purpose of this bill is to decrease the service period for notice of tax lien sales; and to decrease the statute of limitations for an action to set aside a deed.

title: Increasing annual salaries of certain state employees
description: The purpose of this bill is to raise the salaries of certain state employees: WV State Police and certain personnel; public school teachers; and school service personnel.

title: Modifying requirements for public water systems
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the Secretary of the Departmentof Health from promulgating rules that require public water systems or businesses to have backflow preventers.

title: Adjusting salary schedule for elected county officials
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a new salary schedule for county officials.

title: Limiting payment of taxes by co-owners or other interested parties
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit the payment of taxes by co-owners or other interested parties.

title: Relating to recovery residences
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the mandatory registration of recovery residences and limit the authority of the certifying agency regarding data collection and documentation of registered recovery residences.

title: Relating to exhibition of obscene material
description: The purpose of this bill is to make it a criminal offense for a person to engage in an adult cabaret performance where it may be viewed by a minor

title: Prohibiting teaching of divisive acts and critical race theory in public schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the teaching of "divisive acts" and "critical race theory" in West Virginia public and charter schools.

title: WV Short Line Railroad Modernization Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Short Line Railroad Modernization Act and tax credit allowed and credit limitations for short line railroad companies in West Virginia.

title: Designating September 11 as Patriot Day
description: The purpose of this bill is to designate September 11 as the annual legal holiday of "Patriot Day" to remember, honor, and mourn the victims of the terrorist attack on our nation.

title: Creating exemption for disabled veterans from vehicle sales tax
description: The purpose of this bill is to create an exemption for disabled veterans from vehicle sales tax.

title: Requiring both parents consent for non-emergency and non-life-threatening procedures on children
description: The purpose of this bill is to require non-emergency and non-life-threatening medical procedures on behalf of the child only be permitted after both parents agree.

title: Eliminating transfer taxes for siblings and for LLC solely owned by individual transferor
description: This bill amends the exemptions from excise taxes; adding an exemption for transfers between siblings; and adding an exemption for transfers with a solely-owned limited liability company.

title: Relating to payment of state funds to qualified child care entities
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the current reimbursement formula of state funds to childcare facilities from an attendance model to an enrollment model.

title: Relating to statues placed in Capitol rotunda
description: The purpose of this bill is to replace the statue of the Robert C. Byrd with a statue of George Washington, Abraham Lincoln, James Madison, and Arthur I. Boreman, placed in each corner of the rotunda of the Capitol.

title: Prohibiting abortifacients
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the abortifacients and to enact criminal penalties and permit private causes of action for supplying abortifacients and also requiring informed consent.

title: Limiting family income for Hope Scholarship eligibility
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the West Virginia Hope Scholarship Program to limit eligibility for the program to students from families making less than $100,000 annually; to require that any unused funds left in a student's Hope Scholarship account at the end of each fiscal year be transferred to the county school district in which the student resides; and to prohibit the use of Hope Scholarship funds for out-of-state education services.

title: Authorizing medical parole for certain inmates
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a medical parole program for eligible inmates in the custody of the Division of Corrections and Rehabilitation. The bill provides for medical parole petitions to be submitted by inmates and provides for a review process by superintendents of correctional institutions and the commissioner of corrections and rehabilitation. The bill provides for notice of possible medical parole to interested parties, for hearings on parole petitions, and for development of terms and conditions of release. The bill sets a process for reconsideration and review of denials of medical parole, sets reporting requirements, and includes rulemaking authority.

title: Requiring repeat DUI offenders to carry ID indicating they may not purchase alcohol
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that a person convicted of driving under the influence may be designated as an interdicted person and is prohibited from purchasing alcohol for a certain time period.

title: Relating to Property Valuation Training and Procedures Commission
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that one citizen member of the state's property valuation training and procedures commission have a background in or knowledge of agriculture

title: Extending Alzheimer's Disease and Other Dementia Advisory Council sunset date
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend the Alzheimer's Disease and Other Dementia Advisory Council sunset date.

title: Providing tax credit for homeschool students
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish tax credits for parents and legal guardians whose children are in a home-schooling program or private school. The bill provides for an exception. Finally, the bill provides rule-making authority.

title: Relating to employee exemptions from employer-mandated vaccinations
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a religious exemption for employees from employer mandated immunizations.

title: Relating to federally approved project delivery methods for airport capital improvement projects
description: The purpose of this bill is to expressly authorize airport authorities under state law to utilize project delivery methods approved or authorized by the Federal Aviation Administration in order to efficiently and safely plan, procure, and construct airport infrastructure projects funded through the Federal Aviation Administration's Airport Improvement Program, including the Federal Aviation Administration Integrated Project Delivery Pilot Program established under 49 U.S.C. Â§47123 and any successor programs.

title: Relating to religious exemption to mandatory vaccination requirements
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish religious exemption from compulsory immunization for children.

title: Exempting students of higher education from compulsory vaccination requirements
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt students at college, universities, and vocational and technical schools from any compulsory immunization requirements.

title: Relating to medical exemption to mandatory vaccination requirements
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend the process for a medical exemption to compulsory vaccination. It eliminates the commissioners' right to grant, renew, deny, suspend, or revoke medical exemptions to compulsory vaccination requirement and the Immunization Officer. The bill specifies that medical exemptions to compulsory vaccination are granted based on a treating physician's or advanced practice provider's determination that vaccination is or may be detrimental to the child's health. The physician or advanced practice provider is to provide a written statement to this effect to the child's school or state-regulated child care center.

title: Codifying common-law definition of involuntary manslaughter
description: The purpose of this bill is to codify the common-law definition of the misdemeanor offense of involuntary manslaughter and to specify that a defendant's act must proximately cause the death of another for a conviction to result.

title: Establishing November 7 as Victims of Communism Day
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish November 7 of each year as "Victims of Communism Day", to be observed in the public schools of this state.

title: Extending interest rate cap to all obligations incurred during military service
description: The purpose of this bill is to cap interest rates for debts of active service members at six percent per annum.

title: Including step-siblings in Best Interests of Child Protection Act of 2022
description: The purpose of this bill is to include meaningful contact between a child and a step-sibling when considering the best interests of a child in a custodial decision.

title: Requiring persons with illegal immigration status be turned over to ICE
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the punishment of persons with illegal immigration status.

title: Terminating WV Contractor Licensing Board
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the West Virginia Contractor Licensing Act and terminate the West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board.

title: Banking and Financial Services Provider Protections for Eligible Adults from Financial Exploitation
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide banking protections for eligible adults from financial exploitation by permitting depository institutions to delay, refuse, or prevent certain activities and financial transactions when an entity or employer suspects financial exploitation of an elder adult or incapacitated adult may be at issue. This bill further permits disclosure of such activity or financial transaction to an eligible adults' authorized third-party as well as a designated state agency.

title: Prohibiting public funds from supporting low-earning outcome postsecondary degree programs
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit the degrees for which state funds can be used to obtain.

title: Creating Stop the Bleed Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Stop the Bleed Act to require implementation of the act in county schools and to permit private donations and funding by the Legislature.

title: Exempting certain physicians from specified traffic laws when responding to emergencies
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit physicians to be exempt from specified traffic laws when responding to an emergency call. This proposed bill provides that the physician must continue to exercise due care and provides for rulemaking.

title: Providing tax credit to corporations for existing employer-provided child care facilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a tax credit against the state corporate net income tax and the state personal income tax for expenditures related to the operation of existing employer-provided or sponsored child-care facilities.

title: Extending mine safety technology tax credit
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend the termination date of the Innovative Mine Safety Technology Tax Credit.

title: Establishing economic incentives for data centers to locate within WV
description: The purpose of this bill is to create economic incentives for data centers to locatewithin the state and further stimulate the state's economy by relying on locally sourced coal-generated electricity. The bill provides salvage value treatment for personal propertyused by qualifying data centers; an exemption from the B&O tax for all coal-generated electricity sold to qualifying data centers; and provides a sales tax exemption for all personal property sold to and used in the construction or maintenance of a qualifying data center.

title: Extending sunset date for modification to personal and corporate income tax for qualified businesses
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend the sunset date for modification to personal and corporate income tax for qualified opportunity zone businesses.

title: Relating to responsibility of board of public service district that is being dissolved
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the board of a public service district to cooperate with a county commission when the county commission has authorized the dissolution, sale or merger of the district with another public service district.

title: Removing Inspector General from inclusion in Department of Health
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the Office of the Inspector General from the Department of Health, where is it for administrative purposes, and to clarify that the Office of the Inspector General has the ability to conduct performance audits, financial audits, evaluations, and attestations engagements of the Department of Human Services, the Department of Health, and the Department of Health Facilities and their independent contractors.

title: Relating to Build WV Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to replace the Build WV project cost with a cap on new tax credit liability. The bill clarifies that the cost cap applies only to new project approvals; allows credit for smaller projects in rural areas; requires periodic review and adjustment to reflect demand and usage; and establishes a Build WV credit reserve fund adjusted annually.

title: Prohibiting online distribution of pornographic material to minors
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the distribution of pornographic materials to persons under 18.

title: Prohibiting gender transition surgeries, treatments, and therapies to minors
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit gender transition surgeries, treatments, and therapies to minors. The bill establishes penalties for practitioners in violation of regulations. The bill safeguards the mental and physical health of minors. The bill prohibits political subdivisions from enacting conflicting policies. The bill creates whistleblower protection. Finally, the bill prohibits taxpayer subsidization of gender transition treatments.

title: Protecting minors from exposure to indecent displays of sexually explicit nature
description: The purpose of this bill is to protect minors from indecent displays of a sexually explicit nature, including but not limited to, transvestite and/or transgender performances or displays to minors.

title: Relating to controlling interests in flood control dams and similar structures
description: The purpose of this bill is to transfer all interests of conservation districts in flood control dams and similar structures, as well as any associated property and related funds and accounts, to the state Conservation Agency by July 1, 2026. The bill authorizes the state conservation committee to operate, improve, maintain, and construct flood control dams and similar structures and to contract with other entities to realize that authority.

title: Creating Atmospheric Intervention Oversight and Public Safety Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Atmospheric Intervention Oversight and Public Safety Act.

title: Relating to WV Commission on Holocaust Education
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the West Virginia Commission on Holocaust Education. The bill establishes legislative findings. The bill modernizes commission membership in light of the passing of Holocaust survivors and second-generation witnesses. The bill strengthens safeguards for historical accuracy and mission integrity. The bill authorizes limited commission-appointed voting members. The bill authorizes non-voting advisory members, including students. The bill clarifies governance, transparency, and duties. Finally, the bill ensures Holocaust education remains the central and primary purpose of the commission.

title: Legalizing adult consumption of cannabis
description: The purpose of this bill is to legalize the personal use and possession of cannabis by adults in the state. The bill provides for a county option election to allow for the manufacture and sale of cannabis on a county-by-county basis; provides for regulation by the Bureau for Public Health; authorizes excise and local sales taxes on cannabis transactions; prohibits underage use; and preserves the ability of employers and property owners to prohibit or limit use or possession.

title: Creating Mountain Bike Responsibility Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to define those areas of responsibilities and affirmativeacts for which the mountain operators are liable for loss, damage, or injury and to definethose risks that the bicyclist expressly assume.

title: Allowing intergovernmental agreements with Land Stewardship Corporation
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow intergovernmental agreements with the Land Stewardship Corporation.

title: Establishing tax credit for certain physicians who locate to practice in WV
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a tax credit for physicians who are new graduates and locate in West Virginia to practice medicine for at least six years.

title: Creating Forensic Pathology Recruitment Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to recruit forensic pathologists; set forth a purpose; define terms; set forth eligibility criteria; set forth required loan repayment documents and procedure; designate the Department of Health to administer the program; set forth award requirements and procedure; create a fund; require rulemaking; and set forth minimum salary.

title: Levying user fee on cigarettes to support EMS
description: The purpose of this bill is to levy a $1 user fee on cigarettes; provide the user fee be directed to support Emergency Medical Services; and create a special revenue fund to receive funds from the created user fee.

title: Prohibiting release of certain personal information of contributors to political elections
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the release of addresses and names of employers of persons who make contributions to political elections and providing misdemeanor criminal penalty.

title: Relating generally to aboveground storage tanks
description: The purpose of this bill is to alter the definition of an aboveground storage tank.

title: Clarifying requirements before assessor can be nominated for property valuation
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify requirements before an assessor can be nominated and provide preference when certain requirements are met.

title: Discontinuing WV Supreme Court of Appeals Public Campaign Financing Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to discontinue the West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals Public Campaign Financing Program.

title: Requiring Economic Development Authority participate in federal tax credit scholarship program
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the State Treasurer to participate in the federal tax credit scholarship program; and to identify qualified scholarship organizations and schools.

title: Prohibiting surprise billing of ground emergency medical services by nonparticipating providers
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit out-of-network emergency medical services agencies from balance billing a covered enrollee in a health insurance plan for ground ambulance services. The bill establishes the minimum payment to be made by an insurer to an out-of-network emergency medical services agency for ambulance services. The bill requires payment by the insurer directly to the out-of-network emergency medical services agency and the prompt payment of clean claims.

title: Relating to WV employer-provided or sponsored child care tax credit program
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify certain requirements for eligibility for West Virginia's Employer-Provided or Sponsored Child Care Tax Credit program.

title: Allowing physician assistants to own practice
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow physician assistants to own a practice.

title: Strategic and Critical Resources Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to promote the development and availability of strategic and critical resources through uniform statewide regulation, to reserve regulatory authority to the state and federal governments, and to preempt local regulation except as expressly provided.

title: Requiring coverage of home blood pressure monitoring devices for certain Medicaid recipients
description: The purpose of this bill is to require Medicaid coverage for blood pressure monitoring devices to be offered to certain persons who have been diagnosed with hypertension.

title: Designating psychiatric hospital that treats exclusively civil and forensic patients
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish that a psychiatric hospital with an average annual inpatient census patient mix of greater than 95 percent of court-ordered forensic and civil involuntary commitments from state custody or from a state-owned hospital qualifies as a "state-designated facility" for purposes of the statute.

title: Relating to sale of certain properties subject to delinquent tax liens
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a more consistent process when handling the sale of tax liens and non-entered, escheated and waste and unappropriated lands by providing all lands subject to sale under this article be certified before July 1; providing all land sales be completed within 150 days after the auditor has certified the lands; and clarifying payment shall be made to the sheriff of the county in which the property is situated.

title: Relating to distribution of tax revenues collected from data centers
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the distribution of ad valorem property tax revenues collected from high impact data centers so that 80% of such revenues are provided to the counties in which such data centers are sited.

title: Placing statue of remembrance in rotunda
description: The purpose of this bill is to place a statue of U.S. Army Specialist Sarah Beckstom in a corner of the rotunda of the Capitol.

title: Establishing salon training program
description: Establishing salon training program

title: Establishing Right to Race Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Right to Race Act. The bill defines terms. The bill sets forth actions brought upon racetracks. The bill sets forth relevant claims. The bill sets forth political subdivision restrictions. Finally, the bill provides for an effective date.

title: Relating to ethics reforms at PSC
description: The purpose of this bill is to implement certain ethics reforms at the Public Service Commission of West Virginia. The bill requires financial disclosures made by commission members to be made available online; requires commission members to act in furtherance of the public interest; repeals certain inoperative sections of code; revises ethical criteria for commission membership and employment; and applies the code of judicial ethics to commission members.

title: Creating Cohen Craddock Student Athlete Safety Act
description: Creating Cohen Craddock Student Athlete Safety Act

title: Relating to certified microgrid district projects and certified high impact data center projects
description: The purpose of this bill is to restore local control and regulatory authority over certified microgrid districts and certified data centers to counties and municipalities in the state.

title: Prohibiting certain restrictions on regulation of accessory dwelling units
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit municipalities from prohibiting certain restrictions on the regulation of accessory dwelling units.

title: Relating to spousal coverage under PEIA
description: Relating to spousal coverage under PEIA

title: Clarifying commercial real property insurance policies
description: Clarifying commercial real property insurance policies

title: Relating to colorectal cancer prevention
description: Relating to colorectal cancer prevention

title: Allowing parents to refuse family court-ordered medical procedure of child against parents' wishes
description: Allowing parents to refuse family court-ordered medical procedure of child against parents' wishes

title: Allowing power of attorney or conservator to sign transfer on death deed
description: Allowing power of attorney or conservator to sign transfer on death deed

title: Protecting environment and humans from geoengineering and weather modification experiments
description: Protecting environment and humans from geoengineering and weather modification experiments

title: Determining liability for exposure to asbestos or silica
description: Determining liability for exposure to asbestos or silica

title: Relating to settlement definitions for real estate transactions
description: Relating to settlement definitions for real estate transactions

title: Providing compensation to victims of abusive lawsuits
description: Providing compensation to victims of abusive lawsuits

title: Relating to general powers of PSC
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify when the Public Service Commission can approve utility rate increases.

title: Adopting Uniform Protected Series Act
description: Adopting Uniform Protected Series Act

title: Relating to WV Real Estate Commission
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the Governor with advice and consent of the Senate to make appointments.

title: Relating to acts for which WV Real Estate Commission may refuse, suspend, or revoke licenses
description: The purpose of this bill relates to acts in which the West Virginia Real Estate Commission may refuse, suspend or revoke a license.

title: Increasing tax on vapes and e-cigarettes
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the tax on e-cigarette liquid and direct that these taxes be used to fund PEIA.

title: Relating to dog racing requirements
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that a licensed racetrack casino must not maintain an active dog racing license in order to receive telecasts and accept wagers on dog and horse races, or to otherwise apply and qualify for a video lottery or racetrack table game licenses.

title: Relating to composition of boards of governors in higher education
description: The purpose of this bill is to promote the empowerment of young adults in West Virginia, a vital part of the state's population, by giving each elected student body member on a university board of governors voting power, which promotes our republican ideals of representative governance and accountability.

title: Allowing certain Capitol Police officers to participate in WV State Police Retirement System
description: The purpose of this bill is to include members of the Division of Protection Services (Capitol Police) under the state police B retirement system

title: Relating to professionals licensed by WV Board of Medicine
description: The purpose of this bill generally relates to professionals to be licensed by the West Virginia Board of Medicine.

title: Relating to Board of Coal Mine Health and Safety quorum
