description: The purpose of this bill is to provide action when a quorum of the board is present; and to modify the membership of the board to include the Director of the Office of Miners' Health, Safety and Training as an additional voting member.

title: Increasing protection for minors when victims of human trafficking
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide additional protection for the minor victims of sex trafficking.

title: Repealing personal income tax and corporate net income tax
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the personal income tax and the corporate net income tax.

title: Admitting localities or territories contiguous to borders into WV
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow admission as part of West Virginia, localities or territories that are contiguous to the borders of West Virginia.

title: Relating to operation of certain motorboats on lakes
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the director of Natural Resources to promulgate rules, requiring persons operating motorboats with larger than 9.9 engines on 9.9 horsepower lakes to run in idle mode. The rules are to authorize fines for violations.

title: Removing certain requirements for private, parochial, or church schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the requirement that a kindergarten, preschool, or school education program operated by a private, parochial, or church school be recognized by West Virginia Department of Education Policy 2330 in order to be exempt from the section of code imposing certain childcare related licensure, approval, certification, and registration requirements.

title: Relating to required courses of instruction for private, parochial, and church schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove private, parochial, and denominational schools from the requirements for certain courses of instruction and requirements pertaining to Celebrate Freedom Week.

title: Creating Natural Resources Anti-Commandeering Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to protect employees of the State of West Virginia and its political subdivisions from being commandeered by a federal agency or other agent to enforce federal regulations and other actions related to extractive resources or related downstream industries, which do not exist in state law.

title: Coal Co-tenancy Modernization and Miners Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide an exception to waste and trespass for certain coal estates to encourage the safe and efficient mining, extraction, and production of coal.

title: Prohibiting obscene materials in or within 2,500 feet of WV schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit obscene materials in West Virginia schools.

title: Establishing offense of assault or injury of service animal
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the offense of assault upon or injury to a service animal and establish penalties.

title: Creating WV Homeschool Student Athletics Participation Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to reduce the grade levels in which a student is allowed to transfer schools at least one time without losing academic eligibility to grades nine and 10.

title: Creating alternative DOH procurement procedure
description: The purpose of this chapter is to authorize the use of certain alternative contracting procedures, to prescribe appropriate requirements to ensure that such contracting procedures serve the public interest, and to establish a process for evaluation of such contracting procedures.

title: Authorizing DOH to provide reimbursement for timely relocation of utilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to facilitate timely utility relocation whenever the relocation is properly completed within the dates established by the DOH. This will reduce project delays.

title: Authorizing green flashing warning lights on DOH vehicles
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow green flashing warning lights to be used by the Division of Highways, and other vehicles at the discretion of the Commissioner of Highways.

title: Classifying forestry equipment for levy purposes
description: The purpose of this bill is to reclassify forestry equipment as Class I property to provide tax benefits to forestry businesses by acknowledging forestry as a part of agriculture.

title: Removing county residency requirement for county superintendent of schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the requirement for a county superintendent of schools to reside in the county in which he or she serves or in a contiguous county.

title: Department of Commerce rule relating to certification of microgrid district or certification as high impact data center
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the Department of Commerce to promulgate a legislative rule relating to certification of a microgrid district or certification as a high impact data center.This section is new; therefore,

title: Permitting women's wrestling in certain public schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit women's wrestling in public high schools and public charter schools as a sanctioned sporting event in this state.

title: Relating to state road system
description: The purpose of this bill is to creating standards in determining a change of use of existing entrances.

title: Defining what constitutes adulteration of food or drugs
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit certain food colorings in dietary supplements in accordance with the definitions in the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act.

title: Exempting common carriers and contract carriers of solid waste
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt common carriers and contract carriers engaged in the business of transporting solid waste for commercial or industrial customers to disposal or recycling locations.

title: Allowing city attorneys and municipal court clerks to file judgement liens
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow city attorneys and municipal clerks to file judgment liens.

title: Relating to authority of sheriff's commission for collection of taxes
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the allowable commission for tax collection by the sheriff.

title: Setting new maximum annual interest rate for regulated consumer lenders on certain loans
description: The purpose of this bill is to set a maximum interest rate which licensed regulated consumer lenders may charge on installment loans and remove a cap on nonrevolving loans when determining a finance charge.

title: Adopting Social Work Licensure Compact
description: The purpose of this bill is to adopt the Interstate Compact on Social Work Licensure.

title: Prohibiting certain compensation for advising or assisting with veterans benefits
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Veterans' Empowerment and Trust Safeguard Act; define terms; prohibit a person from receiving compensation for assisting another in obtaining veterans' benefits, except as permitted by federal law; prohibit a person from receiving compensation for referring an individual to another person to assist with obtaining veterans' benefits; prohibit a person from receiving compensation for services rendered prior to action by the Department of Veterans Affairs; prohibit a person from guaranteeing an individual is certain to receive specific veterans' benefits; prohibit a person from receiving excessive or unreasonable fees for assisting another in obtaining veterans' benefits; prohibit a person from receiving compensation for assisting another in obtaining veterans' benefits without a written fee agreement, to be filed with the Department of Veterans Affairs; prohibit the provision of medical evidence or expert witness testimony in connection with a veterans' benefits matter where fees are not pre-determined; establish violations of the West Virginia Consumer Credit and Protection Act; and provide for exceptions.

title: Creating offense of theft by conversion
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the offense of theft by conversion and establish penalties.

title: Modifying severance tax on newly drilled oil and natural gas wells
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the amount of severance tax on newly drilled oil and natural gas wells.

title: Relating to crimes involving abuse or desecration of human remains
description: The purpose of this bill is to fill a gap in existing law by criminalizing intentional, outrageous mistreatment of the dead without tying prosecution to proof of homicide or other underlying criminal activity, while still providing enhanced penalties when the conduct is connected to concealment, obstruction, or felony conduct.

title: Creating WV River Access and Bridge Modernization Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to encourage safe, voluntary, and fiscally responsible public river access without the use of eminent domain, without interference with private property rights, and without expanding the authority of the Division of Highways beyond that expressly provided by this article.

title: Relating to collection of special emergency ambulance service fee by county commission
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a process for the collection of delinquent special emergency ambulance fees by the county commission.

title: Eliminating double taxation on foreign income at state level
description: The purpose of this bill is to alleviate double taxation on foreign income at the state level. The bill sunsets the credit for income tax paid on foreign income in 2070.

title: Prohibiting discharge of concentrated highway runoff onto private property
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure that highway drainage systems are designed, maintained, and operated in a manner that protects adjoining and downstream properties while preserving the efficient operation of the state road system.

title: Allowing installation of cattle guards on certain public roads
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the installation of cattle guards on certain public roads.

title: Providing 10 percent raise for all public school staff
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a ten percent pay raise all teachers and school service personnel.

title: Relating generally to practice of veterinary medicine
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the scope of practice and requirements to practice as a veterinarian, veterinary technician, and certified animal euthanasia technician in the state; to change temporary permitting requirements of a veterinarian and veterinary technician; and to increase certain criminal penalties.

title: Requiring state agencies give first consideration to veterans and disabled law-enforcement officers when hiring
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that a state agency or an appointing authority of the state give first consideration to disabled law enforcement officers when considering applicants for employment with the state.

title: Reducing participation required to receive volunteer firefighter tax credit
description: The purpose of this bill is to reduce the amount of participation requirement to receive the volunteer firefighter tax credit from 30 percent to 20 percent.

title: Modifying disability and retirement benefits and procedures for municipal police and firefighters
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify disability and retirement benefits and procedures for municipal police and firefighters participating in municipal plans overseen by the Municipal Pensions Oversight Board.

title: Increasing pay for magistrates
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the salaries of magistrates to $70,000 annually, beginning July 1, 2026.

title: Relating to Municipal Police Officers and Firefighters Retirement System
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify unused leave accruals eligible for campus police officers to use for additional service credit upon retirement and technical clean up.

title: WV Comprehensive Student and Family Support Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a Comprehensive Student and Family Support program; provide legislative findings and purpose; define terms; designate the West Virginia Department of Education as the lead agency; establish local coordinating teams; create a state fund; authorize rulemaking; require accountability, reporting, and audit; and make an appropriation.

title: Updating definitions and requirements for rental agreements of self-storage facilities
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend definitions and requirements for rental agreements of self-service storage facilities; recognize unsinged rental agreements under certain circumstances; provide for notice of removal of personal property from the self-service storage facilities upon termination or non-renewal of the rental agreements; and, establish an effective date applicable to all rental agreements

title: Requiring warrant for DNR officials or officers to enter onto any private property
description: The purpose of this bill is to require that a natural resources officer possess landowner consent or a warrant prior to entering private property and providing exceptions.

title: Clarifying law-enforcement cooperation with bordering states
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify cooperation between law-enforcement agencies and personnel with states bordering this state.

title: Relating to home confinement officers’ participation in EMS retirement system
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the requirement that home confinement officers be certified as law enforcement officers in order to participate in the Emergency Medical Services Retirement System.

title: Creating First-Time Home Buyer Savings Account Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "First Time Home Buyer Savings Account Act".

title: Removing cap for municipalities on their stabilization fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the 30% cap on municipal stabilization funds.

title: Relating to bank merger by interstate branching
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide clarity regarding the attestation submitted in response to an interstate bank merger.

title: Authorizing county commissions to increase compensation of elected county officials
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize County Commissions to increase the compensation of elected county officials.

title: Setting forth mandatory Medicaid program requirements
description: The purpose of this bill is to set forth program requirements for Medicaid to come into federal requirements with the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

title: Relating to program requirements of Bureau for Family Assistance
description: The purpose of this bill is to set forth program requirements for the Bureau for Family Assistance to come into federal compliance with the One Big Beautiful Bill.

title: Eliminating hepatitis-b and meningitis as required vaccines
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate hepatitis-b and meningococcal meningitis vaccines from the existing compulsory vaccination requirements as outlined in WV Code 16-3-4. The Center for Disease Control and Prevention Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices has revised their recommendations, and they no longer include the hepatitis B and meningococcal vaccines in their recommended childhood vaccine schedule. Consequently, this bill removes the meningitis and hepatitis-b vaccines from the list of vaccines that are compulsory for school or state-regulated child care center entry in West Virginia.

title: Permitting audio recording during Child Protective Services investigations
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit audio recording during Child Protective Services investigations and interactions during visits.

title: Establishing Energy Freedom and Fairness Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Energy Freedom and Fairness Act, permitting retail competition for the purchase and sale of electric power for certain non-residential retail customers.

title: Updating requirements for filing fee and annual fee
description: The purpose of this bill is to update the filing fee and annual fee.

title: Phasing out corporate net income tax over 4 years
description: The purpose of this bill is to phase out corporate net income tax over 4 years, cutting the tax 25% per year starting tax year 2027.

title: Requiring DMV to provide identification card for eligible released inmates
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Division of Motor Vehicles to provide an identification card for eligible released inmates.

title: Authorizing county boards of education to accept volunteers as certified chaplains
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize county boards of education to employ or accepting as volunteers certified chaplains. The bill also provides for limitation of liability.

title: Clarifying eligibility for TRICARE program
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify eligibility for the TRICARE program; authorize reimbursement when certain requirements are met; require policies and guidelines; and clarify funding.

title: Creating Protecting Shareholders Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish standards for a breach of fiduciary duty under the Protecting Investors Act.

title: Relating to container labeling of nonintoxicating beer
description: The purpose of this bill relates to container labeling of nonintoxicating beer and nonintoxicating craft beer.

title: Expanding pilot program to implement involuntary commitment process
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand the counties that can participate in the pilot project.

title: Modifying requirements for involuntary hospitalization
description: The purpose of this bill is to streamline the involuntary treatment process by removing a list of persons that must be contacted prior to an involuntary hospitalization and to increase the timeframe in which to file the mental hygiene petition.

title: Creating exemption to prescription limitations for mid-level providers
description: The purpose of this bill is to create an exemption to the prescription limitations contained in this section for mid-level providers under the supervision of a medical director offering comfort medications in hospice care settings. The physician medical director shall audit the prescribing practices of the mid-level providers to ensure compliance with the provisions of this section and compliance with reporting to the controlled substances monitoring database.

title: Relating to Critical Incident Review Team
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that the Critical Incident Review Team is under the Office of the Inspector General. The bill has the Office of Inspector General lead the team and prepare the reporting.

title: Relating to requirements for school nutrition programs
description: The purpose of this bill is to set forth a list of additives to be excluded from a school nutrition program and to set forth requirements for sugar, a fiber to carbohydrate ratio, and to require a posting of menu ingredients.

title: Establishing resident and nonresident wildlife viewing stamps
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a wildlife viewing program through an additional stamp or endorsement upon a state-issued hunting or fishing license.

title: Eliminating restriction to carry firearm on State Capitol Complex grounds
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that it is legal to carry a deadly weapon, firearm, or pepper spray specifically on the sidewalks and streets that directly border and surround the State Capitol Complex grounds.

title: Requiring parental notification of school-based dispensaries of contraceptives to minors
description: The purpose of this bill is to require public schools to notify parents when dispensing contraceptives to minors. The bill provides a definition.

title: Relating to county economic opportunity development districts
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the Berkeley County Commission to levy a special district excise tax for the benefit of the Berkeley County Economic Opportunity Development District.

title: Clarifying process for filling vacancies in Legislature
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the responsibility of the Governor to fill a vacancy in the state legislature. The bill provides a process for the selection of three legally qualified persons to fill a vacancy in the office of state senator or House of Delegates, allows for virtual candidate interviews where more than three candidates apply, and clarifies the interview process. It also provides that a party county chairman appoint a subcommittee to act as vacancy committee where a senate or delegate district is wholly within one county.

title: Limiting landowner liability when land is used for certain purposes
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit landowner liability for injuries to, or caused by, persons entering or going upon land for noncommercial recreational purposes, wildlife propagation purposes, military training purposes, law-enforcement training purposes, or homeland defense training purposes. It also clarifies statutory language in light of Mallet v. Pickens, 206 W.Va. 145, 522 S.E.2d 436 (1999); defines terms, and makes technical corrections.

title: Transferring authority for racing events from county commissions to DOT
description: The purpose of this bill is to transfer duties from county commissions to the Department of Transportation when a road closure is requested to hold organized motorsports events on public roads.

title: Establishing Adopt-A-Road program
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Adopt-A-Road program.

title: Creating Foster Care Facilities Improvement Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Foster Care Facilities Improvement Fund, to be used for the improvement and maintenance of foster care facilities and services within the state. The bill grants the Secretary of Human Services authority to make certain disbursements from the fund, pursuant to recommendations made by an advisory committee appointed by the secretary, with priority to be given to grant awards given to nonprofit organizations providing foster care services in the state for purposes of renovation, construction, and maintenance of foster care facilities.

title: Removing state agencies' requirement to submit annual reports for certain businesses
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the requirement that state agencies submit annual progress reports on small, women and minority-owned business procurement to the Department of Administration.

title: Extending authority to state spending units
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend the authority of the purchasing director, who may utilize best value procurement, to state spending units when they determine that it is in the best interest of the state.

title: Relating to government construction contracts
description: The purpose of this bill is to add language that gives vendors a 10-day grace period to provide bid bond documentation after the bid closing to address bonding errors in otherwise qualified bids.

title: Providing extra state aid to school districts for students enrolled in certain schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to define a reasonable route; provide extra state aid to school districts for students enrolled in extremely remote schools; and prohibit a county board from closing an extremely remote school.

title: Relating to agency changes to auctioneers
description: The purpose of this bill is to update and clarify the laws on auctioneering.

title: Establishing certain rights for purchasers of residential improvements
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish certain rights for purchasers of residential improvements. The bill states a legislative purpose; defines terms; mandates contracts for residential improvements contain warranty; states required minimum terms of warranty; sets length of warranty; establishes that warranty is cumulative of other warranties; prohibits exclusion or limitation of express or implied warranties; mandates that arbitration proceedings be held within certain distance from location of improvements; requires alternative dispute resolution provisions of contract be prominently displayed; and establishes grounds for disciplinary action by Contractor Licensing Board.

title: Relating to in-state production of value-added forest products
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide tax credits to encourage in-state production of value-added forest products.

title: Relating to comprehensive reform of state’s water infrastructure systems
description: The purpose of this bill is to comprehensively reform the state's water and wastewater infrastructure, streamline and clarify the process for issuing certain state grants and loans for water and wastewater infrastructure projects, eliminating the Water Development Authority Board and reassigning any necessary functions, requiring additional reports and on-going training for city and county operators of public water and wastewater systems, allowing public water and wastewater systems to enter into Regional Cooperative Agreements, creating an Early Intervention Pilot Program for struggling public water and wastewater utilities, updating the methodology for the watch list for troubled public water and wastewater utilities, establishing an improvement period for public water and wastewater utilities on the watch list, and allowing for required memorandums of understanding when an identified acquiring utility is exempt from forced consolidation.

title: Requiring children to be screened for sex trafficking upon entering foster care
description: The purpose of this bill is to require children to be screened for sex trafficking and labor trafficking as they enter foster care.

title: Prohibiting certain adulterated products
description: The purpose of this bill is to define terms clarify what additives and food dyes are prohibited and to clarify penalties.

title: Allowing retail liquor outlets discount certain liquor below minimum markup
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow retail liquor outlets who purchased liquor which has not sold in two years to be able to discount liquor that has been documented as stagnant below the minimum markup. The retail liquor outlet benefits from the sale of older or stagnant liquor and the state benefits with additional sales tax on liquor that might otherwise be destroyed.

title: Creating Caregiver Tax Credit Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a tax credit for eligible family members providing caregiver services to an eligible family member.

title: Creating needs-based assessment for EMS
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Emergency Medical Services Needs-Based Assessment and Funding Act.

title: Creating Country Roads Mapping and Marketing Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Country Roads Mapping and Marketing Act.

title: Creating Litter Control and Environmental Cleanup Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure a coordinated approach to litter control, leverages county resources, and introduces a nonprofit contractor to handle large-scale cleanups.

title: Establishing Off-Highway Motor Vehicle Recreation Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Off-Highway Motor Vehicle Recreation Act, create the West Virginia Off-Highway Motor Vehicle Recreation Commission, and a new Off-Highway Motor Vehicle Recreation Program Fund.

title: Establishing non-denominational chapel within WV State Capitol building
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a non-denominational chapel within the West Virginia Capitol building.

title: Declaring certain claims against WV to be moral obligations
description: The purpose of this bill is to declare certain claims against the state to be moral obligations of the state and to authorize payments therefor from the following funds:GENERAL REVENUE FUND: $160,655.07 STATE ROAD FUND: $259,506.46   TOTAL: $420,161.53

title: Requiring Department of Health to report positive alpha-gal tests to CDC
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Secretary of the Department of Health to propose legislative rules to include alpha-gal syndrome on the list of diseases that shall be required to be reported to the Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

title: Allowing certain county EMS officers to participate in EMS Retirement System
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow emergency medical services officers currently participating in the Public Employees Retirement System to elect to begin participating in the Emergency Medical Services Retirement System.

title: Prohibiting state entities from engaging in activity related to sexual orientation
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit state government entities from promoting or facilitating discussions, policies, programs, or medical procedures related to sexual orientation or gender transitioning; defining terms; prohibiting use of state funds for such purposes; establishing enforcement mechanisms; and providing for penalties.

title: Increasing oversight and regulatory authority of PSC
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure that Public Service Districts in West Virginia operate with greater transparency, accountability, and efficiency under the enhanced oversight of the Public Service Commission.

title: Creating Outdoor West Virginians with Disabilities Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Outdoor West Virginians with Disabilities Act. The bill provides for a short title. The bill establishes definitions. The bill provides updates to travel management plans and motor vehicle use plans. The bill clarifies motor vehicle use maps and designation of certain public land as open, limited, or closed to off-road vehicles. Finally, the bill clarifies the effect of the article.

title: Relating to eligibility for homebound services for exceptional children
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove a significant barrier for families by ensuring that students receive timely educational support through allowing nurse practitioners and physicians assistants, as well as physicians, to certify eligibility for homebound services.

title: Exempting certain county boards of education from certain licensure
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt two county boards of education that are a part of a childcare center or facility pilot for school personnel employed by the county from certain licensure, approval, certification, and registration related requirements; require the State Superintendent of Schools to select for the pilot the first two counties that apply and demonstrate that they are financially capable of participating in the pilot; establish the term of the pilot to be for two years; and require a report to the Legislative Oversight Commission on Education Accountability at the conclusion of the two years.

title: Relating to advertising by licensed limited video lottery retailers
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize licensed video lottery retailers and operators to advertise, subject to the approval of the lottery director.

description: The purpose of this bill is to supplement and amend the appropriation of public moneys out of the Treasury from the balance of moneys remaining as an unappropriated surplus balance in the State Fund, General Revenue, to the Governor's Office, Civil Contingent Fund.

description: The purpose of this bill is to provide pay increases to members of the judiciary and to make modifications to the judicial retirement system.

title: Relating to sentence of death or life imprisonment for capital sexual battery
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a sentence of death or life imprisonment for capital sexual battery of a person less than 12 years of age.

description: The purpose of this bill is to consolidate several disparate energy development entities under the Office of Energy and to empower the Office of Energy to develop a comprehensive energy development policy and plan, a comprehensive grid stabilization plan, and to test the stability of West Virginia's energy grid.

description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the statutory requirement that the Supreme Court of Appeals supply all magistrates with hard copies of the West Virginia Code.

title: Relating to courthouse closures on certain days
description: The purpose of this bill relates to courthouse closures on certain days.

title: Relating to appeals of orders or decrees of adoption
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that the Intermediate Court of Appeals does not have appellate jurisdiction over appeals of adoption orders or decrees.

title: Permitting parents and guardians to pay for independent medical evaluation of child in protective custody
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit a parent, guardian, or custodian to pay for an independent medical evaluation of a child in protective custody.

title: Relating to distribution of West Virginia reports
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal W. Va. Code Â§51-8-5 providing for distribution of West Virginia reports.

title: Continuing of independent living and transitional support services for youth
description: The purpose of this bill is to develop a continuum of services and supports for youth who are preparing to exit foster care or who have aged out of that care.

title: Board of Medicine rule relating to continuing education for physicians and podiatric physicians
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the Board of Medicine to promulgate a legislative rule relating to continuing education for physicians and podiatric physicians.This section is new; therefore,

title: Requiring receipt of return of service or return receipt be filed with court
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify procedures for evictions proceedings.

title: Clarifying policy of state regarding jury service
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the procedures and selecting petit and grand juries in the state.

title: Increasing each school district's basic foundation program
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase each school district's basic foundation program by increasing the ratio of professional educators per 1,000 students and the ratio of service personnel per 1,000 students, both of which are a part of the calculation used to determine each school district's basic foundation program; and provide that for the 2026-2027 school year only, a school district cannot be penalized for failing to meet the minimum ratio of professional instructional personnel per state aid funded professional educators.

title: Relating to school preparation days
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit a teacher from being required to use the school preparation days for any other purpose besides the preparation for the opening of school or for school closing; require noninstructional days to include two Leave Teachers Alone (LTA) days to be used as determined by classroom teachers for activities that will improve instruction; and require both of these days to be scheduled and occur before the beginning of the instructional term.

title: Requiring competency assessment upon return to public school
description: The purpose of this bill is to require demonstration of competency of any nonpublic school, home school, microschool, learning pod, or individualized instruction plan student upon enrollment in a public school before the public school can transcribe grades onto a public school transcript.

title: Removing physical education requirements for certain middle and high school athletes
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that students participating in good standing in an extracurricular sport are not required to comply with the statutory middle school and high school physical education requirements.

title: Relating to abortion pill reversal
description: The purpose of this bill is to add the abortion pill reversal as covered expense.

title: Clarifying definition of “farm” or “farmland” for real property tax assessment purposes
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the definition of farm for property tax assessment purposes to prevent disqualification of certain acreage in which other business activities not farming are performed.

title: Authorizing physician assistants to own business
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow physician assistants to own a practice, to allow the Board of Medicine to deny a license or other authorization to physician assistants who make unlawful referrals where that physician assistant has a proprietary interest, provide definitions, and to authorize physician assistants to form a medical corporation and designates physician assistant as a professional service eligible for establishing a professional limited liability company.

title: Regulating consumable hemp products
description: The purpose of this bill is to regulate consumable hemp products and to establish clear standards for the manufacture, distribution, sale, taxation, and enforcement of consumable hemp products in West Virginia.

title: Rescheduling cannabis from Schedule 1 to Schedule 3
description: The purpose of this bill is to move cannabis and its synthetic and natural derivatives from Schedule I to Schedule III.

title: Relating to lung cancer prevention and education
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish lung cancer prevention and education; define terms; establish a lung cancer and education program within the Department of Health; allow for grants to be issued to approved organizations; set forth grant criteria; set forth procedure and eligibility for grants; require annual reporting; establish a fund; set forth financial eligibility; set forth medical eligibility; set forth the reimbursement process; set forth a rate for the screening service; and require the Department of Health to administer an education campaign.

title: Allowing individuals to change party voter registration during day of voting
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow registered voters to change their party affiliation on the day of an election.

title: Prohibiting any person to operate unmanned aerial vehicle over polling place on election day
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit any person from operating an unmanned aerial vehicle over a polling place or within the electioneering zone on election day.

title: Increasing civil penalties for failure to file required campaign finance reports
description: The purpose of this bill is to encourage campaign finance reports to be filed in a timely fashion.

title: Requiring Secretary of State notify respondent of election law complaint
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that the Secretary of State shall notify a respondent of an election law complaint, and that the respondent shall provide a response within ten business days.

title: Prohibiting refunds of candidate filing fees
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that a candidate's filing fee is not generally refundable, even if the candidate withdraws from the race or does not make it onto the ballot.

title: Requiring candidates file campaign financial statements with county clerk
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase transparency into county and municipal campaign finance activities by requiring all campaign finance reports for all elected offices in the state to be published online within 48 hours of the deadline, and to require municipal candidates file their campaign finance reports with the County Clerk of the County in which they are running.

title: Requiring contact information for chair of political committee
description: The purpose of this bill is add contact information of the committee chair and require and acknowledgment in the statement of organization that the committee must adhere to the reporting requirements set forth in the campaign finance laws of West Virginia.

title: Relating to filing of fraudulent financing statement
description: The purpose of this bill is to update acts constituting the filing of a fraudulent financing statement; filing of an affidavit and notice to secured parties; investigative powers of the Secretary of State; removing outdated provisions of code.

title: Defining residence for purpose of registration and voting in WV
description: The purpose of this bill is to define residence for purposes of registration and voting.

title: Creating personal income tax credit for election officials in WV
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a $100 tax credit per election for service by an election official to West Virginia Personal income tax liabilities. The tax credit shall not exceed $200 for any taxable year.

title: Creating Second Amendment Preservation Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Second Amendment Preservation Act. The bill states a short title; provides legislative findings; prohibits regulation of intrastate firearm sales and transfers; provides for civil and criminal penalties; authorizes Attorney General to defend and prosecute; and addresses sovereign immunity.

title: Providing for filing fee for write-in candidates
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for a filing fee for a write-in candidate.

title: Increasing fees for execution of service of process by certified mail
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for an increase in service of process fees and fees in shipping and handling expenses for execution of service of process by certified mail upon any defendant and to provide for certain exemptions for foreign veteran-owned businesses.

title: Clarifying persons permitted to be present in polling place during election for non-voting activities
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify individuals permitted to be present in a polling place during an election period while voting is taking place for normal non-voting activities that normally occur at the location.

title: Relating to powers of Secretary of State under Solicitation of Charitable Funds Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow the Secretary of State administer oaths and affirmations, issue subpoenas, involve the aid of the circuit court in the execution of its subpoena power, and request legal and investigative assistance from the Attorney General, when investigating a charitable organization, professional fund-raising counsel or professional solicitor.

title: Providing circumstances that qualified voter is authorized to vote absentee ballot by mail
description: Providing circumstances that qualified voter is authorized to vote absentee ballot by mail

title: Extending State Fire Marshal inspections to include municipalities with certified fire code
description: The purpose of this bill is to extend State Fire Marshal inspections, generally, to include municipalities with certified fire code officials, certified fire code inspectors and certified fire code plans examiners to perform duties in occupancies under the jurisdiction of the State Fire Marshal; to clarify the difference between certified and uncertified fire officials, fire inspectors, and fire plans examiners; to explain how training and examination for Fire Code Disciplines and Categories are completed; and to delineate the approved categories of examinations.

title: Limiting county's responsibility for jail costs after sentences of time served
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit county responsibility for certain jail costs if an inmate is sentenced to time served.

title: Relating to WV Division of Homeland Security and Emergency Management background checks on radio programmers
description: The purpose of this bill is to revise the statute to authorize the West Virginia Division of Homeland Security and Emergency Management ("WVDHSEM") to run background checks on persons applying to be a Statewide Interoperable Radio Network ("SIRN") Radio Programmer and on persons seeking approval to work in SIRN network facilities and to explain the requirements of submitting to the background checks.

title: Removing responsibility to hear appeals of certification decisions from deputy cabinet secretary
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the responsibility to hear appeals of certification decisions by the subcommittee from the Deputy Cabinet Secretary or his or her designee to the Office of Administrative Hearings and clarify that the Office of Administrative Hearings is to hear appeals from decisions or orders of any of the subcommittees of the Governor's Committee on Crime, Delinquency and Correction. to the Office of Administrative Hearings.

title: Relating to payment of funeral expenses for first responders
description: The purpose of this bill is to modify the language in the statute to make it consistent with W.Va. Code Â§5H-1-2(b) for survivor's benefit payment for first responders for purposes of payment for funeral expenses of law enforcement, safety, and emergency workers.

title: Making WV State Police Forensic Laboratory responsible for certification and standards for DUI tests
description: The purpose of this bill is to make the West Virginia State Police Forensic Laboratory the entity responsible for the certification, standards, and administration of secondary chemical tests. The bill also makes the West Virginia State Police Forensic Laboratory responsible for approval of the devices and methods of preliminary breath analysis. The bill transfers rule-making authority from the Bureau of Public Health to the State Police.

title: Repealing Addiction Treatment Pilot Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the Addiction Treatment Pilot Program as the pilot program no longer exists.

title: Increasing fees to be paid by parolees based on his or her ability to pay
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the amount of fees to be paid by parolees based on his or her ability to pay, not to exceed $50 per month to defray the costs of supervision, which would be an increase from not to exceed $40 to not to exceed $50.

title: Providing for amount Secretary of State may charge for bad check fee
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow the Secretary of State to charge a fee of up to $5 plus any amount passed on by a financial institution for any returned or dishonored check, money order, or draft. This fee covers the administrative costs for handling the returned item. The bill allows the Secretary of State discretion to waive late fees under certain circumstances. The bill provides that the Secretary of State shall design and provide a veteran-owned logotype.

title: Clarifying definition of "electioneering"
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the definition of electioneering; describe certain prohibited electioneering information or activity; exempt from the definition of "electioneering" certain activity and materials; permit certain persons to enforce election laws and maintain law and order inside the prohibited zone; and permit certain persons to seek assistance from a law-enforcement officer.

title: Eliminating capital gains tax on gold, silver, and cryptocurrency
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt capital gains tax on gold, silver, and cryptocurrency.

title: Strengthening definition of shelter for animals exposed to extreme weather
description: This bill shall be known as the West Virginia Safe Outdoor Dogs Act. The purpose of this bill is to provide added protection for animals exposed to extreme weather.

description: The purpose of supplemental appropriation bill is to amend an item of appropriation in the aforesaid section and account for the designated spending units for expenditure during the fiscal year 2026.

title: Creating WV Housing Stability Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Housing Stability Fund. The bill authorizes the fund, to be administered by the Secretary of Human Services, for purposes of distributing grant funding to child welfare agencies, housing authorities, and qualifying nonprofit organizations. The bill provides for grant funding to be used to provide housing assistance vouchers and utility bill assistance payments to qualifying recipients.

title: Providing $10,000 pay raise to teachers across five years
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide teachers a $10,000 pay raise across five years, with a $2,000 raise to be provided in each school year beginning with the 2026-2027 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year, and to provide service personnel with a 25% raise across five years, with a five percent raise to be provided in each school year beginning with the 2026-2027 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year.
