title: Creating Office of Entrepreneurship within Office of Secretary of State
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the office of entrepreneurship, provide for legislative oversight, authorize rulemaking authority, create an associated fund, and to provide an appropriation.

title: Eliminating Herbert Henderson Office of Minority Affairs
description: The purpose of this bill is to eliminate the Herbert Henderson Office on Minority Affairs, to remove the placement of the director of the Herbert Henderson Office on Minority Affairs from the West Virginia Semiquincentennial Commission and the West Virginia Hope Scholarship Board, to direct the department of administration to designate Building 3 of the State Capitol Complex in memory of Herbert H. Henderson, to terminate the Minority Affairs Fund, and to transfer its remaining funds to the Entrepreneurship and Innovation Investment Fund administered under Â§5B-2-16 of this Code.

title: Recognizing Judea and Samaria
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Recognizing Judea and Samaria Act" and to prohibit state agencies from using the term "West Bank" in official government materials.

title: Clarifying minimum hours of attendance necessary for child subsidies to be based on monthly enrollment
description: The purpose of this bill is to set forth requirements for the reimbursement of child care and afterschool providers receiving child care subsidies.

title: Establishing Blue Envelope Program to promote communication between law enforcement and community members
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend this code section by adding a new article, relating to the establishment of a "Blue Envelope Program" to promote inclusivity and enhanced communication between law enforcement and community members with a condition or disability where additional accommodations or awareness may be helpful; providing findings and declarations; providing how the program will be established; and, providing immunity for individuals providing information to the "Blue Envelope Program" in good faith.

title: Relating to standard of proof required for final parole or probation revocation hearing
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the standard of proof required for a final parole or probation revocation hearing is proof by a preponderance of the evidence.

title: Requiring coverage of treatment for certain pediatric autoimmune neuropsychiatric disorders in certain circumstances
description: The purpose of this bill is to require PEIA, Medicaid, and other health insurance providers to cover for treatment of pediatric autoimmune neuropsychiatric disorders associated with streptococcal infections and pediatric acute onset neuropsychiatric syndrome if certain conditions are met.

title: Allowing Tier II teachers to bank unused sick time toward retirement
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow Tier II members of the Teachers Retirement System to apply accrued annual and sick leave, on the basis of one day's retirement service credit for each two days of accrued annual and sick leave, toward an increase in his or her retirement benefits with those days constituting additional credited service in computation of the benefits under the Teachers Retirement System.

title: Permitting prescribed fire control on private property without burning permit
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow prescribed fire control on private property without a burning permit.

title: Relating to requirements for licensure and regulation of money transmission services
description: The purpose of this bill is to bring virtual currency kiosks within the purview of money transmission licensure and create disclosure requirements and daily transaction limitations for new and existing customers.

title: Creating Judicial Deference Reform Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Judicial Deference Reform Act. The bill states a purpose; sets forth definitions; prohibits judicial deference to state agency interpretations; addresses interpretive ambiguity; specifies applicability of the Act; provides for severability; and provides an effective date.

title: Requiring recreational facilities have AED accessible
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Hamza Syed Law" which requires recreational facilities to have an automated external defibrillator accessible during its hours of operation.

title: Changing certain school calendar requirements from days or months to hours
description: The purpose of this bill is to change the minimum public school 180 instructional day requirement into a minimum 900 instructional hour requirement; change the minimum public school employment term from 200 days to 1,600 hours; convert other public school calendar provisions from days or months to hours; increase the time to be designated by the county board to be used by the employees for preparation for opening school; and allow nonpublic schools to deliver instruction through alternative methods that count toward up to 25 hours of instructional time when schools are closed due to inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstance.

title: Relating to oversight of political subdivision hiring of private attorneys
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the oversight by the Attorney General of a political subdivision's hiring of a private attorney under a contingency fee legal arrangement or contract to sue.

title: Modifying allowable forms of medical cannabis to include edible form
description: The purpose of this bill is to improve patient safety in the medical cannabis program by authorizing permitted, regulated medical cannabis processors to manufacture medical cannabis in edible form for dispensing to certified patients in the state; to specify certain requirements applicable to medical cannabis dispensed in edible form; and to require information relating to the dispensing of medical cannabis be input into the controlled substance monitoring database.

title: Providing tax credits for expenditures and activities related to biochar manufacturing
description: The purpose of this bill is to encourage private investment in biochar manufacturing facilities located in this state by leveraging existing federal tax incentives through a limited, performance-based state income tax credit.

title: Reforming certain boards and commissions
description: The purpose of this bill is reform of state board and commissions system by eliminating unnecessary, expired, or outdated board, shifting essential functions of several boards or commissions to various agencies or entities, reducing the number of members on several continuing boards and commissions, modifying or eliminating several reports of various boards or commissions, and technical cleanup throughout.

title: Removing time limits for filing or modifying claims for massive fibrosis
description: The purpose of this bill is to recognize progressive massive fibrosis claims as more severe than simple occupational pneumoconiosis in the workers' compensation code.

title: Establishing when sale of tax liens may be suspended by sheriffs
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish when a sale may be suspended by the sheriff and provide a tax exemption to certain purchasers.

title: Relating to licensure and certification of alcohol and drug counselors
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the licensure or certification of alcohol and drug counselors.

title: Relating to valuation of farm property
description: The purpose of this bill is to assess certain agricultural buildings on qualified farmland at salvage value beginning January 1, 2027, and, beginning January 1, 2029, remove such buildings from ad valorem real property tax assessment altogether.

title: Permitting certain teachers to be certified to work as school principals
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit teachers with 15 years of experience at the elementary, high school, or middle school level to be certified to be principals at the levels they have taught in for the minimum of 15 years.

title: Including certain correctional facilities as "targeted facility"
description: The purpose of this bill is criminalize the use of unmanned aerial vehicles over correctional and detention facilities.

title: Creating truancy pre-trial diversion program
description: This bill creates a Truancy Pretrial Diversion Program that allows parents, guardians, and custodians of truant children an opportunity to remedy the truancy prior to conviction, allows for additional delays in sentencing to address the underlying truancy, and requires the Department of Human Services to provide home-based family preservation services when ordered by a magistrate or circuit court judge.

title: Removing barriers to voting for disabled voters
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove voting barriers for disabled voters.

title: Increasing number of days before nursing homes must report abandoned property to administrator
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the procedures on filing a claim and distribution for unclaimed property.

title: Modernizing and updating workers’ compensation statutes
description: The purpose of this bill is to revise outdated provisions within Articles 4 and 5, Chapter 23 of the West Virginia Code, which pertain to the administration of workers' compensation claims. Much of the revised language is antiquated and predates the 2005/2006 regulatory transition from a state-operated monopolistic system for workers' compensation to a competitive, private market system. The bill also repeals obsolete code sections.

title: Requiring election officials to capture and publish ballot images
description: The purpose of this bill is to preserve ballot images and cast vote records on the Secretary of State website which will allow a near 100% verification of cast vote tabulation by citizens and election officials and provide voters with the ability to anonymously identify and verify their ballot cast in a statewide election in West Virginia.

title: Permitting lawful prescription of crystalline polymorph psilocybin under FDA recommendations
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit lawful prescription, distribution, and marketing of any composition of crystalline polymorph psilocybin that the United States Food and Drug Administration approves and that is rescheduled by the United States Drug Enforcement Administration, in accordance with the recommendations of the United States Food and Drug Administration.

title: Relating to pharmacy benefit managers and state pharmacy purchasing
description: The purpose of this bill is to is to regulate pharmacy benefit managers and state pharmacy purchasing by requiring an annual pharmacy dispensing fee study, limiting amounts charged by pharmacy benefit managers, prohibiting certain pharmacy benefit manager contracts with West Virginia Medicaid and the West Virginia Public Employees Insurance Agency, and requiring implementation of a pharmacy cost containment tool.

title: Relating to flexibility in setting lottery director's salary
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide flexibility in setting the Lottery Director's annual salary.

title: Modernizing educational programs and technologies
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Future-Ready Education Act, to enable local boards of education to enter into long-term contracts for textbooks resulting in fiscal savings, to expand the Mountain State Digital Literacy Program, to requires educators to be trained in the science of reading, and to provide funding for the science of reading training.

title: Removing unintended limitation on excused absences for students in certain extracurriculars
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the unintended limitation on excused absences for students participating in approved extracurricular and educational activities and to restore local decision-making authority to parents, teachers, and school administrators.

title: Creating First-Time Drive to Work Pilot Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the First-time Drive to Work Pilot Program in the Division of Economic Development which provides certain vehicle purchase assistance to eligible participants.

title: Removing sales tax for food bought in vending machines
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove consumers sales and service tax from prepared food sold through vending and money-operated machines.

title: Removing annual report requirement for WV Research Trust Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the annual report requirement for the West Virginia Research Trust Fund.

title: Increasing taxes on tobacco products
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend the Tobacco Products Excise Tax Act; repeal discounts on tax stamps; add a definition of "Electronic smoking device"; increase taxes on tobacco products; provide that 10 percent of the revenue collected be dedicated to the West Virginia Division of Tobacco Prevention; and repeal Â§11-17-4a and Â§11-17-4b.

title: Clarifying when detained or confined juveniles may have contact with incarcerated adult persons
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove language that may cause confusion or instances of confusion when a juvenile may be detained or confined in an institution in which he or she may have contact with or come within sight or sound of any incarcerated adult persons. The bill also provides the Commissioner of the Division of Corrections and Rehabilitation with the discretion to oversee the process of security staff or direct care staff of a jail or lock up facility where a juvenile may be detained or confined in which he or she would have contact with or come within sight or sound of any incarcerated adult persons.

title: Using “A.C.” as name ending for accounting corporation
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the use of "A.C." as a name ending for an accounting corporation.

title: Imposing privilege tax on retail sale of electric vehicle charging services
description: The purpose of this bill is to impose a 15 percent privilege tax on the retail sale of electric vehicle charging services at public charging stations.

title: Relating to civil service promotion criteria for municipal law-enforcement officers
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish civil service promotion criteria for municipal law enforcement officers.

title: Creating Safe School Events Music Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Safe School Events Music Act.

title: Mandating life sentence for first degree murder of minor victim with firearm
description: The purpose of this bill is to make a first-degree murder of a minor conviction with a firearm punishable by life imprisonment without mercy.

title: Prohibiting Medicaid from being used for abortions or gender reassignment surgery
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit state funding from being used to pay for abortions or gender reassignment surgery.

title: Requiring public lodging establishments to provide human trafficking awareness training for employees
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit a hotel or public lodging establishment to provide annual training regarding human trafficking awareness to employees and to provide for rulemaking.

title: Creating Guaranteeing Rights Against Novel International Tyranny and Extortion Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia "Guaranteeing Rights Against Novel International Tyranny and Extortion (GRANITE) Act."

title: Streamlining and reforming Division of Personnel systems
description: The purpose of this bill is to streamline and simplify the state hiring system of the Division of Personnel. The bill terminates the State Personnel Board, defines the role of the director and the Division of Personnel, transfers to the Division all State Personnel Board responsibilities, eliminate Division of Personnel exemptions for the Department of Transportation, State Tax Division, and Bureau of Social Services, transferring new hires and promoted employees within the Department of Transportation into the classified-exempt system and exempting these employees from the grievance board. This bill right-sizes state government and refocuses the Division of Personnel to broadly categorize employees, provide training to our agencies, and to act as an advocate for attracting and retaining employees.

title: Providing Future Farmers of America-sanctioned activities not count toward limit of excused absences
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that a Future Farmers of America ("FFA") sanctioned activity or program shall not count toward the 10-day limit for excused absences.

title: Eliminating capital gains tax on certain precious metals
description: The purpose of this bill is to exclude capital gains on precious metal bullion from gross income.

title: Clarifying Commissioner of Agriculture's authority to regulate bees
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the Commissioner of Agriculture's authority to regulate bees, bee equipment, and apiaries in the state, and to clarify when legal proceedings may be maintained against certain owners or operators of agricultural land or agricultural operations.

title: Relating to manufacture, sale, and distribution of low-proof spirit alcohol products
description: The purpose of this bill is to afford West Virginia consumers responsible access to Low-Proof Alcohol Spirit Products consistent with their availability in adjoining states.

title: Relating to state board intervention into county school systems
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Taxpayer Transparency in Education Act; requiring the timely reporting of county school boards and prohibiting a county board from receiving discretionary state funding if it fails to provide the required published statement.

title: Raising cost of living increase for certain municipal employees
description: The purpose of this bill is to raise the cost-of-living increase from the first $15,000 to the first $45,000 for supplemental pension benefits for municipal police, firefighters, employees of waterworks systems, sewage systems, or combined waterworks/sewage systems.

title: Relating to utility affordability and economic competitiveness
description: The purpose of this bill is to restore utility affordability and reliability.

title: Specifying that cultivated meat products are adulterated foods
description: The purpose of this bill is to define cultivated meat products as an adulterated food.

title: Expanding digital mapping of unimproved public roads
description: The purpose of this bill is to enable and encourage tourism and outdoor recreation on unimproved public roads using existing resources.

title: Modifying accrued benefit of members of WV Natural Resources Police Officer Retirement System
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the West Virginia Natural Resources Police Officer Retirement System accrued benefit for members who retire after July 1, 2026, and to provide funding for the benefit,

title: Eliminating business and occupation tax exemption for certain coal-fired merchant power plants
description: The purpose of this bill is to immediately eliminate the business and occupation tax exemption for certain coal-fired merchant power plants on the generating capacity of the generating units located in this state that are owned or leased by the taxpayer and used to generate electricity. The bill would be made effective from passage.

title: Providing WV certified thoroughbred eligibility
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide West Virginia certified Thoroughbred eligibility, reallocate interstate simulcasts by licensed racetracks, increase West Virginia Restricted race caps, provide an inflation adjustment to the net terminal income at a licensed racetrack deposited in the state Excess Lottery Revenue Fund and reallocate a certain amount of said income to the thoroughbred and greyhound development funds at the licensed racetracks of origin.

title: Establishing community-based child welfare system program
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a community-based child welfare system program.

title: Clarifying powers, duties, and responsibilities of certain public health officials
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the duties and responsibilities of the Secretary of the Department of Health, the Commissioner of the Bureau for Public Health, and the state health officer.

title: Creating WV Reshoring Manufacturing Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to encourage West Virginia businesses to replace foreign-manufactured goods with goods manufactured in West Virginia through performance-based, time-limited tax incentives that support sustained in-state production, workforce expansion, and long-term economic growth.

title: Establishing early detection cancer screening pilot program for active and retired firefighters
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish an early detection cancer screening pilot program for active and retired firefighters.

title: Making certain agreements prohibiting information sharing related to sexual abuse unenforceable
description: The purpose of this bill is to make unenforceable certain agreements prohibiting the disclosure of information related to acts of sexual abuse.

title: Creating Advanced Baseload Energy Development Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create an advanced-baseload ecosystem that provides affordable and reliable power while generating long-term economic and security benefits.

title: Repealing data collection code section relating to Juvenile Reform Oversight Committee
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal a section dealing with data collection for the Juvenile Reform Oversight Committee, which terms have expired due to a sunset provision.

title: Expanding categories of eligible federal law-enforcement officers authorized to enforce state laws
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand the categories of eligible federal law-enforcement officers authorized to enforce the laws of this state under certain circumstances.

title: Permitting Adjutant General to pay employees during federal government shutdown or furlough
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the Adjutant General to pay employees during a federal government shutdown or furlough.

title: Relating to hospital facility fee oversight
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the charging of facility fees, to provide for penalties and to require reporting.

title: Providing birth certificate copies to homeless individuals under 18
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide birth certificates to homeless individuals under the age of 18.

title: Allowing firearms on Capitol Complex with exceptions
description: The purpose of this bill is to change West Virginia code to allow for the carry of a firearm or deadly weapon on the Capitol grounds and surrounding streets and sidewalks that border the capitol complex and the carrying of a firearm in the Capitol Building with certain exceptions.

title: Creating Uniform Assignment for Benefit of Creditors Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Uniform Assignment for Benefit of Creditors Act.

title: Relating to mileage and expenses of judges
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal W. Va. Code Â§6-7-5 providing for mileage and expenses of judges.

title: Closing Parent Education and Mediation Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to close the Parent Education and Mediation Fund and redirect its funds to the Family Court Fund.

title: Transferring Court Security Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to transfer the administration of the Court Security Fund from the Department of Military Affairs and Public Safety to the Supreme Court of Appeals; modify composition of the Court Security Board; and to eliminate legislative rulemaking requirements.

title: Relating to disaffiliation from religious denominations while retaining property
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide provisions for the disaffiliation from religious denominations and the retention and division of property upon disaffiliation.

title: Relating to health insurance for living organ donors
description: The purpose of this bill is to prohibit the denial, cancellation, or other discrimination in policies of life insurance, sickness, disability, or long-term care insurance due to the status of the insured as a living organ donor.

title: Relating to hotel occupancy tax
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend the definition of "hotel" to include campground sites and to provide the county commission the authority to authorize campground site for the purpose of collecting hotel occupancy tax.

title: Authorizing physician assistants to own business
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow physician assistants to own a practice.

title: Relating to minimum number of council members for certain municipalities
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow for Class IV towns and villages to have fewer council members.

title: Closing Enforcement of Guardianship and Conservatorship Act Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to close the Enforcement of Guardianship and Conservatorship Act Fund and redirect the remaining balance and certain filing fees to the Court Security Fund.

title: Closing Parent Education Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to close the Parent Education Fund and redirect the remaining balance, certain fees, and civil penalties to the Family Court Fund.

title: Adjusting liquor license requirements for certain private events
description: The purpose of this bill is to adjust the requirements for a private wedding venue or barn for purposes of certain liquor licenses for events.

title: Relating to rule-making policies
description: The purpose of this bill is that for every one new regulation issued, at least two prior regulations be identified for elimination.

title: Requiring high school students to pass US citizenship exam
description: The purpose of this bill is to require all West Virginia high school students to pass a civics examination and the United States Naturalization Examination and other tests as a prerequisite for graduation.

title: Protecting due process in firearm confiscation
description: The purpose of this bill is to require a full adversarial hearing before a court of record before a respondent may be prohibited from possessing any firearm or ammunition, under mandatory provisions in protective order and then only by clear and convincing evidence. The bill also provides for automatic appeal by respondent.

title: Creating volunteer board to review and rate library books
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the safe library books for kids committee.

title: Providing protection of personal information of certain attorneys
description: The purpose of this bill relates to the personal information of protected individuals. The bill provides for the protection of the personal information of district attorneys, assistant district attorneys, and district attorney investigators. The bill provides for records of the office of the Secretary of State. The bill provides for an effective date. Finally, the bill provides for related matters.

title: Changing requirements for home school instruction
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove all requirements for parents' certifications and remove all requirements regarding curriculum that includes the same subject areas as public schools.

title: Removing provisions that transformers do not apply to aboveground storage tanks
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the provisions that transformers do not apply to above ground storage tanks.

title: Clarifying registration and purchaser requirements for tax-abandoned land auctions
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify purchaser requirements for tax abandoned land auctions by the Auditor.

title: Providing county boards of education option to obtain certain alternate professional or other liability insurance coverage
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide county boards of education with the option of seeking insurance coverage from licensed insurance carriers, in addition to the State Board of Risk and Insurance Management.

title: Exempting volunteer fire departments from raffle regulations
description: The purpose of this bill is to exempt volunteer fire departments and part time volunteer fire departments from regulations relating to the raffle and online raffle of vehicles.

title: Providing fire safety requirements for agritourism businesses
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide reasonable minimum safety standards for fully enclosed buildings participating in the state's agritourism program.

title: Relating to education placements during child abuse and neglect investigations
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish Raylee's law which temporarily prohibits authorization of home instruction education placement if there is a pending child abuse or neglect investigation against a custodial parent of guardian.

title: Creating crime of property disposal for purposes of avoiding debt or asset repayment
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a crime of disposing or attempting to dispose of property to another party with the intention of preventing liability from the payment of debts, fines, or other fees without the knowledge or acceptance of that property by another party.

title: Clarifying Attorney General oversight of political subdivision's hiring of private attorneys
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the oversight by the Attorney General of a political subdivision's hiring of a private attorney under a contingency fee legal arrangement or contract to sue.

title: Excluding county reimbursement for any inmate declared incompetent to stand trial
description: The purpose of this bill relates to county reimbursement for housing and maintaining inmates; and excludes county reimbursement for any inmate declared incompetent to stand trial.

title: Authorizing optional use of county-wide voting centers on election day
description: This bill authorizes optional use of countywide voting centers on election day and establishes related notice, administrative, and rulemaking provisions.

title: Creating benefit for duty-related partial disability
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow for partial disability benefits under the Emergency Medical Services Retirement System.

title: Authorizing certain municipalities to become members of Municipal Police Officers and Firefighters Retirement System
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow municipalities with police officers or firefighters currently participating in the Emergency Medical Services Retirement Plan to elect to become members of the Municipal Police Officers and Firefighters Retirement System.

title: Requiring Division of Highways publish project bids on its website
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the requirement of the Commissioner of Highways to publish project bids in daily newspapers.

title: Clarifying office of Prosecuting Attorney exemption from Freedom of Information Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify that the Office of the Prosecuting Attorney is not a custodian of records and is exempt from the Freedom of Information Act.

title: Imposing one-year moratorium on approval of certain public utility rate increases
description: The purpose of this bill is to impose a one-year moratorium on approval of certain public utility rate increases.

title: Creating Neighborhood Access Road Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Neighborhood Access Road Program.

title: Creating State Tax Lien Registry
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a centralized tax lien registry to improve tax collection efficiency, enhance transparency, support economic development, and reduce administrative burden.

title: Clarifying that petition to restore firearms rights may include right to serve on jury
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the automatic restoration of civil rights for certain nonviolent first offenders.

title: Relating to registration and enforcement of kratom products
description: The purpose of this bill is to enhance registration and enforcement requirements for kratom products.

title: Relating to child torture and abused children
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the crime of child torture.

title: Prohibiting discrimination based upon gender identity or sexual orientation
description: The purpose of this bill is to add "sexual orientation," "gender identity" and "familial status" to the categories covered by the Human Rights Act, prohibiting discrimination in employment and places of public accommodation. The bill adds "sexual orientation" and "gender identity" to the categories covered by the Fair Housing Act prohibiting discrimination in housing. The bill defines "sexual orientation" and "gender identity".

title: Authorizing staffing recommendations and limits by Department of Education
description: The purpose of this bill relates to staffing oversight and accountability for county boards of education.

title: Changing membership requirements of Medical Services Fund Advisory Council
description: The purpose of this bill is to repeal the current children's health insurance advisory board; modify the membership of the Medical Services Fund Advisory Council to comply with 42 CFR Â§431.12; include the West Virginia Children's Health Insurance Program in the Medical Services Fund Advisory Council; and create the Medicaid Beneficiary Advisory Council per the requirements of 42 CFR Â§431.12.

title: Creating WV ALS Care Services Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the ALS Care Services Act.

title: Codifying common law cause of action of public nuisance
description: The purpose of this bill is to codify the common law cause of action of public nuisance in a manner consistent with its originally intended and historical applications.

title: Conducting study of vaccinated and unvaccinated pediatric populations
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Secretary of Health to conduct a study of vaccinated and unvaccinated pediatric populations and to set forth the parameters of that study.

title: Providing requirements for midwife licensure
description: The purpose of this bill is to license and regulate the practice of midwifery in this state.

title: Relating to Medicaid reimbursement rates for certain mental health procedures
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize the West Virginia physician/medical practitioner provider Medicaid enhancement board to examine the current reimbursement rates paid to outpatient psychiatry and psychology services provided in a licensed behavioral health center for outpatient psychotherapy, medication management, and interventional services, including psychiatric interview evaluations and psychotherapy with evaluation and management services for adults, families, and couples, and develop a proposal for increasing those reimbursement rates by no later than July 1, 2026.

title: Conducting oversight of Rural Health Transformation program
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for Oversight of the Rural Health Transformation Program.

title: Creating Jennings Randolph Lake State Park and Teter Creek Lake State Park
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Jennings Randolph Lake State Park.

title: Allowing certain hospital staff members to begin withdrawing from retirement benefits in certain circumstances
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow certain vested staff members participating in the Public Employees Retirement System employed by Hopemont Hospital, Jackie Withrow Hospital, John Manchin Sr. Health Care Center, and Lakin State Hospital to begin drawing their retirement annuity before the normal age of retirement.

title: Recruiting mental health professionals focusing on children and adolescents
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a student loan repayment program for mental health professionals focusing on children and adolescents.

title: Third Amendment Reaffirmation and Protection Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Third Amendment Reaffirmation and Protection Act relating to active service members serving on juries.

title: Regulating vape and smoke shop retailers
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Alternative Nicotine Product Regulatory Act of 2026" and the Alternative Nicotine Products Compliance Fund.

title: Establishing WV Nuclear Lifecycle and Advanced Fuel Cycle Development Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the West Virginia Nuclear Lifecycle and Advanced Fuel Cycle Development Act authorizing enrichment, recycling, transportation, storage and related fuel cycle activities.

title: Allowing counties and municipalities to create special assessment districts
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow counties and municipalities to create special assessment districts.

title: Creating regional pediatric mental health hubs
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a "Home-First" mental health framework and create Regional Pediatric Mental Health Hubs

title: Adding voter approval requirement to close or consolidate schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to add a voter approval requirement to the required steps prior to a final decision to close or consolidate any school except in cases in which a construction bond issue was passed by the voters and the bond issue included the schools to be closed or consolidated.

title: Clarifying processes of royalty payments for wells in this state
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the method of reporting and payments from all oil and gas wells royalties. The bill provides the method of calculations and payment of royalties requiring auditing of information relating to leased premises, and transparency and monitoring of leased minerals.

title: Relating to fire and casualty insurance premium tax
description: The purpose of this bill relates to providing equal share of funds from the fire and casualty premium tax to the departments.

title: Relating to voting in WV elections while residing overseas
description: The purpose of this bill relates to voting in West Virginia elections while residing overseas.

title: Relating to statute of limitations for asbestos and silica litigation
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend the procedures for the handling of asbestos and silica litigation and to enhance the ability of the judicial system to manage such litigation.

title: Providing immunity for those who work for Child Advocacy Centers while performing duties
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide immunity from civil action for persons who are acting in the official scope of the person's duties at a local specialized child's advocacy center based on a recommendation made or an opinion rendered in good faith.

title: Limiting landowner liability for operation of all-terrain vehicles
description: The purpose of this bill is to limit landowner liability when certain persons operate an all-terrain vehicle.

title: Allowing volunteer fire departments to submit audit paperwork electronically
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow volunteer fire companies to submit audit paperwork electronically.

title: Permitting development of juvenile inpatient substance use disorder treatment beds
description: The purpose of this bill is to permit the development of juvenile treatment beds in Cabell County.

title: Allowing certain municipal plan participants to use accrued leave toward credited service upon retirement
description: The purpose of this bill is to allowing municipal police and firefighters participating in municipal plans overseen by the Municipal Pensions Oversight Board to use accrued leave toward credited service upon retirement.

title: Increasing Medicaid dental provider reimbursement rates
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase Medicaid dental provider reimbursement rates.

title: Establishing Drainage Relief Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Drainage Remediation Fund and to provide a procedure to remedy drainage and obstruction matters which may degrade the state road system.

title: Creating Second Look Sentencing Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Second Look Sentencing Act.

title: Establishing Charter School Direct Loan Program and Charter School Credit Enhancement Program
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Charter School Direct Loan Program and the Charter School Credit Enhancement Program within the West Virginia Economic Development Authority to support the growth of public charter schools.

title: Clarifying definition of “farm” or “farmland” for real property tax assessment purposes
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify the definition of farm for property tax assessment purposes to prevent disqualification of certain acreage in which other business activities not farming are performed.

title: Requiring coverage for medically necessary treatment for cleft lip and cleft palate
description: The purpose of this bill is to require coverage for newly born children up to the age of 19 for medically necessary congenital anomalies of cleft lip and palate.

title: Allowing up to five educational leave days within definition of "excused absence"
description: The purpose of this bill is to include up to five educational leave days within the definition of "excused absence" for school attendance purposes.

title: Creating limited purpose ordinance procedure for municipal elections
description: The purpose of this bill relates generally to municipal elections, and creates a limited-purpose ordinance procedure.

title: Removing electrical transformers as exempted aboveground storage tanks
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove electrical transformers from the list of exempted aboveground storage tanks.

title: Creating "responsible recreation” special license plate
description: The purpose of this bill is to create a "Responsible Recreation" special license plate and establish a special revenue fund.

title: Allowing rescission or reversal of school closure decisions through July 15
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize recession or reversal of school closure decisions through July 15 and establish procedures for this decision.

title: Allowing CDL license renewal without medical retest under certain circumstances
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish a 10-year grace period for reinstatement of commercial driving privileges when a commercial driver's license holder has failed to maintain a current medical examiner's certificate and to authorize reinstatement without retesting under certain conditions.

title: Increasing criminal penalties and fines for disturbing religious worship
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the crime of disturbing a lawful meeting, establishing penalties.

title: Modifying WV Invests Grant Program eligibility requirements
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the High School Dual Enrollment Accessibility Act.

title: Relating to financial assistance available for prescription drug
description: The purpose of this bill is to ensure financial or product assistance are available for a prescription drug.

title: Providing parents plain-language statements of immediate rights and ongoing rights
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide parents with plain language statements of their rights during a CPS investigation.

title: Creating Decentralized Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to make decentralized unincorporated nonprofit associations a recognized legal entity in the state and create the Decentralized Unincorporated Nonprofit Association Act.

title: Increasing cost of solid waste assessment fees
description: The purpose of this bill is to increase the county solid waste assessment fees by 50 cents per ton.

title: Clarifying Office of Broadband coordinate with Consumer Protection Division on certain consumer complaints
description: The purpose of this bill is to enhance the ability of the Office of Broadband to receive, transmit, and resolve consumer complaints relating to the safety, adequacy, and reliability of broadband service and providing a mechanism for consumer complaints that the terms and conditions of broadband service are unjust, unfair or unreasonable.

title: Clarifying powers and duties of Commissioner of Agriculture over state-owned land
description: The purpose of this bill is to enable the West Virginia Commissioner of Agriculture to transfer land owned by the West Virginia Department of Agriculture to other public bodies pursuant to Â§1-5-1 through to Â§1-5-5 of this code and deposit any proceeds from the transfer into the special revenue account established in Â§19-12A-6a of this code.

title: Increasing amount of funding counties receive for HOPE Scholarship enrollments
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide funding to county boards of education for certain students not enrolled in public schools in the county that either receive, or are eligible for but don't receive, a Hope Scholarship.

title: Relating to Judges' Retirement System
description: The purpose of this bill is to amend the retirement system by suspending contribution of courts into judicial retirement system until certain condition met; providing that retirees under the post-2005 retirement system are to be treated as pre-2005 retirement system retirees; providing for actuarially reduced pension benefit for judges in certain circumstances; increasing surviving spouse plan benefit for certain judges; eliminating limitation on retirement benefit increases; and eliminating distinction between certain judges for purposes of calculating surviving spouse plan benefits, surviving dependent children plan benefits, and adjusted annual retirement benefit.

title: Creating Sustainable Child-Serving Workforce and Foster Care Modernization Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Sustainable Child-Serving Workforce & Foster Care Modernization Act.

title: Allowing death penalty for first degree murder during commission of sexual assault
description: The purpose of this bill is to impose the death penalty on defendants convicted of first degree murder and first degree sexual abuse of a child in the same proceeding.

title: Adjusting salaries for certain administrative law judges
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a 15 percent salary adjustment to Administrative Law Judge 1 and Administrative Law Judge 2 positions in WorkForce West Virginia Board of Review.

title: Expanding crime of indecent exposure to include biological males who undress in women's locker rooms
description: The purpose of this bill is to expand to the crime of indecent exposure to include biological males who undress in women's locker rooms.

title: Creating WV Energy Freedom Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Energy Freedom Act related to power generation companies in the state.

title: Creating Energy Economic Load Dispatch Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the Energy Economic Load Dispatch Act.

title: Relating to ventilation of underground mines
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide that ventilation of underground mines include that ventilation where coal is being cut, mined, drilled for blasting, or loaded be ventilated with a minimum quantity of 3,000 cubic feet of air per minute.

title: Supplemental appropriation to Department of Agriculture, fund 1401
description: The purpose of this supplemental appropriation bill is to increase an existing item of appropriation in the aforesaid account for the designated spending unit for expenditure during the fiscal year 2026.A total of $3,000,000 increase in spending authority shall be used for operational expenses and for personal services and employee benefits.A total (up to) $1,000,000 increase in spending authority in the agricultural fees fund shall be used to purchase necessary software and program related expenses as indicated in SB985. The WV purchasing process and RFP cannot be completed until authorized in this bill.

title: Requiring Board of Education to promulgate rule that sets forth common graduation requirements
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the West Virginia Board of Education to promulgate a rule that sets forth common graduation requirements for all students as well as additional requirements for the various graduation pathways which include an Academic (College-Preparatory) Pathway, a Workforce Pathway, a Career and Technical Education and Skilled Trades Pathway, and a Military Pathway.

title: Clarifying when service of process on limited liability corporation by Secretary of State is sufficient
description: The purpose of this bill is to clarify when service of process on a limited liability company or corporation by the Secretary of State is sufficient.

title: Increasing fines for first degree sexual assault
description: The purpose of this bill is to raise the penalty for first degree sexual assault to life in prison.

title: Establishing Community Well-Being, Recovery Housing, and Family Stabilization Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish the Community Well-Being, Recovery Housing, and Family Stabilization Act.

title: Transferring responsibility of school position eliminations to WV Board of Education
description: The purpose of this bill is to transfer the responsibility for making determinations on eliminating school personnel positions due to lack of need for all county school districts from the county boards of those districts to the West Virginia Board of Education.

title: Allowing retail liquor licensees to wholesale certain low-proof alcohol to class A and class B retailers
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow retail liquor licensees to distribute at wholesale ready to drink low-proof distilled alcohol products to Class A and Class B retailers regulated by Â§11-16-1 et seq. of the code.

title: Creating WV Task Force on Election Integrity
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the West Virginia Task Force on Election Integrity.

title: Creating Charter School Revolving Loan Fund
description: The purpose of this bill is to create the "Charter School Revolving Loan Fund" for the purpose of providing low-interest loans for public charter school facility projects with the loan repayments being recycled and deposited back into the fund to support future projects.

title: Requiring county commissions approve certain purchase made with county fire levy moneys
description: The purpose of this bill is to require county commissions to approve all purchases made by volunteer fire departments over $10,000 and made with county fire fee levy money.

title: Authorizing Unemployment Automation and Administration Fund to modernize and enhance WorkForce West Virginia
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize Unemployment Automation and Administration Fees on certain employers to support administration and automation efforts, subject to a cap on collections, suspension of the fee and rate reduction when the Unemployment Compensation Trust Fund balance falls below $300 million dollars, and sets forth disbursements for modernization of WorkForce West Virginia.

title: Creating Natural Organic Reduction Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to establish Natural Organic Reduction as a lawful method of disposition in West Virginia.

title: Conducting rate study for substance use disorder
description: The purpose of this bill is to require the Bureau of Medical Services to use a data informed methodology when reviewing reimbursement rates for substance use disorder services.

title: Increasing number of children allowable in family child care home

title: Authorizing green burial and natural burial
description: The purpose of this bill is to authorize green burials and natural burials.

title: Creating Economic Freedom Zones Act
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove barriers to voluntary exchange and entrepreneurship in distressed areas without creating preferential treatment for specific industries or firms.

title: Relating to agreements between solid waste motor carriers and commercial customers
description: The purpose of this bill is to allow agreements between solid waste motor carriers and their commercial customers that have a term of more than one year.

title: Providing WV certified thoroughbred eligibility and increase restricted race caps
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide West Virginia certified Thoroughbred eligibility and increase West Virginia Restricted race caps.

title: Authorizing reassignment of school personnel in certain instances
description: The purpose of this bill is to remove the prohibition against reassigning school personnel in certain instances after the last day of the second school month.

title: Creating TEAM-WV

title: Creating Economic Development Investment Fund

title: Reforming licenses related to sale of alcohol and nonintoxicating alcohol products
description: The purpose of this bill is to simplify and consolidate WVABCA license structure and fees and provide licensees with additional services for no additional fee. Many licenses are eliminated but the purpose or activity is retained in a new license but with less overall licenses. Certain new privileges are granted with retail liquor outlets being permitted to sell stagnant liquor below cost, beer fees are included with wine, liquor, and private club type licenses; up to six beer floorplan extensions are free for every Class A retail dealer; persons purchasing barrels from a distillery, mini-distillery, or micro-distillery will be permitted to transport in excess of 10 gallons of liquor; distilleries, mini-distilleries, and micro-distilleries will be permitted to sell their manufactured liquor within their market zone or contiguous market zone; wine clubs may obtain a free license to operate wine tasting dinners in licensed premises; certain licensees get beer, wine, and craft cocktail growlers for no additional fee; certain licensees get beer, wine and liquor or craft cocktail growler delivery for no additional fee; and certain licensees get curbside delivery via an application order. Sales through drive-through windows are permitted already for no additional fee. Some eliminated items include: 24 licenses, additional beer license fees when selling beer for on-premises or off-premises sales of beer as wine or liquor licensee; the special markup for distilleries, mini-distilleries, and micro-distilleries; private cigar shop license; private multi-vendor fair and festival license; a transfer to the Tax Commissioner of wine proceeds; and prorated fees in certain circumstances.

title: Protecting burial rights and lot ownerships for cemeteries and burial grounds
description: The purpose of this bill is to protect burial rights and lot ownership by ensuring the continuity of responsibility for cemetery care, prevention, abandonment and evasion of cemetery obligations.

title: Creating extended daycare program for elementary schools
description: The purpose of this bill is to create an extended childcare program for elementary schools, supervised by adults who are paid by parents of the children.

title: Permitting death penalty for murder of minors 16 years or younger
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide for the death penalty in limited circumstances. The bill provides for procedures and standards applicable thereto. Finally, procedures for carrying out the death sentence are established.

title: Aligning Uniform Unclaimed Property Act with modern practices
description: The purpose of this bill is to provide a low-lift statutory modernization aligning the West Virginia Uniform Unclaimed Property Act with emerging custodial practices for digital financial assets while preserving administrative flexibility.

title: Creating WV Land Use Association Division
description: The purpose of this bill relates to land use associations; provides a short title; defines terms; establishes construction of chapter; provides statement of purpose; requires liability insurance; creates West Virginia Land Use Association Division; mandates registration of land use associations with Secretary of State; setting fee for registration; and prescribe content of registration form.

title: County Boundary Review Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to propose a Constitutional Amendment to allow the Legislature to redraw county boundaries and combine counties every 100 years.

title: Protection of the Right to Bear Arms Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to amend the State Constitution to prohibit the state, counties, municipalities, or other political subdivisions of the state from restricting the right to keep and bear arms.

title: Honorably Discharged Veterans' Property Tax Exemption Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to provide for an election to amend the state Constitution to exempt all honorably discharged veterans of the Armed Forces of the United States from ad valorem property taxation on the assessed value of his or her primary residence plus all personal property.

title: State Senate and House of Delegates Term Limits Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to propose an amendment to the Constitution of the State of West Virginia to prevent any person from serving more than three consecutive terms in the State Senate or more than six consecutive terms in the House of Delegates, for terms beginning after the ratification of the proposed amendment.

title: Cannabis Legalization Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to allow citizens to possess for personal consumption up to two ounces, or up to four plants of cannabis; to allow the Legislature to regulate the manufacture and sale of cannabis; and to provide dismissal and expungement of prior convictions for possession of cannabis

title: Constitutional Officer Term Limit Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to propose an amendment to the Constitution of the State of West Virginia preventing any person from serving more than two consecutive terms in the offices of Secretary of State, Auditor, Treasurer, Commissioner of Agriculture, or Attorney General.

title: Right to Reproductive Freedom with Protections for Health and Safety Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to propose an amendment to the Constitution of the State of West Virginia preserving the right to reproductive freedom.

title: Sheriff's Succession Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to amend the sheriff's succession amendment to permit a person appointed to fill a term of sheriff to be eligible for election to two consecutive terms if the appointed term is less than two years.

title: Citizenship Requirement to Vote in West Virginia Elections Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to propose an amendment to the Constitution to provide that in all elections held in West Virginia only citizens of the state who are citizens of the United States are qualified to vote.

title: Constitutional Officer Term Limit Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to amend the constitution to prevent any person from serving in the office of Secretary of State, Auditor, Treasurer, Commissioner of Agriculture, or Attorney General for more than three consecutive terms beginning after January 1, 2029.

title: Homestead Exemption Increase Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to increase the Homestead Exemption from $20,000 to not less than the first $25,000 and to provide for periodic additional increases until such time as the exemption reaches $40,000 of the Homestead Exemption.

title: Elimination of Business Inventory Tax Amendment
description: The purpose of this amendment is to eliminate the current tax on business inventory.

title: West Virginia Educational Governance Accountability Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to ensure legislative oversight on educational policies while still allowing for the State Board of Education to function. However, it would need to navigate potential legal challenges regarding the separation of powers, the independence of educational governance, and the potential for politicization of educational policy. The public's perception of legislative involvement in education will also be crucial in whether such an amendment would pass.

title: Incorporation of Churches or Religious Denominations Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to authorize the incorporation of churches or religious denominations which choose to incorporate.

title: Bi-annual Legislative Session Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to modify the frequency of Legislative Session from annually to bi-annually.

title: Constitutional Officer Term Limit Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to amend the constitution to prevent any person from serving in the office of Secretary of State, Auditor, Treasurer, Commissioner of Agriculture, or Attorney General for more than three consecutive terms beginning after January 1, 2029.

title: Elimination of Real Estate Taxes on Permanent Residence Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to amend the Constitution to permit the Legislature to adopt general laws exempting from taxation personal property used exclusively for residential purposes and occupied by the owner or one of the owners thereof as his or her residence who is a citizen of this state.

title: Elimination of Real Estate Taxes on the Permanent Residence for Certain Individuals Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to amend the Constitution to eliminate taxes on the permanent residence of certain individuals.

title: Governor Born in West Virginia Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to provide that candidates for governor shall be born in West Virginia in order to be eligible for office of Governor.

title: Fire and Emergency Services Excess Levy Majority Approval Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to allow excess levies or increases in maximum rates limited exclusively to fire protection and emergency medical services to be approved by a simple majority (50% + 1), while retaining the current sixty percent voter approval requirement for all other levies and increases.

title: Taxpayers' Bill of Rights Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to establish the Taxpayers' Bill of Rights, establishing a tax and expenditure limitation that provides that state government may not increase expenditures more than the growth of the population plus inflation.

title: Authorizing Legislature to Eliminate Ad Valorem Tax on Business and Inventory Tangible Personal Property Amendment
description: The purpose of this resolution is to permit the Legislature to repeal the business and inventory ad valorem tangible personal property tax and to require the Legislature create a mechanism to replace funding that counties receive from the business and inventory ad valorem tangible personal property tax.
